    apply (mem_subgroupImage N n _).mpr
    refine ⟨a / ⟨b, hb'⟩,
      (QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem (N := N) (x := (a : G)) (y := b)).mp hab.symm, ?_⟩
    change mk G n a - mk G n ⟨b, hb'⟩ = mk G n a
    rw [(mk_eq_zero G n ⟨b, hb'⟩).mpr hb, sub_zero]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (mem_subgroupImage N n x).mp hx
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, mapLayer_mk, mk_eq_zero]
    change (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (a : G) ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup (G ⧸ N)).lowerCentralSeries n
    rw [show (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (a : G) = 1 from (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr ha]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.quotientLayerEquiv_mapLayer
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientLayerEquiv_mapLayer (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : ℕ) (x : Layer G n) :
    quotientLayerEquiv N n (mapLayer (QuotientGroup.mk' N) n x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk x
proof:
:= by
  simp [quotientLayerEquiv]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.quotientLayerEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientLayerEquiv_mk (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : ℕ) (x : term G n) :
    quotientLayerEquiv N n (mk (G ⧸ N) n (termMap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) n x)) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (mk G n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapLayer_mk, quotientLayerEquiv_mapLayer]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.quotientLayerEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientLayerEquiv_symm_mk (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : ℕ) (x : Layer G n) :
    (quotientLayerEquiv N n).symm (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      mapLayer (QuotientGroup.mk' N) n x
proof:
:= by
  apply (quotientLayerEquiv N n).injective
  simp

name: T3.Amalgamation.relator_mem_iff
statement:
theorem relator_mem_iff (N : Subgroup (Coproduct G H)) [N.Normal] (a : A) :
    relator f g a ∈ N ↔
      (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (Coproduct.inl (f a)) =
        (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (Coproduct.inr (g a))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [relator, div_eq_mul_inv, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply] using
    (QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem (N := N)
      (x := Coproduct.inl (f a)) (y := Coproduct.inr (g a))).symm

name: T3.Amalgamation.leftMap_comp_eq_rightMap_comp
statement: theorem leftMap_comp_eq_rightMap_comp : (leftMap f g).comp f = (rightMap f g).comp g
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  exact (relator_mem_iff f g (relations f g) a).mp (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨a, rfl⟩)

name: T3.Amalgamation.hasExponentThree_pushout
statement: theorem hasExponentThree_pushout : HasExponentThree (Pushout f g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (relations f g) x
  rw [← map_pow, Coproduct.pow_three, map_one]

name: T3.Amalgamation.relations_le_ker_lift
statement:
theorem relations_le_ker_lift (hK : HasExponentThree K) (i : G →* K) (j : H →* K)
    (hij : i.comp f = j.comp g) : relations f g ≤ (Coproduct.lift hK i j).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  change Coproduct.lift hK i j (relator f g a) = 1
  simp only [relator, map_mul, map_inv, Coproduct.lift_inl, Coproduct.lift_inr]
  exact mul_inv_eq_one.mpr (DFunLike.congr_fun hij a)

name: T3.Amalgamation.lift_leftMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_leftMap (hK : HasExponentThree K) (i : G →* K) (j : H →* K)
    (hij : i.comp f = j.comp g) (x : G) : lift f g hK i j hij (leftMap f g x) = i x
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Amalgamation.lift_rightMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_rightMap (hK : HasExponentThree K) (i : G →* K) (j : H →* K)
    (hij : i.comp f = j.comp g) (x : H) : lift f g hK i j hij (rightMap f g x) = j x
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Amalgamation.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  have hq : i.comp (QuotientGroup.mk' (relations f g)) =
      j.comp (QuotientGroup.mk' (relations f g)) :=
    Coproduct.hom_ext (DFunLike.congr_fun hl) (DFunLike.congr_fun hr)
  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (relations f g) x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hq y

name: T3.Amalgamation.canonicalMaps_injective_of_amalgam
statement:
theorem canonicalMaps_injective_of_amalgam (hK : HasExponentThree K)
    (i : G →* K) (j : H →* K) (hi : Function.Injective i) (hj : Function.Injective j)
    (hij : i.comp f = j.comp g) :
    Function.Injective (leftMap f g) ∧ Function.Injective (rightMap f g)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    exact hi (by simpa only [lift_leftMap] using congrArg (lift f g hK i j hij) h)
  · intro x y h
    exact hj (by simpa only [lift_rightMap] using congrArg (lift f g hK i j hij) h)

name: T3.Amalgamation.amalgamableOver_iff
statement:
theorem amalgamableOver_iff : AmalgamableOver f g ↔
    Function.Injective (leftMap f g) ∧ Function.Injective (rightMap f g)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, hij⟩
    let : Group K := hK
    exact canonicalMaps_injective_of_amalgam f g hpow i j hi hj hij
  · rintro ⟨hl, hr⟩
    exact ⟨Pushout f g, inferInstance, hasExponentThree_pushout f g,
      leftMap f g, rightMap f g, hl, hr, leftMap_comp_eq_rightMap_comp f g⟩

name: T3.Amalgamation.amalgamableOver_of_amalgam
statement:
theorem amalgamableOver_of_amalgam (hK : HasExponentThree K)
    (i : G →* K) (j : H →* K) (hi : Function.Injective i) (hj : Function.Injective j)
    (hij : i.comp f = j.comp g) : AmalgamableOver f g
proof:
:=
  (amalgamableOver_iff f g).mpr (canonicalMaps_injective_of_amalgam f g hK i j hi hj hij)

name: T3.Amalgamation.leftMap_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem leftMap_eq_one_iff (x : G) : leftMap f g x = 1 ↔ Coproduct.inl x ∈ relations f g
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _

name: T3.Amalgamation.rightMap_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem rightMap_eq_one_iff (x : H) : rightMap f g x = 1 ↔ Coproduct.inr x ∈ relations f g
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _

name: T3.Amalgamation.exists_witness_of_not_amalgamableOver
statement:
theorem exists_witness_of_not_amalgamableOver (h : ¬ AmalgamableOver f g) :
    (∃ x : G, x ≠ 1 ∧ Coproduct.inl x ∈ relations f g) ∨
      ∃ x : H, x ≠ 1 ∧ Coproduct.inr x ∈ relations f g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! hn
  apply h
  apply (amalgamableOver_iff f g).mpr
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
    intro x hx
    by_contra hne
    exact hn.1 x hne ((leftMap_eq_one_iff f g x).mp hx)
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
    intro x hx
    by_contra hne
    exact hn.2 x hne ((rightMap_eq_one_iff f g x).mp hx)

name: T3.Amalgamation.normalClosure_relators_eq_of_closure_range_eq_top
statement:
theorem normalClosure_relators_eq_of_closure_range_eq_top {I : Type*} (a : I → A)
    (ha : Subgroup.closure (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range fun i => relator f g (a i)) = relations f g
proof:
:= by
  let N := Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range fun i => relator f g (a i))
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  have hagree : (q.comp Coproduct.inl).comp f = (q.comp Coproduct.inr).comp g := by
    apply MonoidHom.eq_of_eqOn_dense ha
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (relator_mem_iff f g N (a i)).mp (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_mono
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a i, rfl⟩
  · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    rintro x ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact (relator_mem_iff f g N x).mpr (DFunLike.congr_fun hagree x)

name: T3.Amalgamation.exists_witness_of_generating_family
statement:
theorem exists_witness_of_generating_family {I : Type*} (a : I → A)
    (ha : Subgroup.closure (Set.range a) = ⊤) (h : ¬ AmalgamableOver f g) :
    (∃ x : G, x ≠ 1 ∧ Coproduct.inl x ∈
      Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range fun i => relator f g (a i))) ∨
    ∃ x : H, x ≠ 1 ∧ Coproduct.inr x ∈
      Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range fun i => relator f g (a i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalClosure_relators_eq_of_closure_range_eq_top f g a ha]
  exact exists_witness_of_not_amalgamableOver f g h

name: T3.Amalgamation.AmalgamableOver.precomp
statement:
theorem AmalgamableOver.precomp {A' : Type*} [Group A'] (e : A' →* A)
    (h : AmalgamableOver f g) : AmalgamableOver (f.comp e) (g.comp e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, hij⟩ := h
  refine ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (fun k : A →* K => k.comp e) hij

name: T3.Amalgamation.amalgamableOver_precomp_iff
statement:
theorem amalgamableOver_precomp_iff {A' : Type*} [Group A'] (e : A' →* A)
    (he : Function.Surjective e) :
    AmalgamableOver (f.comp e) (g.comp e) ↔ AmalgamableOver f g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, AmalgamableOver.precomp f g e⟩
  rintro ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, hij⟩
  refine ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, ?_⟩
  ext a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := he a
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hij b

name: DirectSum.coe_decompose_range_lof
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_decompose_range_lof (x : ⨁ i, M i) (i : ι) :
    (decompose (fun i => LinearMap.range (lof R ι M i)) x i : ⨁ i, M i) =
      lof R ι M i (x i)
proof: := rfl

name: Set.powersetCard.sumEquiv_fst
statement:
theorem sumEquiv_fst (n : ℕ) (s : powersetCard (I ⊕ J) n) :
    ((sumEquiv n s).1 : ℕ) = s.val.toLeft.card
proof: := rfl

name: Set.powersetCard.sumEquiv_symm_val
statement:
theorem sumEquiv_symm_val (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : powersetCard I k) (t : powersetCard J (n - k)) :
    ((sumEquiv n).symm ⟨k, s, t⟩).val = s.val.disjSum t.val
proof: := rfl

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.appendOrderEmbedding_apply
proof: := rfl

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.ofFinEmbEquiv_appendOrderEmbedding
statement:
private theorem ofFinEmbEquiv_appendOrderEmbedding {p q : ℕ}
    (s : Set.powersetCard I p) (t : Set.powersetCard J q) :
    (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv
      (appendOrderEmbedding (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s)
        (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t))).val = s.val.disjSum t.val
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff, Set.powersetCard.mem_ofFinEmbEquiv_iff_mem_range]
  cases z with
  | inl i =>
    rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      obtain ⟨j | j, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective j
      · simp only [appendOrderEmbedding_apply,
          finSumFinEquiv_apply_left, Fin.append_left, Function.comp_apply,
          Sum.inl.injEq] at hj
        exact (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem s i).mp ⟨j, hj⟩
      · simp [appendOrderEmbedding_apply] at hj
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem s i).mpr hi
      exact ⟨Fin.castAdd q j, by simpa [appendOrderEmbedding_apply] using hj⟩
  | inr i =>
    rw [Finset.inr_mem_disjSum]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      obtain ⟨j | j, rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective j
      · simp [appendOrderEmbedding_apply] at hj
      · simp only [appendOrderEmbedding_apply,
          finSumFinEquiv_apply_right, Fin.append_right, Function.comp_apply,
          Sum.inr.injEq] at hj
        exact (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem t i).mp ⟨j, hj⟩
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem t i).mpr hi
      exact ⟨Fin.natAdd p j, by simpa [appendOrderEmbedding_apply] using hj⟩

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.wedgeMap_tmul_coe
statement:
theorem wedgeMap_tmul_coe (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : ⋀[R]^k.val V) (y : ⋀[R]^(n - k.val) W) :
    (wedgeMap R V W n k (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) =
      (exteriorPower.map k (LinearMap.inl R V W) x : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) *
      (exteriorPower.map (n - k) (LinearMap.inr R V W) y : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.exteriorBasis_disjSum_coe
statement:
theorem exteriorBasis_disjSum_coe {p q n : ℕ} (h : p + q = n)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I p) (t : Set.powersetCard J q) :
    ((b.prod c).exteriorPower n
      ⟨s.val.disjSum t.val, by rw [Set.powersetCard.mem_iff, Finset.card_disjSum,
        s.property, t.property, h]⟩ : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) =
      (exteriorPower.map p (LinearMap.inl R V W) (b.exteriorPower p s) :
        ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) *
      (exteriorPower.map q (LinearMap.inr R V W) (c.exteriorPower q t) :
        ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W))
proof:
:= by
  subst n
  have hs : (⟨s.val.disjSum t.val, by simp⟩ : Set.powersetCard (I ⊕ J) (p + q)) =
      Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv
        (appendOrderEmbedding (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s)
          (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t)) :=
    Subtype.ext (ofFinEmbEquiv_appendOrderEmbedding s t).symm
  rw [hs]
  simp only [exteriorPower.basis_apply, exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti_family,
    exteriorPower.ιMulti_family_apply_coe, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_family,
    Equiv.symm_apply_apply, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti]
  congr 1
  funext i
  refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) i <;>
    simp [appendOrderEmbedding_apply, Basis.prod_apply]

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorBasis_apply
statement:
theorem tensorBasis_apply (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Set.powersetCard I k) (t : Set.powersetCard J (n - k)) :
    tensorBasis b c n ⟨k, s, t⟩ =
      DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k
        (b.exteriorPower k s ⊗ₜ[R] c.exteriorPower (n - k) t)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tensorBasis b c n).repr.injective
  ext ⟨l, u, v⟩
  simp only [Basis.repr_self]
  change Finsupp.single
      (⟨k, s, t⟩ : Σ k : Fin (n + 1), Set.powersetCard I k × Set.powersetCard J (n - k))
      (1 : R) ⟨l, u, v⟩ =
    ((b.exteriorPower l).tensorProduct (c.exteriorPower (n - l))).repr
      ((DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k
        (b.exteriorPower k s ⊗ₜ[R] c.exteriorPower (n - k) t)) l) (u, v)
  by_cases h : k = l
  · subst l
    rw [DirectSum.lof_apply, ← Basis.tensorProduct_apply, Basis.repr_self]
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
  · rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne k l _ (Ne.symm h), map_zero,
      Finsupp.zero_apply]
    exact Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (fun he => h (congrArg Sigma.fst he).symm)

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_basis
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_basis (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Set.powersetCard I k) (t : Set.powersetCard J (n - k)) :
    tensorEquiv b c n ((b.prod c).exteriorPower n
      ((Set.powersetCard.sumEquiv n).symm ⟨k, s, t⟩)) =
      DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k
        (b.exteriorPower k s ⊗ₜ[R] c.exteriorPower (n - k) t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEquiv, Basis.equiv_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, tensorBasis_apply]

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_symm_basis
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_basis (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Set.powersetCard I k) (t : Set.powersetCard J (n - k)) :
    (tensorEquiv b c n).symm
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k
        (b.exteriorPower k s ⊗ₜ[R] c.exteriorPower (n - k) t)) =
      (b.prod c).exteriorPower n ((Set.powersetCard.sumEquiv n).symm ⟨k, s, t⟩)
proof:
:=
  (tensorEquiv b c n).symm_apply_eq.mpr (tensorEquiv_basis b c n k s t).symm

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (tensorEquiv b c n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k) = wedgeMap R V W n k
proof:
:= by
  apply ((b.exteriorPower k).tensorProduct (c.exteriorPower (n - k))).ext
  rintro ⟨s, t⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Basis.tensorProduct_apply]
  rw [tensorEquiv_symm_basis]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact exteriorBasis_disjSum_coe b c (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ k.isLt)) s t

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_symm_tmul_coe
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_tmul_coe (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : ⋀[R]^k.val V) (y : ⋀[R]^(n - k.val) W) :
    ((tensorEquiv b c n).symm
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) :
        ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) =
      (exteriorPower.map k (LinearMap.inl R V W) x : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W)) *
      (exteriorPower.map (n - k) (LinearMap.inr R V W) y : ExteriorAlgebra R (V × W))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wedgeMap_tmul_coe, ← tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof b c]
  rfl

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_wedgeMap
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_wedgeMap (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (z : TensorBlock R V W n k) :
    tensorEquiv b c n (wedgeMap R V W n k z) =
      DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof b c]
  exact (tensorEquiv b c n).apply_symm_apply _

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.leftCount_sumEquiv_symm
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ((s.val.disjSum t.val).filter (fun z => z.isLeft = true)) =
      s.val.map Function.Embedding.inl := by
    ext z
    cases z <;> simp
  change ((s.val.disjSum t.val).filter (fun z => z.isLeft = true)).card = k
  rw [hf, Finset.card_map, s.property]

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.projection_basis
proof:
:= by
  apply ((b.prod c).exteriorPower n).repr.injective
  ext t
  rw [ExteriorSum.projection_repr]
  by_cases hs : ExteriorSum.leftCount s = k
  · rw [ite_eq_left hs]
    by_cases hst : s = t
    · subst t
      rw [ite_eq_left hs]
    · simp only [Basis.repr_self_apply, ite_eq_right hst, ite_self]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hs, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    by_cases hst : s = t
    · subst t
      rw [ite_eq_right hs]
    · simp only [Basis.repr_self_apply, ite_eq_right hst, ite_self]

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.wedgeMap_tensorEquiv_component
statement:
theorem wedgeMap_tensorEquiv_component (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (x : ⋀[R]^n (V × W)) :
    wedgeMap R V W n k (tensorEquiv b c n x k) =
      ExteriorSum.projection (b.prod c) n k x
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : (wedgeMap R V W n k).comp
      ((DirectSum.component R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k).comp
        (tensorEquiv b c n).toLinearMap) = ExteriorSum.projection (b.prod c) n k from
    DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  apply ((b.prod c).exteriorPower n).ext
  intro u
  obtain ⟨⟨l, s, t⟩, rfl⟩ := (Set.powersetCard.sumEquiv n).symm.surjective u
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, tensorEquiv_basis,
    DirectSum.component.of, projection_basis, leftCount_sumEquiv_symm]
  by_cases h : l = k
  · subst l
    rw [dite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, ← tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof b c]
    exact tensorEquiv_symm_basis b c n k s t
  · rw [dite_eq_right h, map_zero, ite_eq_right (fun hv => h (Fin.ext hv))]

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.range_wedgeMap
statement:
theorem range_wedgeMap (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    LinearMap.range (wedgeMap R V W n k) = ExteriorSum.block (b.prod c) n k
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(tensorEquiv b c n).symm (DirectSum.lof R _ (TensorBlock R V W n) k z), ?_⟩
    rw [← wedgeMap_tensorEquiv_component, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, DirectSum.lof_apply]
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨tensorEquiv b c n y k, wedgeMap_tensorEquiv_component b c n k y⟩

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.wedgeMap_injective
statement:
theorem wedgeMap_injective (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (wedgeMap R V W n k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof b c]
  exact (tensorEquiv b c n).symm.injective.comp (DirectSum.of_injective k)

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.blockTensorEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
theorem blockTensorEquiv_apply_coe (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (z : TensorBlock R V W n k) :
    (blockTensorEquiv b c n k z : ⋀[R]^n (V × W)) = wedgeMap R V W n k z
proof: := rfl

name: T3.ExteriorTensor.tensorEquiv_symm_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_symm_toLinearMap (n : ℕ) :
    (tensorEquiv b c n).symm.toLinearMap =
      DirectSum.toModule R _ _ (wedgeMap R V W n)
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro k
  rw [tensorEquiv_symm_comp_lof]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  exact (DirectSum.toModule_lof R k z).symm

name: TensorProduct.map_ker_eq_map₂
statement:
theorem map_ker_eq_map₂ (f : A →ₗ[R] C) (g : B →ₗ[R] D)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    (map f g).ker = Submodule.map₂ (mk R A B) f.ker ⊤ ⊔
      Submodule.map₂ (mk R A B) ⊤ g.ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_ker f.exact_subtype_ker_map hf g.exact_subtype_ker_map hg]
  simp only [LinearMap.lTensor, LinearMap.rTensor, range_map,
    LinearMap.range_id, Submodule.range_subtype]
  exact sup_comm _ _

name: TensorProduct.tmul_ne_zero
statement: theorem tmul_ne_zero {v : V} {w : W} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) : v ⊗ₜ[K] w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace K W
  intro h
  apply hw
  apply b.repr.injective
  ext i
  have hi := congrArg (fun t : V ⊗[K] W => equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b t i) h
  rw [equivFinsuppOfBasisRight_apply_tmul_apply, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] at hi
  simpa only [map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] using (smul_eq_zero.mp hi).resolve_right hv

name: exteriorPower.contraction_wedge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contraction_wedge (φ : Module.Dual R V) (u v : V) :
    contraction φ (T3.wedgeVV R V u v) = φ u • v - φ v • u
proof:
:= by
  have hw : T3.wedgeVV R V u v = ιMulti R 2 ![u, v] := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [T3.wedgeVV, T3.gradedMul, T3.oneEquiv_symm_coe,
      ιMulti_apply_coe, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_succ_apply]
  rw [hw, contraction, alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti]
  rfl

name: exteriorPower.contraction_mem
statement:
theorem contraction_mem (φ : Module.Dual R V) (U : Submodule R V)
    {q : ⋀[R]^2 V} (hq : q ∈ wedgeSpan U) : contraction φ q ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem q hq =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩ := hq
    rw [contraction_wedge]
    exact U.sub_mem (U.smul_mem _ hv) (U.smul_mem _ hu)
  | zero => simp
  | add q r hq hr hi hj => simpa using U.add_mem hi hj
  | smul r q hq hi => simpa using U.smul_mem r hi

name: exteriorPower.contraction_pairedForm_even
statement:
theorem contraction_pairedForm_even {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    contraction (b.coord (2 * k)) (pairedForm b n) = b (2 * k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [pairedForm, map_sum, contraction_wedge, Module.Basis.coord_apply,
    Module.Basis.repr_self]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · simp
  · intro i hi hik
    have h₁ : 2 * i ≠ 2 * k := by omega
    have h₂ : 2 * i + 1 ≠ 2 * k := by omega
    simp [h₁, h₂]
  · simp [hk]

name: exteriorPower.contraction_pairedForm_odd
statement:
theorem contraction_pairedForm_odd {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    contraction (b.coord (2 * k + 1)) (pairedForm b n) = -b (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [pairedForm, map_sum, contraction_wedge, Module.Basis.coord_apply,
    Module.Basis.repr_self]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · simp
  · intro i hi hik
    have h₁ : 2 * i ≠ 2 * k + 1 := by omega
    simp [h₁, hik]
  · simp [hk]

name: exteriorPower.basis_mem_of_pairedForm_mem
statement:
theorem basis_mem_of_pairedForm_mem {n : ℕ} {U : Submodule R V}
    (h : pairedForm b n ∈ wedgeSpan U) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < 2 * n) : b j ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  have hk : j / 2 < n := by omega
  have heven := contraction_mem (b.coord (2 * (j / 2))) U h
  have hodd := contraction_mem (b.coord (2 * (j / 2) + 1)) U h
  rw [contraction_pairedForm_even b hk] at heven
  rw [contraction_pairedForm_odd b hk] at hodd
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one j with hzero | hone
  · have hj' : j = 2 * (j / 2) := by omega
    rw [hj']
    exact U.neg_mem_iff.mp hodd
  · have hj' : j = 2 * (j / 2) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hj']
    exact heven

name: exteriorPower.pairedForm_finrank_le
proof:
:= by
  let v : Fin (2 * n) → U := fun j => ⟨b j, basis_mem_of_pairedForm_mem b h j.isLt⟩
  have hi : LinearIndependent R v := LinearIndependent.of_comp U.subtype
    (b.linearIndependent.comp (fun j : Fin (2 * n) => (j : ℕ)) Fin.val_injective)
  simpa using hi.fintype_card_le_finrank

name: exteriorPower.pairedForm_ne_zero
statement: theorem pairedForm_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : pairedForm b n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := contraction_pairedForm_even b hn
  rw [hz, map_zero] at h
  exact b.ne_zero 1 h.symm

proof:

name: T3.TruncatedExterior.decompositionMap_left_inv

    DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grade V) ∘ₗ decompositionMap = LinearMap.id

  intro x
  simpa [decompositionMap, componentOne, componentTwo, componentThree] using
    ofOne_add_ofTwo_add_ofThree x

name: T3.TruncatedExterior.decompositionMap_coe
proof:
:= by
  have hz (i : ℕ) (h : (0 : TruncatedExterior V) ∈ grade V i) :
      (⟨0, h⟩ : grade V i) = 0 := rfl
  by_cases h₁ : n = 1
  · subst n
    obtain ⟨h₂, h₃⟩ := mem_grade_one.mp x.property
    have hx : ofOne (one (x : TruncatedExterior V)) = (x : TruncatedExterior V) := by
      apply ext <;> simp [h₂, h₃]
    simp [decompositionMap, componentOne, componentTwo, componentThree, h₂, h₃, hx, hz]
  by_cases h₂ : n = 2
  · subst n
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₃⟩ := mem_grade_two.mp x.property
    have hx : ofTwo (two (x : TruncatedExterior V)) = (x : TruncatedExterior V) := by
      apply ext <;> simp [h₁, h₃]
    simp [decompositionMap, componentOne, componentTwo, componentThree, h₁, h₃, hx, hz]
  by_cases h₃ : n = 3
  · subst n
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := mem_grade_three.mp x.property
    have hx : ofThree (three (x : TruncatedExterior V)) = (x : TruncatedExterior V) := by
      apply ext <;> simp [h₁, h₂]
    simp [decompositionMap, componentOne, componentTwo, componentThree, h₁, h₂, hx, hz]
  have hx : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (ext (x.property.1 h₁)
    (x.property.2.1 h₂) (x.property.2.2 h₃))
  rw [hx]
  simp

    decompositionMap ∘ₗ DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grade V) = LinearMap.id
proof:

  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [decompositionMap_coe]

statement:

theorem gradedMul_coe {i j : ℕ} (a : ⋀[R]^i M) (b : ⋀[R]^j M) :

name: T3.exteriorPower_map_coe
statement:
theorem exteriorPower_map_coe (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ) (x : ⋀[R]^n M) :
    (exteriorPower.map n f x : ExteriorAlgebra R N) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.map f (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
proof:
:= by
  let a := (⋀[R]^n N).subtype.comp (exteriorPower.map n f)
  let b := (ExteriorAlgebra.map f).toLinearMap.comp (⋀[R]^n M).subtype
  have hab : a = b := by
    apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    apply AlternatingMap.ext
    intro v
    change (exteriorPower.map n f (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) : ExteriorAlgebra R N) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.map f (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n v)
    simp only [exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti, exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe,
      ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ιMulti]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hab x

      gradedMul (exteriorPower.map i f a) (exteriorPower.map j f b)
proof:

  simp only [exteriorPower_map_coe, gradedMul_coe, map_mul]

name: T3.exteriorPower_map_oneEquiv_symm

      (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R N).symm (f v)
proof:
:= by
  apply (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R N).injective
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (exteriorPower.oneEquiv_naturality f)
    ((exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).symm v)
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h

name: T3.oneEquiv_symm_coe
