name: T3.Coproduct.rank_le
statement:
theorem rank_le [Group.FG G] [Group.FG H] :
    Group.rank (Coproduct G H) ≤ Group.rank G + Group.rank H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hgenS⟩ := Group.rank_spec G
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hgenT⟩ := Group.rank_spec H
  have hgen : Subgroup.closure
      (↑(s.image inl ∪ t.image inr) : Set (Coproduct G H)) = ⊤ := by
    simpa only [Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_image] using
      closure_image_inl_union_image_inr hgenS hgenT
  exact (Group.rank_le hgen).trans ((Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans
    (Nat.add_le_add (Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq hs) (Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq ht)))

name: T3.Coproduct.rank_freeTwo_le
statement:
theorem rank_freeTwo_le [Group.FG G] :
    Group.rank (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2))) ≤ Group.rank G + 2
proof:
:=
  rank_le.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (by simpa using Free.rank_le_card (I := Fin 2)) _)

name: T3.Coproduct.pureLeftBlock_le_grade
statement:
private theorem pureLeftBlock_le_grade (i : ℕ) :
    pureLeftBlock (G := G) (H := H) i ≤ grade (Coproduct G H) i
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mapLayer inl i y, rfl⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.pureRightBlock_le_grade
statement:
private theorem pureRightBlock_le_grade (j : ℕ) :
    pureRightBlock (G := G) (H := H) j ≤ grade (Coproduct G H) j
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mapLayer inr j y, rfl⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.mixedBlock_le_grade
statement:
private theorem mixedBlock_le_grade {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) :
    mixedBlock (G := G) (H := H) hi hj ≤ grade (Coproduct G H) (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨mixedMap hi hj y, rfl⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.pureLeftBlock_zero
statement: private theorem pureLeftBlock_zero : pureLeftBlock (G := G) (H := H) 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_bot_iff.mpr
  exact (pureLeftBlock_le_grade 0).trans (le_of_eq grade_zero)

name: T3.Coproduct.pureRightBlock_zero
statement: private theorem pureRightBlock_zero : pureRightBlock (G := G) (H := H) 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_bot_iff.mpr
  exact (pureRightBlock_le_grade 0).trans (le_of_eq grade_zero)

name: T3.Coproduct.block_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem block_zero_left (j : ℕ) : block (G := G) (H := H) 0 j = pureRightBlock j
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.block_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem block_zero_right (i : ℕ) : block (G := G) (H := H) i 0 = pureLeftBlock i
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero => exact pureRightBlock_zero.trans pureLeftBlock_zero.symm
  | succ i => rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.block_of_pos
statement:
theorem block_of_pos {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) :
    block (G := G) (H := H) i j = mixedBlock hi hj
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero => omega
  | succ i => cases j with
    | zero => omega
    | succ j => rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.block_le_grade
statement:
theorem block_le_grade (i j : ℕ) :
    block (G := G) (H := H) i j ≤ grade (Coproduct G H) (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero => simpa only [block, zero_add] using pureRightBlock_le_grade j
  | succ i => cases j with
    | zero => exact pureLeftBlock_le_grade (i + 1)
    | succ j => exact mixedBlock_le_grade _ _

name: T3.Coproduct.block_zero_zero
statement: theorem block_zero_zero : block (G := G) (H := H) 0 0 = ⊥
proof: := pureRightBlock_zero

name: T3.Coproduct.block_eq_bot_of_four_le
statement:
theorem block_eq_bot_of_four_le {i j : ℕ} (h : 4 ≤ i + j) :
    block (G := G) (H := H) i j = ⊥
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_iff.mpr ((block_le_grade i j).trans (le_of_eq (grade_eq_bot_of_four_le h)))

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_pureLeft_pureLeft
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨x, rfl⟩ y ⟨y, rfl⟩
  change ⁅DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) i (mapLayer inl i x),
    DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) j (mapLayer inl j y)⁆ ∈ _
  rw [bracket_lof hi hj, ← mapLayer_bracketLayer]
  exact ⟨bracketLayer hi hj x y, rfl⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_pureRight_pureRight
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨x, rfl⟩ y ⟨y, rfl⟩
  change ⁅DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) i (mapLayer inr i x),
    DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) j (mapLayer inr j y)⁆ ∈ _
  rw [bracket_lof hi hj, ← mapLayer_bracketLayer]
  exact ⟨bracketLayer hi hj x y, rfl⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_pureLeft_pureRight
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨x, rfl⟩ y ⟨y, rfl⟩
  change ⁅DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) i (mapLayer inl i x),
    DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) j (mapLayer inr j y)⁆ ∈ _
  rw [bracket_lof hi hj]
  exact ⟨x ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] y, rfl⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_swap_le
statement:
private theorem bracket_swap_le
    {A B C : Submodule (ZMod 3) (GradedModule (Coproduct G H))}
    (h : Submodule.map₂ bracketLinear A B ≤ C) :
    Submodule.map₂ bracketLinear B A ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
  intro x hx y hy
  change ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ C
  rw [← lie_skew]
  exact C.neg_mem (h (Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ hy hx))

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inl
statement:
theorem bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inl (a c : Layer G 1) (b : Layer H 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) (a ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] b)) (mapLayer inl 1 c) =
      mixedMap (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
        (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) c a ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedMap_tmul, mixedMap_tmul, mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 1) (j := 1)]
  exact (bracketLayer_triple_cyclic _ _ _).trans (bracketLayer_triple_cyclic _ _ _)

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inr
statement:
theorem bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inr (a : Layer G 1) (b c : Layer H 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) (a ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] b)) (mapLayer inr 1 c) =
      -mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide)
        (a ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) b c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedMap_tmul, mixedMap_tmul, mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 1) (j := 1),
    bracketLayer_one_two, neg_neg]
  exact bracketLayer_triple_cyclic _ _ _

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_mixed_pureLeft
statement:
private theorem bracket_mixed_pureLeft :
    Submodule.map₂ bracketLinear (mixedBlock (G := G) (H := H) (i := 1) (j := 1)
      (by decide) (by decide)) (pureLeftBlock 1) ≤
      mixedBlock (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨t, rfl⟩ y ⟨z, rfl⟩
  change ⁅DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) 2 (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) t),
    DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) 1 (mapLayer inl 1 z)⁆ ∈ _
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    rw [bracket_lof (by decide) (by decide), bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inl]
    exact ⟨bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) z x ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] y, rfl⟩
  | add a b ha hb => simpa only [map_add, add_lie] using Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_mixed_pureRight
statement:
private theorem bracket_mixed_pureRight :
    Submodule.map₂ bracketLinear (mixedBlock (G := G) (H := H) (i := 1) (j := 1)
      (by decide) (by decide)) (pureRightBlock 1) ≤
      mixedBlock (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨t, rfl⟩ y ⟨z, rfl⟩
  change ⁅DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) 2 (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) t),
    DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer (Coproduct G H)) 1 (mapLayer inr 1 z)⁆ ∈ _
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    rw [bracket_lof (by decide) (by decide), bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inr, map_neg]
    apply Submodule.neg_mem
    exact ⟨x ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) y z, rfl⟩
  | add a b ha hb => simpa only [map_add, add_lie] using Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_block_le
statement:
theorem bracket_block_le (i j k l : ℕ) :
    Submodule.map₂ bracketLinear (block (G := G) (H := H) i j) (block k l) ≤
      block (i + k) (j + l)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i + j = 0
  · have hi : i = 0 := by omega
    have hj : j = 0 := by omega
    subst i
    subst j
    rw [block_zero_zero, Submodule.map₂_bot_left]
    exact bot_le
  by_cases hkl : k + l = 0
  · have hk : k = 0 := by omega
    have hl : l = 0 := by omega
    subst k
    subst l
    rw [block_zero_zero, Submodule.map₂_bot_right]
    exact bot_le
  by_cases hhigh : 4 ≤ i + j + (k + l)
  · have hg : Submodule.map₂ bracketLinear (block (G := G) (H := H) i j) (block k l) ≤
        grade (Coproduct G H) (i + j + (k + l)) := by
      apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
      intro x hx y hy
      exact SetLike.GradedBracket.bracket_mem (block_le_grade i j hx) (block_le_grade k l hy)
    rw [grade_eq_bot_of_four_le hhigh] at hg
    exact hg.trans bot_le
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst j
    have hi : 0 < i := by omega
    by_cases hl : l = 0
    · subst l
      simpa only [block_zero_right, add_zero] using
        bracket_pureLeft_pureLeft (G := G) (H := H) hi (by omega : 0 < k)
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      have hlp : 0 < l := by omega
      simpa only [block_zero_right, block_zero_left, add_zero, zero_add, block_of_pos hi hlp] using
        bracket_pureLeft_pureRight (G := G) (H := H) hi hlp
    have h : i = 1 ∧ k = 1 ∧ l = 1 := by omega
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact bracket_swap_le bracket_mixed_pureLeft
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    have hjp : 0 < j := by omega
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      simpa only [block_zero_left, zero_add] using
        bracket_pureRight_pureRight (G := G) (H := H) hjp (by omega : 0 < l)
    by_cases hl : l = 0
    · subst l
      have hkp : 0 < k := by omega
      simpa only [block_zero_right, block_zero_left, add_zero, zero_add, block_of_pos hkp hjp] using
        bracket_swap_le (bracket_pureLeft_pureRight (G := G) (H := H) hkp hjp)
    have h : j = 1 ∧ k = 1 ∧ l = 1 := by omega
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact bracket_swap_le bracket_mixed_pureRight
  by_cases hl : l = 0
  · subst l
    have h : i = 1 ∧ j = 1 ∧ k = 1 := by omega
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact bracket_mixed_pureLeft
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    have h : i = 1 ∧ j = 1 ∧ l = 1 := by omega
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact bracket_mixed_pureRight
  omega

name: T3.Coproduct.bracket_mem_block
statement:
theorem bracket_mem_block {i j k l : ℕ} {x y : GradedModule (Coproduct G H)}
    (hx : x ∈ block i j) (hy : y ∈ block k l) : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ block (i + k) (j + l)
proof:
:=
  bracket_block_le i j k l (Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ hx hy)

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.exists_nonzero_layerOne
statement: theorem exists_nonzero_layerOne [Nontrivial G] : ∃ a : Layer G 1, a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hderived : commutator G ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    have hbot : (⊥ : Subgroup G) = ⊤ :=
      eq_top_of_sup_commutator_eq_top Fact.out (by simpa only [bot_sup_eq] using h)
    exact bot_ne_top hbot
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : G, a ∉ commutator G := by
    by_contra h
    apply hderived
    apply top_unique
    intro a _
    by_contra ha
    exact h ⟨a, ha⟩
  exact ⟨mk G 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩, fun h => ha ((mk_eq_zero G 1 _).mp h)⟩

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.upperCentralSeries_two_le_commutator_of_triple_bracket
statement:
theorem upperCentralSeries_two_le_commutator_of_triple_bracket
    (hsep : ∀ a : Layer G 1, a ≠ 0 → ∃ b c : Layer G 1,
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
        (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) a b) c ≠ 0) :
    Subgroup.upperCentralSeries G 2 ≤ commutator G
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  by_contra hnot
  have hform : mk G 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hnot ((mk_eq_zero G 1 _).mp h)
  obtain ⟨b, c, hbc⟩ := hsep _ hform
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 b
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 c
  have hab : ⁅a, (b : G)⁆ ∈ Subgroup.center G := by
    simpa only [Subgroup.upperCentralSeries_one] using
      (Subgroup.mem_upperCentralSeries_succ_iff.mp ha) (b : G)
  have habc : ⁅⁅a, (b : G)⁆, (c : G)⁆ = 1 :=
    commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm.mpr ((Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp hab) c).symm
  apply hbc
  rw [bracketLayer_mk, bracketLayer_mk, mk_eq_zero]
  change ⁅⁅a, (b : G)⁆, (c : G)⁆ ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries 3
  rw [habc]
  exact Subgroup.one_mem _

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.center_le_lowerCentralSeries_two_of_bracket
statement:
theorem center_le_lowerCentralSeries_two_of_bracket
    (hsecond : Subgroup.upperCentralSeries G 2 ≤ commutator G)
    (hsep : ∀ a : Layer G 2, a ≠ 0 → ∃ b : Layer G 1,
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) a b ≠ 0) :
    Subgroup.center G ≤ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries 2
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  have ha' : a ∈ Subgroup.upperCentralSeries G 1 := by
    simpa only [Subgroup.upperCentralSeries_one] using ha
  have haD : a ∈ commutator G :=
    hsecond (Subgroup.upperCentralSeries_mono G (by decide : 1 ≤ 2) ha')
  by_contra hnot
  have hform : mk G 2 ⟨a, haD⟩ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hnot ((mk_eq_zero G 2 _).mp h)
  obtain ⟨b, hab⟩ := hsep _ hform
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 b
  have hab' : ⁅a, (b : G)⁆ = 1 :=
    commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm.mpr ((Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp ha) b).symm
  apply hab
  rw [bracketLayer_mk, mk_eq_zero]
  change ⁅a, (b : G)⁆ ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries 3
  rw [hab']
  exact Subgroup.one_mem _

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.centralSeriesCoincide_of_bracket_separation
statement:
theorem centralSeriesCoincide_of_bracket_separation
    (hone : ∀ a : Layer G 1, a ≠ 0 → ∃ b c : Layer G 1,
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
        (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) a b) c ≠ 0)
    (htwo : ∀ a : Layer G 2, a ≠ 0 → ∃ b : Layer G 1,
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) a b ≠ 0) : CentralSeriesCoincide G
proof:
:= by
  have hsecond := upperCentralSeries_two_le_commutator_of_triple_bracket hone
  exact (centralSeriesCoincide_iff Fact.out).mpr
    ⟨le_antisymm (commutator_le_upperCentralSeries_two Fact.out) hsecond,
      le_antisymm (lowerCentralSeries_two_le_center Fact.out)
        (center_le_lowerCentralSeries_two_of_bracket hsecond htwo)⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.centralSeriesCoincide_freeTwo
statement: theorem centralSeriesCoincide_freeTwo : CentralSeriesCoincide (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2)))
proof:
:=
  AssociatedGraded.centralSeriesCoincide_of_bracket_separation
    FreeTwoSeparation.exists_triple_bracket_ne_zero FreeTwoSeparation.exists_bracket_ne_zero

name: T3.Coproduct.freeTwo_stabilization
statement:
theorem freeTwo_stabilization :
    IsStrict (inl (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 2))).range ∧
      CentralSeriesCoincide (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨isStrict_inl, centralSeriesCoincide_freeTwo⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_fst_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLayer_fst_inl (n : ℕ) (x : Layer G n) :
    mapLayer (fst (H := H) Fact.out) n (mapLayer inl n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, fst_comp_inl, mapLayer_id]
  rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_fst_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLayer_fst_inr (n : ℕ) (x : Layer H n) :
    mapLayer (fst (G := G) Fact.out) n (mapLayer inr n x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, fst_comp_inr, mapLayer_one]
  rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_snd_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLayer_snd_inl (n : ℕ) (x : Layer G n) :
    mapLayer (snd (H := H) Fact.out) n (mapLayer inl n x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, snd_comp_inl, mapLayer_one]
  rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_snd_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLayer_snd_inr (n : ℕ) (x : Layer H n) :
    mapLayer (snd (G := G) Fact.out) n (mapLayer inr n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, snd_comp_inr, mapLayer_id]
  rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.factorMap_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorMap_inl (n : ℕ) (x : Layer G n) :
    factorMap n (x, (0 : Layer H n)) = mapLayer inl n x
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorMap]

name: T3.Coproduct.factorMap_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorMap_inr (n : ℕ) (x : Layer H n) :
    factorMap n ((0 : Layer G n), x) = mapLayer inr n x
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorMap]

name: T3.Coproduct.factorProjection_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorProjection_inl (n : ℕ) (x : Layer G n) :
    factorProjection n (mapLayer (inl (H := H)) n x) = (x, 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorProjection]

name: T3.Coproduct.factorProjection_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorProjection_inr (n : ℕ) (x : Layer H n) :
    factorProjection n (mapLayer (inr (G := G)) n x) = (0, x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorProjection]

name: T3.Coproduct.factorProjection_factorMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorProjection_factorMap (n : ℕ) (x : Layer G n × Layer H n) :
    factorProjection n (factorMap n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorMap, factorProjection]

name: T3.Coproduct.factorMap_injective
statement: theorem factorMap_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (factorMap (G := G) (H := H) n)
proof:
:=
  (show Function.LeftInverse (factorProjection n) (factorMap (G := G) (H := H) n) from
    factorProjection_factorMap n).injective

name: T3.Coproduct.factorMap_one_factorProjection
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorMap_one_factorProjection (x : Layer (Coproduct G H) 1) :
    factorMap 1 (factorProjection 1 x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let e := (factorMap (G := G) (H := H) 1).comp (factorProjection 1)
  let h : MulLayer (Coproduct G H) 1 →* MulLayer (Coproduct G H) 1 :=
    MonoidHom.toAdditive.symm e.toAddMonoidHom
  have hh : h.comp (quotientOne (Coproduct G H)) = quotientOne (Coproduct G H) := by
    apply hom_ext
    · intro a
      exact congrArg Additive.toMul
        (show factorMap 1 (factorProjection 1 (mapLayer (inl (H := H)) 1
          (mk G 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩))) =
            mapLayer inl 1 (mk G 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩) by
              rw [factorProjection_inl, factorMap_inl])
    · intro a
      exact congrArg Additive.toMul
        (show factorMap 1 (factorProjection 1 (mapLayer (inr (G := G)) 1
          (mk H 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩))) =
            mapLayer inr 1 (mk H 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩) by
              rw [factorProjection_inr, factorMap_inr])
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective (Coproduct G H) 1 x
  exact congrArg Additive.ofMul (DFunLike.congr_fun hh (a : Coproduct G H))

name: T3.Coproduct.layerOneEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem layerOneEquiv_apply (x : Layer G 1 × Layer H 1) :
    layerOneEquiv x = mapLayer inl 1 x.1 + mapLayer inr 1 x.2
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.layerOneEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem layerOneEquiv_symm_apply (x : Layer (Coproduct G H) 1) :
    layerOneEquiv.symm x = (mapLayer (fst Fact.out) 1 x, mapLayer (snd Fact.out) 1 x)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.isStrict_inl
statement: theorem isStrict_inl : IsStrict (inl (G := G) (H := H)).range
proof:
:=
  isStrict_range_of_leftInverse inl (fst Fact.out) rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.isStrict_inr
statement: theorem isStrict_inr : IsStrict (inr (G := G) (H := H)).range
proof:
:=
  isStrict_range_of_leftInverse inr (snd Fact.out) rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.mixedMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mixedMap_tmul {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j)
    (x : Layer G i) (y : Layer H j) :
    mixedMap hi hj (x ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] y) =
      bracketLayer hi hj (mapLayer inl i x) (mapLayer inr j y)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.layerTwoMap_apply
statement:
theorem layerTwoMap_apply (x : LayerTwoBlocks (G := G) (H := H)) :
    layerTwoMap x = mapLayer inl 2 x.1 +
      (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) x.2.1 + mapLayer inr 2 x.2.2)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.layerThreeMap_apply
statement:
theorem layerThreeMap_apply (x : LayerThreeBlocks (G := G) (H := H)) :
    layerThreeMap x = mapLayer inl 3 x.1 +
      (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) x.2.1 +
        (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) x.2.2.1 + mapLayer inr 3 x.2.2.2))
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.factorProjection_comp_mixedMap
statement:
theorem factorProjection_comp_mixedMap {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) :
    (factorProjection (G := G) (H := H) (i + j)).comp (mixedMap hi hj) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro x y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, mixedMap_tmul, factorProjection, LinearMap.prod_apply,
    Function.prod_apply, mapLayer_bracketLayer, mapLayer_fst_inl, mapLayer_fst_inr,
    mapLayer_snd_inl, mapLayer_snd_inr, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, Prod.zero_eq_mk]

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_map_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLayer_map_inl (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') (n : ℕ) (x : Layer G n) :
    mapLayer (map f g) n (mapLayer inl n x) = mapLayer inl n (mapLayer f n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, map_comp_inl, mapLayer_comp]
  rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_map_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLayer_map_inr (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') (n : ℕ) (x : Layer H n) :
    mapLayer (map f g) n (mapLayer inr n x) = mapLayer inr n (mapLayer g n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, map_comp_inr, mapLayer_comp]
  rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_factorMap
statement:
theorem mapLayer_factorMap (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') (n : ℕ)
    (x : Layer G n × Layer H n) :
    mapLayer (map f g) n (factorMap n x) =
      factorMap n (mapLayer f n x.1, mapLayer g n x.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorMap]

name: T3.Coproduct.layerOneEquiv_natural
statement:
theorem layerOneEquiv_natural (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') (x : Layer G 1 × Layer H 1) :
    mapLayer (map f g) 1 (layerOneEquiv x) =
      layerOneEquiv (mapLayer f 1 x.1, mapLayer g 1 x.2)
proof:
:=
  mapLayer_factorMap f g 1 x

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_comp_mixedMap
statement:
theorem mapLayer_comp_mixedMap (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) :
    (mapLayer (map f g) (i + j)).comp (mixedMap hi hj) =
      (mixedMap hi hj).comp (TensorProduct.map (mapLayer f i) (mapLayer g j))
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro x y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, mixedMap_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    mapLayer_bracketLayer, mapLayer_map_inl, mapLayer_map_inr]

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_mixedMap
statement:
theorem mapLayer_mixedMap (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) (x : Layer G i ⊗[ZMod 3] Layer H j) :
    mapLayer (map f g) (i + j) (mixedMap hi hj x) =
      mixedMap hi hj (TensorProduct.map (mapLayer f i) (mapLayer g j) x)
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (mapLayer_comp_mixedMap f g hi hj) x

name: T3.Coproduct.layerTwoMap_natural
statement:
theorem layerTwoMap_natural (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H')
    (x : LayerTwoBlocks (G := G) (H := H)) :
    mapLayer (map f g) 2 (layerTwoMap x) = layerTwoMap
      (mapLayer f 2 x.1, TensorProduct.map (mapLayer f 1) (mapLayer g 1) x.2.1,
        mapLayer g 2 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [layerTwoMap_apply, map_add, mapLayer_map_inl, mapLayer_map_inr,
    mapLayer_mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 1)]

name: T3.Coproduct.layerThreeMap_natural
statement:
theorem layerThreeMap_natural (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H')
    (x : LayerThreeBlocks (G := G) (H := H)) :
    mapLayer (map f g) 3 (layerThreeMap x) = layerThreeMap
      (mapLayer f 3 x.1, TensorProduct.map (mapLayer f 2) (mapLayer g 1) x.2.1,
        TensorProduct.map (mapLayer f 1) (mapLayer g 2) x.2.2.1, mapLayer g 3 x.2.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [layerThreeMap_apply, map_add, mapLayer_map_inl, mapLayer_map_inr,
    mapLayer_mixedMap (i := 2) (j := 1), mapLayer_mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2)]

name: T3.Coproduct.pow_three
statement: theorem pow_three (g : Coproduct G H) : g ^ 3 = 1
proof: := powerQuotient_hasExponent g

name: T3.Coproduct.lift_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_inl (hK : HasExponentThree K) (f : G →* K) (g : H →* K) (x : G) :
    lift hK f g (inl x) = f x
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.lift_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_inr (hK : HasExponentThree K) (f : G →* K) (g : H →* K) (x : H) :
    lift hK f g (inr x) = g x
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {f g : Coproduct G H →* K}
    (hl : ∀ x, f (inl x) = g (inl x)) (hr : ∀ x, f (inr x) = g (inr x)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have heq : f.comp powerQuotientMk = g.comp powerQuotientMk :=
    Monoid.Coprod.hom_ext (MonoidHom.ext hl) (MonoidHom.ext hr)
  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := powerQuotientMk_surjective x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq x

name: T3.Coproduct.fst_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_inl (hG : HasExponentThree G) (x : G) : fst hG (inl (H := H) x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.snd_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_inr (hH : HasExponentThree H) (x : H) : snd hH (inr (G := G) x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.fst_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_inr (hG : HasExponentThree G) (x : H) : fst hG (inr x) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.snd_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_inl (hH : HasExponentThree H) (x : G) : snd hH (inl x) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.fst_comp_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_comp_inl (hG : HasExponentThree G) :
    (fst (H := H) hG).comp inl = MonoidHom.id G
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.fst_comp_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_comp_inr (hG : HasExponentThree G) : (fst hG).comp (inr (H := H)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.snd_comp_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_comp_inl (hH : HasExponentThree H) : (snd hH).comp (inl (G := G)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.snd_comp_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_comp_inr (hH : HasExponentThree H) :
    (snd (G := G) hH).comp inr = MonoidHom.id H
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.map_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_inl (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') (x : G) : map f g (inl x) = inl (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.map_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_inr (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') (x : H) : map f g (inr x) = inr (g x)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.map_comp_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp_inl (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') :
    (map f g).comp inl = inl.comp f
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.map_comp_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp_inr (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') :
    (map f g).comp inr = inr.comp g
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (MonoidHom.id G) (MonoidHom.id H) = MonoidHom.id (Coproduct G H)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)

name: T3.Coproduct.map_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp (f : G →* G') (g : H →* H') (f' : G' →* G'') (g' : H' →* H'') :
    map (f'.comp f) (g'.comp g) = (map f' g').comp (map f g)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)

name: T3.Coproduct.inl_injective
statement:
theorem inl_injective (hG : HasExponentThree G) :
    Function.Injective (inl : G → Coproduct G H)
proof:
:=
  (show Function.LeftInverse (fst hG) inl from fst_inl hG).injective

name: T3.Coproduct.inr_injective
statement:
theorem inr_injective (hH : HasExponentThree H) :
    Function.Injective (inr : H → Coproduct G H)
proof:
:=
  (show Function.LeftInverse (snd hH) inr from snd_inr hH).injective

name: T3.Free.sumToCoproduct_of_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sumToCoproduct_of_inl (x : X) :
    sumToCoproduct (of (Sum.inl x : X ⊕ Y)) = Coproduct.inl (of x)
proof: := lift_of _ _ _

name: T3.Free.sumToCoproduct_of_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sumToCoproduct_of_inr (y : Y) :
    sumToCoproduct (of (Sum.inr y : X ⊕ Y)) = Coproduct.inr (of y)
proof: := lift_of _ _ _

name: T3.Coproduct.layerTwoBlockMap_surjective
statement:
theorem layerTwoBlockMap_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Surjective (layerTwoBlockMap f g)
proof:
:=
  (mapLayer_surjective f hf 2).prodMap
    ((TensorProduct.map_surjective (mapLayer_surjective f hf 1)
      (mapLayer_surjective g hg 1)).prodMap (mapLayer_surjective g hg 2))

name: T3.Coproduct.layerThreeBlockMap_surjective
statement:
theorem layerThreeBlockMap_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Surjective (layerThreeBlockMap f g)
proof:
:=
  (mapLayer_surjective f hf 3).prodMap
    ((TensorProduct.map_surjective (mapLayer_surjective f hf 2)
      (mapLayer_surjective g hg 1)).prodMap
        ((TensorProduct.map_surjective (mapLayer_surjective f hf 1)
          (mapLayer_surjective g hg 2)).prodMap (mapLayer_surjective g hg 3)))

name: T3.Coproduct.layerTwoBlockMap_ker
statement:
theorem layerTwoBlockMap_ker (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hKf : f.ker ≤ commutator G) (hKg : g.ker ≤ commutator H) :
    (layerTwoBlockMap f g).ker =
      (subgroupImage f.ker 2).prod ((⊥ : Submodule (ZMod 3)
        (Layer G 1 ⊗[ZMod 3] Layer H 1)).prod (subgroupImage g.ker 2))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [layerTwoBlockMap, LinearMap.ker_prodMap,
    TensorProduct.map_ker_eq_map₂ _ _ (mapLayer_surjective f hf 1) (mapLayer_surjective g hg 1),
    mapLayer_ker f hf, mapLayer_ker g hg,
    subgroupImage_eq_bot_of_le 1 hKf, subgroupImage_eq_bot_of_le 1 hKg,
    Submodule.map₂_bot_left, Submodule.map₂_bot_right, sup_idem]

name: T3.Coproduct.layerThreeBlockMap_ker
statement:
theorem layerThreeBlockMap_ker (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hKf : f.ker ≤ commutator G) (hKg : g.ker ≤ commutator H) :
    (layerThreeBlockMap f g).ker =
      (subgroupImage f.ker 3).prod
        ((Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk (ZMod 3) (Layer G 2) (Layer H 1))
          (subgroupImage f.ker 2) ⊤).prod
          ((Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk (ZMod 3) (Layer G 1) (Layer H 2))
            ⊤ (subgroupImage g.ker 2)).prod (subgroupImage g.ker 3)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [layerThreeBlockMap, LinearMap.ker_prodMap,
    TensorProduct.map_ker_eq_map₂ _ _ (mapLayer_surjective f hf 2) (mapLayer_surjective g hg 1),
    TensorProduct.map_ker_eq_map₂ _ _ (mapLayer_surjective f hf 1) (mapLayer_surjective g hg 2),
    mapLayer_ker f hf, mapLayer_ker g hg,
    subgroupImage_eq_bot_of_le 1 hKf, subgroupImage_eq_bot_of_le 1 hKg,
    Submodule.map₂_bot_left, Submodule.map₂_bot_right, sup_bot_eq, bot_sup_eq]

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerEquiv_comp_inl
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext (freeSumLayerEquiv_inl n)

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerEquiv_comp_inr
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext (freeSumLayerEquiv_inr n)

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_map₂
statement:
private theorem freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_map₂ {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j)
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 3) (Layer (Free I) i))
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 3) (Layer (Free J) j)) :
    (Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk (ZMod 3) (Layer (Free I) i) (Layer (Free J) j)) A B).map
        ((freeSumLayerEquiv (i + j)).toLinearMap.comp (mixedMap hi hj)) =
      Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer hi hj)
        (A.map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) i))
        (B.map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_map₂, Submodule.map₂_map_map]
  congr 1
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  exact freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_tmul hi hj x y

name: T3.Coproduct.layerTwoBlockMap_ker_map_freeSum
statement:
theorem layerTwoBlockMap_ker_map_freeSum (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g) (hKf : f.ker ≤ commutator (Free I))
    (hKg : g.ker ≤ commutator (Free J)) :
    (layerTwoBlockMap f g).ker.map freeSumLayerTwoMap =
      subgroupImage (Presentation.relationKernel f.ker g.ker) 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [layerTwoBlockMap_ker f g hf hg hKf hKg,
    freeSumLayerTwoMap, layerTwoMap, LinearMap.comp_coprod, LinearMap.comp_coprod,
    LinearMap.coprod_map_prod, LinearMap.coprod_map_prod,
    freeSumLayerEquiv_comp_inl, freeSumLayerEquiv_comp_inr, Submodule.map_bot, bot_sup_eq,
    Presentation.subgroupImage_relationKernel_two f.ker g.ker hKf hKg]

name: T3.Coproduct.layerThreeBlockMap_ker_map_freeSum
statement:
theorem layerThreeBlockMap_ker_map_freeSum (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g) (hKf : f.ker ≤ commutator (Free I))
    (hKg : g.ker ≤ commutator (Free J)) :
    (layerThreeBlockMap f g).ker.map freeSumLayerThreeMap =
      subgroupImage (Presentation.relationKernel f.ker g.ker) 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [layerThreeBlockMap_ker f g hf hg hKf hKg,
    freeSumLayerThreeMap, layerThreeMap,
    LinearMap.comp_coprod, LinearMap.comp_coprod, LinearMap.comp_coprod,
    LinearMap.coprod_map_prod, LinearMap.coprod_map_prod, LinearMap.coprod_map_prod,
    freeSumLayerEquiv_comp_inl, freeSumLayerEquiv_comp_inr,
    freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_map₂ (i := 2) (j := 1),
    freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_map₂ (i := 1) (j := 2),
    Submodule.map_top, Submodule.map_top,
    Presentation.subgroupImage_relationKernel_three_eq_four_blocks f.ker g.ker hKf hKg]
  ac_rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.presentationMap_comp_coproductToSum
statement:
theorem presentationMap_comp_coproductToSum :
    (Presentation.presentationMap f g).comp Free.coproductToSum = map f g
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  · intro x
    exact Presentation.presentationMap_map_inl f g x
  · intro x
    exact Presentation.presentationMap_map_inr f g x

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerTwoMap_quotient_square
statement:
theorem freeSumLayerTwoMap_quotient_square :
    (mapLayer (Presentation.presentationMap f g) 2).comp freeSumLayerTwoMap =
      layerTwoMap.comp (layerTwoBlockMap f g)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change mapLayer (Presentation.presentationMap f g) 2
    (mapLayer Free.coproductToSum 2 (layerTwoMap x)) = _
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, presentationMap_comp_coproductToSum]
  exact layerTwoMap_natural f g x

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerThreeMap_quotient_square
statement:
theorem freeSumLayerThreeMap_quotient_square :
    (mapLayer (Presentation.presentationMap f g) 3).comp freeSumLayerThreeMap =
      layerThreeMap.comp (layerThreeBlockMap f g)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change mapLayer (Presentation.presentationMap f g) 3
    (mapLayer Free.coproductToSum 3 (layerThreeMap x)) = _
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, presentationMap_comp_coproductToSum]
  exact layerThreeMap_natural f g x

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketLayer_subgroupImage_top_le
statement:
theorem bracketLayer_subgroupImage_top_le (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) :
    Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer hi hj) (subgroupImage K i) ⊤ ≤ subgroupImage K (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
  intro x hx y _
  obtain ⟨x, hxK, rfl⟩ := (mem_subgroupImage K i x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G j y
  exact (mem_subgroupImage K (i + j) _).mpr
    ⟨termCommutator hi hj x y,
      Subgroup.commutator_le_left K ⊤
        (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator hxK (Subgroup.mem_top _)), rfl⟩

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketLayer_map_subgroupImage_range_le
statement:
theorem bracketLayer_map_subgroupImage_range_le (f : G →* H) (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) :
    Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer hi hj) ((subgroupImage K i).map (mapLayer f i))
      (LinearMap.range (mapLayer f j)) ≤ (subgroupImage K (i + j)).map (mapLayer f (i + j))
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ y ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rw [← mapLayer_bracketLayer]
  exact Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, bracketLayer_subgroupImage_top_le K hi hj
    (Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ hx Submodule.mem_top), rfl⟩

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.map₂_bracketLayer_one_two
statement:
theorem map₂_bracketLayer_one_two (A : Submodule (ZMod 3) (Layer G 1))
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 3) (Layer G 2)) :
    Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)) A B =
      Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)) B A
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [bracketLayer_one_two]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ hy hx)
  · apply Submodule.map₂_le.mpr
    intro y hy x hx
    rw [← neg_neg (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) y x), ← bracketLayer_one_two]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ hx hy)

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.freeProjectionLeft_map_inl
statement:

theorem freeProjectionLeft_map_inl (x : Free I) :

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.freeProjectionLeft_map_inr

theorem freeProjectionRight_map_inl (x : Free I) :
    freeProjectionRight (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J) x) = 1

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.freeProjectionRight_map_inr
statement:

theorem freeProjectionRight_map_inr (x : Free J) :

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.freeProjectionLeft_comp_map_inl

theorem freeProjectionLeft_comp_map_inl :
    (freeProjectionLeft (I := I) (J := J)).comp (Free.map Sum.inl) = MonoidHom.id _

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.freeProjectionRight_comp_map_inr

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.subgroupImage_map_inl
statement:
theorem subgroupImage_map_inl (K : Subgroup (Free I)) (n : ℕ) :
    subgroupImage (K.map (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J))) n =
      (subgroupImage K n).map (mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inl) n)
proof:
:=
  subgroupImage_map_of_leftInverse _ freeProjectionLeft freeProjectionLeft_comp_map_inl K n

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.subgroupImage_map_inr
statement:
theorem subgroupImage_map_inr (K : Subgroup (Free J)) (n : ℕ) :
    subgroupImage (K.map (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J))) n =
      (subgroupImage K n).map (mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inr) n)
proof:
:=
  subgroupImage_map_of_leftInverse _ freeProjectionRight freeProjectionRight_comp_map_inr K n

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.mapLayer_inl_projection_add_inr_projection
statement:
theorem mapLayer_inl_projection_add_inr_projection (x : Layer (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1) :
    mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inl) 1 (mapLayer freeProjectionLeft 1 x) +
      mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inr) 1 (mapLayer freeProjectionRight 1 x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let e : Layer (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1 →ₗ[ZMod 3] Layer (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1 :=
    (mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inl) 1).comp (mapLayer freeProjectionLeft 1) +
      (mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inr) 1).comp (mapLayer freeProjectionRight 1)
  let q : Free (I ⊕ J) →* MulLayer (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1 :=
    (QuotientGroup.mk' (relation (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1)).comp
      (Subgroup.topEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom)
  let h : MulLayer (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1 →* MulLayer (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1 :=
    MonoidHom.toAdditive.symm e.toAddMonoidHom
  have hh : h.comp q = q := by
    apply Free.hom_ext
    intro a
    apply Additive.ofMul.injective
    change e (mk _ 1 ⟨Free.of a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩) =
      mk _ 1 ⟨Free.of a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
    cases a <;>
      simp [e, mapLayer_mk, termMap, freeProjectionLeft, freeProjectionRight, liftFree]
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1 x
  exact congrArg Additive.ofMul (DFunLike.congr_fun hh (a : Free (I ⊕ J)))

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.range_mapLayer_inl_sup_range_mapLayer_inr_one
statement:
theorem range_mapLayer_inl_sup_range_mapLayer_inr_one :
    LinearMap.range (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 1) ⊔
      LinearMap.range (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 1) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  rw [← mapLayer_inl_projection_add_inr_projection x]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _)
    (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _)

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.subgroupImage_relationSubgroup_eq_sup_map
statement:
theorem subgroupImage_relationSubgroup_eq_sup_map (h₀ : K₀ ≤ commutator (Free I))
    (h₁ : K₁ ≤ commutator (Free J)) (n : ℕ) :
    subgroupImage (relationSubgroup K₀ K₁) n =
      (subgroupImage K₀ n).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) n) ⊔
        (subgroupImage K₁ n).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [subgroupImage_relationSubgroup K₀ K₁ h₀ h₁ n,
    subgroupImage_map_inl, subgroupImage_map_inr]

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.subgroupImage_relationKernel_one
statement:
theorem subgroupImage_relationKernel_one (h₀ : K₀ ≤ commutator (Free I))
    (h₁ : K₁ ≤ commutator (Free J)) : subgroupImage (relationKernel K₀ K₁) 1 = ⊥
proof:
:=
  subgroupImage_eq_bot_of_le 1 (relationKernel_le_commutator K₀ K₁ h₀ h₁)

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.subgroupImage_relationKernel_two
statement:
theorem subgroupImage_relationKernel_two (h₀ : K₀ ≤ commutator (Free I))
    (h₁ : K₁ ≤ commutator (Free J)) :
    subgroupImage (relationKernel K₀ K₁) 2 =
      (subgroupImage K₀ 2).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 2) ⊔
        (subgroupImage K₁ 2).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [relationKernel, subgroupImage_normalClosure_two
    (relationSubgroup_le_commutator K₀ K₁ h₀ h₁),
    subgroupImage_relationSubgroup_eq_sup_map K₀ K₁ h₀ h₁]

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.subgroupImage_relationKernel_three
statement:
theorem subgroupImage_relationKernel_three (h₀ : K₀ ≤ commutator (Free I))
    (h₁ : K₁ ≤ commutator (Free J)) :
    subgroupImage (relationKernel K₀ K₁) 3 =
      ((subgroupImage K₀ 3).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 3) ⊔
        (subgroupImage K₁ 3).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 3)) ⊔
      Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide))
        ((subgroupImage K₀ 2).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 2) ⊔
          (subgroupImage K₁ 2).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 2)) ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [relationKernel, subgroupImage_normalClosure_three
    (relationSubgroup_le_commutator K₀ K₁ h₀ h₁),
    subgroupImage_relationSubgroup_eq_sup_map K₀ K₁ h₀ h₁,
    subgroupImage_relationSubgroup_eq_sup_map K₀ K₁ h₀ h₁]

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.bracketLayer_inl_relation_le
statement:
theorem bracketLayer_inl_relation_le [K₀.Normal] :
    Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide))
      ((subgroupImage K₀ 2).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 2))
      (LinearMap.range (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 1)) ≤
        (subgroupImage K₀ 3).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 3)
proof:
:=
  bracketLayer_map_subgroupImage_range_le _ K₀ (by decide) (by decide)

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.bracketLayer_inr_relation_le
statement:
theorem bracketLayer_inr_relation_le [K₁.Normal] :
    Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide))
      ((subgroupImage K₁ 2).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 2))
      (LinearMap.range (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 1)) ≤
        (subgroupImage K₁ 3).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 3)
proof:
:=
  bracketLayer_map_subgroupImage_range_le _ K₁ (by decide) (by decide)

name: T3.Coproduct.Presentation.subgroupImage_relationKernel_three_eq_four_blocks
statement:
theorem subgroupImage_relationKernel_three_eq_four_blocks [K₀.Normal] [K₁.Normal]
    (h₀ : K₀ ≤ commutator (Free I)) (h₁ : K₁ ≤ commutator (Free J)) :
    subgroupImage (relationKernel K₀ K₁) 3 =
      (subgroupImage K₀ 3).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 3) ⊔
      Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide))
        ((subgroupImage K₀ 2).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 2))
        (LinearMap.range (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 1)) ⊔
      Submodule.map₂ (bracketLayer (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide))
        (LinearMap.range (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 1))
        ((subgroupImage K₁ 2).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 2)) ⊔
      (subgroupImage K₁ 3).map (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 3)

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.x_ne_zero
statement: theorem x_ne_zero : x ≠ 0
proof: := Free.layerOneBasis.ne_zero 0

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.y_ne_zero
statement: theorem y_ne_zero : y ≠ 0
proof: := Free.layerOneBasis.ne_zero 1

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.q_eq_basis
statement: theorem q_eq_basis : q = Free.layerTwoBasis (⟨0, 1, by decide⟩ : IncreasingPair (Fin 2))
proof:
:=
  (Free.layerTwoBasis_eq_bracket ⟨0, 1, by decide⟩).symm

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.q_ne_zero
statement: theorem q_ne_zero : q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_eq_basis]
  exact Free.layerTwoBasis.ne_zero _

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.layerThree_subsingleton
statement: theorem layerThree_subsingleton : Subsingleton (Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 3)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsEmpty (IncreasingTriple (Fin 2)) := ⟨fun t => by
    have h₁ := t.first_lt_second
    have h₂ := t.second_lt_third
    have h₃ := t.third.isLt
    simp only [Fin.lt_def] at h₁ h₂
    omega⟩
  exact ⟨fun a b => Free.layerThreeEquiv.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.eq_repr_smul
statement:
theorem eq_repr_smul (β : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) :
    β = Free.layerOneBasis.repr β 0 • x + Free.layerOneBasis.repr β 1 • y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_two, x, y] using (Free.layerOneBasis.sum_repr β).symm

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.bracket_y
statement:
theorem bracket_y (β : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) :
    bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) β y = Free.layerOneBasis.repr β 0 • q
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [eq_repr_smul β]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    bracketLayer_one_self, smul_zero, add_zero, q]

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.bracket_x
statement:
theorem bracket_x (β : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) :
    bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) β x = - (Free.layerOneBasis.repr β 1 • q)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [eq_repr_smul β]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    bracketLayer_one_self, smul_zero, zero_add]
  rw [bracketLayer_one_swap y x]
  simp only [q, smul_neg]

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.exists_bracket_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_bracket_ne_zero (β : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1, (w = x ∨ w = y) ∧
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) β w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₀ : Free.layerOneBasis.repr β 0 = 0
  · have h₁ : Free.layerOneBasis.repr β 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h₁
      apply hβ
      rw [eq_repr_smul β, h₀, h₁, zero_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
    refine ⟨x, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [bracket_x, neg_ne_zero]
    exact smul_ne_zero h₁ q_ne_zero
  · refine ⟨y, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [bracket_y]
    exact smul_ne_zero h₀ q_ne_zero

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwo.exists_tensor_eq
statement:
theorem exists_tensor_eq (t : V ⊗[ZMod 3] Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) :
    ∃ α α' : V, t = α ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] x + α' ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] y
proof:
:= by
  let e := TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight (M := V) (Free.layerOneBasis (I := Fin 2))
  refine ⟨e t 0, e t 1, ?_⟩
  have h := e.symm_apply_apply t
  change e.symm (e t) = t at h
  rw [TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight_symm_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_fintype (e t) _ (fun i =>
      TensorProduct.zero_tmul V (Free.layerOneBasis i)), Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
  exact h.symm

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem freeSumLayerEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (x : Layer (Coproduct (Free I) (Free J)) n) :
    freeSumLayerEquiv n x = mapLayer Free.coproductToSum n x
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freeSumLayerEquiv_inl (n : ℕ) (x : Layer (Free I) n) :
    freeSumLayerEquiv n (mapLayer (inl (H := Free J)) n x) =
      mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) n x
proof:
:= by
  have h : Free.coproductToSum.comp (inl (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) =
      Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J) := rfl
  rw [freeSumLayerEquiv_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp]
  rw [h]

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freeSumLayerEquiv_inr (n : ℕ) (x : Layer (Free J) n) :
    freeSumLayerEquiv n (mapLayer (inr (G := Free I)) n x) =
      mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) n x
proof:
:= by
  have h : Free.coproductToSum.comp (inr (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) =
      Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J) := rfl
  rw [freeSumLayerEquiv_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp]
  rw [h]

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_tmul
statement:
theorem freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_tmul {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j)
    (x : Layer (Free I) i) (y : Layer (Free J) j) :
    freeSumLayerEquiv (i + j) (mixedMap hi hj (x ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] y)) =
      bracketLayer hi hj (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) i x)
        (mapLayer (Free.map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) j y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedMap_tmul, freeSumLayerEquiv_apply, mapLayer_bracketLayer]
  change bracketLayer hi hj (freeSumLayerEquiv i (mapLayer inl i x))
    (freeSumLayerEquiv j (mapLayer inr j y)) = _
  rw [freeSumLayerEquiv_inl, freeSumLayerEquiv_inr]

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerTwoMap_apply
statement:
theorem freeSumLayerTwoMap_apply (x : LayerTwoBlocks (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) :
    freeSumLayerTwoMap x = mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inl) 2 x.1 +
      (freeSumLayerEquiv 2 (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) x.2.1) +
        mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inr) 2 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [freeSumLayerTwoMap, layerTwoMap_apply]

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerThreeMap_apply
statement:
theorem freeSumLayerThreeMap_apply (x : LayerThreeBlocks (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) :
    freeSumLayerThreeMap x = mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inl) 3 x.1 +
      (freeSumLayerEquiv 3 (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) x.2.1) +
        (freeSumLayerEquiv 3 (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) x.2.2.1) +
          mapLayer (Free.map Sum.inr) 3 x.2.2.2))
proof:
:= by
  simp [freeSumLayerThreeMap, layerThreeMap_apply]

name: T3.Coproduct.oneEquiv_symm_freeFirstEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem oneEquiv_symm_freeFirstEquiv (x : Layer (Free I) 1) :
    (exteriorPower.oneEquiv (ZMod 3) V).symm (freeFirstEquiv b x) = Free.sigmaOne b x
proof:
:=
  (exteriorPower.oneEquiv (ZMod 3) V).symm_apply_apply _

name: T3.Coproduct.freeTwoBlocksEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem freeTwoBlocksEquiv_apply (x : LayerTwoBlocks (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) :
    freeTwoBlocksEquiv b c x =
      (Free.sigmaTwo b x.1, TensorProduct.congr (freeFirstEquiv b) (freeFirstEquiv c) x.2.1,
        Free.sigmaTwo c x.2.2)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.freeThreeBlocksEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem freeThreeBlocksEquiv_apply (x : LayerThreeBlocks (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) :
    freeThreeBlocksEquiv b c x =
      (Free.sigmaThree b x.1,
        TensorProduct.congr (Free.sigmaTwo b) (freeFirstEquiv c) x.2.1,
        -TensorProduct.congr (freeFirstEquiv b) (Free.sigmaTwo c) x.2.2.1,
        Free.sigmaThree c x.2.2.2)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.sigmaTwo_freeSum_mixedMap
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_freeSum_mixedMap (z : Layer (Free I) 1 ⊗[ZMod 3] Layer (Free J) 1) :
    Free.sigmaTwo (b.prod c)
      (freeSumLayerEquiv 2 (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) z)) =
      ExteriorLowDegree.mixedTwoMap (ZMod 3) V W
        (TensorProduct.congr (freeFirstEquiv b) (freeFirstEquiv c) z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Free.sigmaTwo (b.prod c)).toLinearMap.comp
      ((freeSumLayerEquiv 2).toLinearMap.comp
        (mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide))) =
        (ExteriorLowDegree.mixedTwoMap (ZMod 3) V W).comp
          (TensorProduct.congr (freeFirstEquiv b) (freeFirstEquiv c)).toLinearMap := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro x y
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_tmul (i := 1) (j := 1),
      Free.sigmaTwo_bracket_factors, TensorProduct.congr_tmul,
      ExteriorLowDegree.mixedTwoMap_tmul, oneEquiv_symm_freeFirstEquiv]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

name: T3.Coproduct.sigmaThree_freeSum_mixedMap_two_one
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_freeSum_mixedMap_two_one
    (z : Layer (Free I) 2 ⊗[ZMod 3] Layer (Free J) 1) :
    Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c)
      (freeSumLayerEquiv 3 (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) z)) =
      ExteriorLowDegree.mixedTwoOneMap (ZMod 3) V W
        (TensorProduct.congr (Free.sigmaTwo b) (freeFirstEquiv c) z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c)).toLinearMap.comp
      ((freeSumLayerEquiv 3).toLinearMap.comp
        (mixedMap (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide))) =
        (ExteriorLowDegree.mixedTwoOneMap (ZMod 3) V W).comp
          (TensorProduct.congr (Free.sigmaTwo b) (freeFirstEquiv c)).toLinearMap := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro x y
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_tmul (i := 2) (j := 1),
      Free.sigmaThree_bracket_factors_two_one, TensorProduct.congr_tmul,
      ExteriorLowDegree.mixedTwoOneMap_tmul, oneEquiv_symm_freeFirstEquiv]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

name: T3.Coproduct.sigmaThree_freeSum_mixedMap_one_two
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_freeSum_mixedMap_one_two
    (z : Layer (Free I) 1 ⊗[ZMod 3] Layer (Free J) 2) :
    Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c)
      (freeSumLayerEquiv 3 (mixedMap (by decide) (by decide) z)) =
      -ExteriorLowDegree.mixedOneTwoMap (ZMod 3) V W
        (TensorProduct.congr (freeFirstEquiv b) (Free.sigmaTwo c) z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c)).toLinearMap.comp
      ((freeSumLayerEquiv 3).toLinearMap.comp
        (mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide))) =
        -((ExteriorLowDegree.mixedOneTwoMap (ZMod 3) V W).comp
          (TensorProduct.congr (freeFirstEquiv b) (Free.sigmaTwo c)).toLinearMap) := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro x y
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.neg_apply,
      freeSumLayerEquiv_mixedMap_tmul (i := 1) (j := 2), Free.sigmaThree_bracket_factors_one_two,
      TensorProduct.congr_tmul, ExteriorLowDegree.mixedOneTwoMap_tmul,
      oneEquiv_symm_freeFirstEquiv]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h z

name: T3.Coproduct.sigmaTwo_freeSumLayerTwoMap
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_freeSumLayerTwoMap (x : LayerTwoBlocks (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) :
    Free.sigmaTwo (b.prod c) (freeSumLayerTwoMap x) =
      ExteriorLowDegree.twoMap (ZMod 3) V W (freeTwoBlocksEquiv b c x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [freeSumLayerTwoMap_apply, map_add, Free.sigmaTwo_map_inl,
    Free.sigmaTwo_map_inr, sigmaTwo_freeSum_mixedMap, freeTwoBlocksEquiv_apply,
    ExteriorLowDegree.twoMap, LinearMap.coprod_apply]

name: T3.Coproduct.sigmaThree_freeSumLayerThreeMap
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_freeSumLayerThreeMap (x : LayerThreeBlocks (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) :
    Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c) (freeSumLayerThreeMap x) =
      ExteriorLowDegree.threeMap (ZMod 3) V W (freeThreeBlocksEquiv b c x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [freeSumLayerThreeMap_apply, map_add, Free.sigmaThree_map_inl,
    Free.sigmaThree_map_inr, sigmaThree_freeSum_mixedMap_two_one,
    sigmaThree_freeSum_mixedMap_one_two, freeThreeBlocksEquiv_apply,
    ExteriorLowDegree.threeMap, LinearMap.coprod_apply, map_neg]

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerTwoMap_bijective
statement:
theorem freeSumLayerTwoMap_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (freeSumLayerTwoMap (I := I) (J := J))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let : LinearOrder J := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let : LinearOrder (I ⊕ J) := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let : AddCommGroup (ZMod 3) := (ZMod.commRing 3).toAddCommGroup
  let b : Basis I (ZMod 3) (I →₀ ZMod 3) := Finsupp.basisSingleOne
  let c : Basis J (ZMod 3) (J →₀ ZMod 3) := Finsupp.basisSingleOne
  have he : (Free.sigmaTwo (b.prod c)) ∘ freeSumLayerTwoMap =
      (ExteriorLowDegree.twoEquiv b c) ∘ freeTwoBlocksEquiv b c := by
    funext x
    change Free.sigmaTwo (b.prod c) (freeSumLayerTwoMap x) = _
    rw [sigmaTwo_freeSumLayerTwoMap]
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (ExteriorLowDegree.twoEquiv_toLinearMap b c) _).symm
  have h : Function.Bijective ((Free.sigmaTwo (b.prod c)) ∘ freeSumLayerTwoMap) := by
    rw [he]
    exact (ExteriorLowDegree.twoEquiv b c).bijective.comp (freeTwoBlocksEquiv b c).bijective
  exact h.of_comp_left (Free.sigmaTwo (b.prod c)).injective

name: T3.Coproduct.freeSumLayerThreeMap_bijective
statement:
theorem freeSumLayerThreeMap_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (freeSumLayerThreeMap (I := I) (J := J))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let : LinearOrder J := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let : LinearOrder (I ⊕ J) := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let : AddCommGroup (ZMod 3) := (ZMod.commRing 3).toAddCommGroup
  let b : Basis I (ZMod 3) (I →₀ ZMod 3) := Finsupp.basisSingleOne
  let c : Basis J (ZMod 3) (J →₀ ZMod 3) := Finsupp.basisSingleOne
  have he : (Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c)) ∘ freeSumLayerThreeMap =
      (ExteriorLowDegree.threeEquiv b c) ∘ freeThreeBlocksEquiv b c := by
    funext x
    change Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c) (freeSumLayerThreeMap x) = _
    rw [sigmaThree_freeSumLayerThreeMap]
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (ExteriorLowDegree.threeEquiv_toLinearMap b c) _).symm
  have h : Function.Bijective ((Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c)) ∘ freeSumLayerThreeMap) := by
    rw [he]
    exact (ExteriorLowDegree.threeEquiv b c).bijective.comp (freeThreeBlocksEquiv b c).bijective
  exact h.of_comp_left (Free.sigmaThree (b.prod c)).injective

name: T3.Coproduct.layerTwoMap_bijective_free
statement:
theorem layerTwoMap_bijective_free :
    Function.Bijective (layerTwoMap (G := Free I) (H := Free J))

:=
  Function.Bijective.of_comp_left (f := freeSumLayerEquiv 2)

name: T3.Coproduct.freeLayerTwoEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freeLayerTwoEquiv_apply (x : LayerTwoBlocks (G := Free I) (H := Free J)) :

proof: := rfl

name: T3.Coproduct.freeLayerThreeEquiv_apply
statement:

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwoSeparation.bracket_inr_inr
statement:
private theorem bracket_inr_inr (β : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 2)
    (w : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (mapLayer (inr (G := G)) 2 β) (mapLayer inr 1 w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1)]
  have h : bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) β w = 0 :=
    FreeTwo.layerThree_subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [h, map_zero]

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwoSeparation.bracket_inr_inl
statement:
private theorem bracket_inr_inl (β : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 2) (g : Layer G 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (mapLayer inr 2 β) (mapLayer inl 1 g) =
      -mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide) (g ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedMap_tmul, bracketLayer_one_two, neg_neg]

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwoSeparation.mixed_one_two_tmul_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun z : Layer (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2))) 3 =>
    ((layerThreeEquiv (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 2))).symm z).2.2.1) h
  exact TensorProduct.tmul_ne_zero hg hβ (by simpa using he)

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwoSeparation.triple_sum_inr_inr
statement:
private theorem triple_sum_inr_inr (α : Layer G 1) (β u v : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (bracketLayer (i := 1) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
        (mapLayer inl 1 α + mapLayer inr 1 β) (mapLayer inr 1 u)) (mapLayer inr 1 v) =
      -mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide)
        (α ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) u v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ← mixedMap_tmul (i := 1) (j := 1),
    ← mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 1) (j := 1), map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
    bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inr, bracket_inr_inr, add_zero]

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwoSeparation.triple_inr_inl_inr
statement:
private theorem triple_inr_inl_inr (β w : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) (g : Layer G 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (bracketLayer (i := 1) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
        (mapLayer inr 1 β) (mapLayer inl 1 g)) (mapLayer inr 1 w) =
      mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide)
        (g ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) β w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracketLayer_one_swap, ← mixedMap_tmul (i := 1) (j := 1), map_neg,
    LinearMap.neg_apply, bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inr, neg_neg]

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwoSeparation.exists_triple_bracket_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_triple_bracket_ne_zero [Nontrivial G]
    (a : Layer (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2))) 1) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ b c : Layer (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2))) 1,
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
        (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) a b) c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨α, β⟩, rfl⟩ := (layerOneEquiv (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 2))).surjective a
  simp only [layerOneEquiv_apply] at ha ⊢
  by_cases hα : α = 0
  · have hβ : β ≠ 0 := by
      intro hβ
      exact ha (by simp [hα, hβ])
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_nonzero_layerOne (G := G)
    obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := FreeTwo.exists_bracket_ne_zero β hβ
    refine ⟨mapLayer inl 1 g, mapLayer inr 1 w, ?_⟩
    simp only [hα, map_zero, zero_add]
    rw [triple_inr_inl_inr β w g]
    exact mixed_one_two_tmul_ne_zero hg hw
  · refine ⟨mapLayer inr 1 FreeTwo.x, mapLayer inr 1 FreeTwo.y, ?_⟩
    rw [triple_sum_inr_inr, neg_ne_zero]
    exact mixed_one_two_tmul_ne_zero hα FreeTwo.q_ne_zero

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwoSeparation.bracket_two_inr
statement:
private theorem bracket_two_inr (α₂ : Layer G 2) (α₁ α₁' : Layer G 1)
    (β₂ : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 2) (w : Layer (Free (Fin 2)) 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (layerTwoEquiv (α₂, α₁ ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] FreeTwo.x + α₁' ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] FreeTwo.y, β₂))
      (mapLayer inr 1 w) =
      mixedMap (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide) (α₂ ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] w) +
        (-mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide)
          (α₁ ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) FreeTwo.x w) +
        -mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide)
          (α₁' ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) FreeTwo.y w))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [layerTwoEquiv_apply, layerTwoMap_apply, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  rw [← mixedMap_tmul (i := 2) (j := 1), bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inr,
    bracket_mixedMap_tmul_inr, bracket_inr_inr, add_zero]

name: T3.Coproduct.FreeTwoSeparation.exists_bracket_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_bracket_ne_zero [Nontrivial G]
    (a : Layer (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2))) 2) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ b : Layer (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2))) 1,
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) a b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨α₂, t, β₂⟩, rfl⟩ := (layerTwoEquiv (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 2))).surjective a
  obtain ⟨α₁, α₁', rfl⟩ := FreeTwo.exists_tensor_eq t
  by_cases hα₂ : α₂ = 0
  · by_cases hα₁ : α₁ = 0
    · by_cases hα₁' : α₁' = 0
      · have hβ₂ : β₂ ≠ 0 := by
          intro hβ₂
          apply ha
          simp [hα₂, hα₁, hα₁', hβ₂, layerTwoMap_apply]
        obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_nonzero_layerOne (G := G)
        refine ⟨mapLayer inl 1 g, ?_⟩
        simp only [hα₂, hα₁, hα₁', TensorProduct.zero_tmul, add_zero,
          layerTwoEquiv_apply, layerTwoMap_apply, map_zero, zero_add]
        rw [bracket_inr_inl, neg_ne_zero]
        exact mixed_one_two_tmul_ne_zero hg hβ₂
      · refine ⟨mapLayer inr 1 FreeTwo.x, ?_⟩
        rw [bracket_two_inr]
        simp only [hα₂, hα₁, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, neg_zero, zero_add]
        rw [bracketLayer_one_swap FreeTwo.y FreeTwo.x, TensorProduct.tmul_neg,
          map_neg, neg_neg]
        exact mixed_one_two_tmul_ne_zero hα₁' FreeTwo.q_ne_zero
    · refine ⟨mapLayer inr 1 FreeTwo.y, ?_⟩
      rw [bracket_two_inr]
      simp only [hα₂, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, zero_add, bracketLayer_one_self,
        TensorProduct.tmul_zero, neg_zero, add_zero, neg_ne_zero]
      exact mixed_one_two_tmul_ne_zero hα₁ FreeTwo.q_ne_zero
  · refine ⟨mapLayer inr 1 FreeTwo.x, ?_⟩
    rw [bracket_two_inr]
    intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun z : Layer (Coproduct G (Free (Fin 2))) 3 =>
      ((layerThreeEquiv (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 2))).symm z).2.1) h
    exact TensorProduct.tmul_ne_zero hα₂ FreeTwo.x_ne_zero (by simpa using he)

name: T3.Coproduct.layerTwoBlockMap_injective
statement:
theorem layerTwoBlockMap_injective (hf : ∀ n, Function.Injective (mapLayer f n))
    (hg : ∀ n, Function.Injective (mapLayer g n)) :
    Function.Injective (layerTwoBlockMap f g)
proof:
:=
  (hf 2).prodMap ((TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat _ _ (hf 1) (hg 1)).prodMap (hg 2))

name: T3.Coproduct.layerThreeBlockMap_injective
statement:
theorem layerThreeBlockMap_injective (hf : ∀ n, Function.Injective (mapLayer f n))
    (hg : ∀ n, Function.Injective (mapLayer g n)) :
    Function.Injective (layerThreeBlockMap f g)
proof:
:=
  (hf 3).prodMap ((TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat _ _ (hf 2) (hg 1)).prodMap
    ((TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat _ _ (hf 1) (hg 2)).prodMap (hg 3)))

name: T3.Coproduct.mapLayer_map_injective
statement:
theorem mapLayer_map_injective (hf : ∀ n, Function.Injective (mapLayer f n))
    (hg : ∀ n, Function.Injective (mapLayer g n)) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (mapLayer (map f g) n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : 4 ≤ n
  · let := layer_subsingleton_of_four_le (G := Coproduct G H) Fact.out hn
    exact fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hn' : n ≤ 3 := by omega
  interval_cases n
  · exact fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (layerOneEquiv (G := G) (H := H)).surjective x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (layerOneEquiv (G := G) (H := H)).surjective y
    apply congrArg (layerOneEquiv (G := G) (H := H))
    apply (hf 1).prodMap (hg 1)
    apply (layerOneEquiv (G := G') (H := H')).injective
    simpa only [layerOneEquiv_natural, Prod.map] using hxy
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (layerTwoMap_bijective (G := G) (H := H)).surjective x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (layerTwoMap_bijective (G := G) (H := H)).surjective y
    apply congrArg (layerTwoMap (G := G) (H := H))
    apply layerTwoBlockMap_injective f g hf hg
    apply (layerTwoMap_bijective (G := G') (H := H')).injective
    simpa only [layerTwoMap_natural, layerTwoBlockMap, LinearMap.coe_prodMap, Prod.map] using hxy
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (layerThreeMap_bijective (G := G) (H := H)).surjective x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (layerThreeMap_bijective (G := G) (H := H)).surjective y
    apply congrArg (layerThreeMap (G := G) (H := H))
    apply layerThreeBlockMap_injective f g hf hg
    apply (layerThreeMap_bijective (G := G') (H := H')).injective
    simpa only [layerThreeMap_natural, layerThreeBlockMap, LinearMap.coe_prodMap, Prod.map]
      using hxy

name: T3.Coproduct.map_injective_of_mapLayer_injective
statement:
theorem map_injective_of_mapLayer_injective (hf : ∀ n, Function.Injective (mapLayer f n))
    (hg : ∀ n, Function.Injective (mapLayer g n)) : Function.Injective (map f g)
proof:
:=
  injective_of_mapAdd_injective Fact.out _ (mapLayer_map_injective f g hf hg)

name: T3.Coproduct.map_injective_of_strict
statement:
theorem map_injective_of_strict (D : Subgroup G) (hD : IsStrict D) :
    Function.Injective (map D.subtype (MonoidHom.id B))
proof:
:= by
  have hG : HasExponentThree G := Fact.out
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree D) := ⟨fun x => Subtype.ext (hG x)⟩
  have hgraded : Function.Injective (AssociatedGraded.map D.subtype) :=
    (map_injective_iff_isStrict D.subtype D.subtype_injective).mpr (by simpa using hD)
  apply map_injective_of_mapLayer_injective D.subtype (MonoidHom.id B)
    ((map_injective_iff D.subtype).mp hgraded)
  intro n
  rw [mapLayer_id]
  exact Function.injective_id

name: T3.CentralRootRelations.relator_mem_center
statement: theorem relator_mem_center (i : I) : relator S z w i ∈ Subgroup.center (G × K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
  intro a
  exact Prod.ext (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp ((Subgroup.center G).inv_mem (hz i)) a.1)
    (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (hS (w i).property) a.2)

name: T3.CentralRootRelations.normalClosure_eq_closure
statement:
theorem normalClosure_eq_closure :
    Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range (relator S z w)) =
      Subgroup.closure (Set.range (relator S z w))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (relator S z w)) ≤ Subgroup.center _ :=
    (Subgroup.closure_le _).2 (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact relator_mem_center S hS z hz w i)
  have : (Subgroup.closure (Set.range (relator S z w))).Normal := by
    constructor
    intro a ha g
    rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (hc ha) g, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
    exact ha
  exact le_antisymm (Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal Subgroup.subset_closure)
    Subgroup.closure_le_normalClosure

name: T3.CentralRootRelations.exists_relationWord
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [normalClosure_eq_closure S hS z hz w] at ha
  induction ha using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
    refine ⟨Pi.single i 1, ?_⟩
    simp [relationWord, Pi.single_apply, bundledRelator]
  | one => exact ⟨0, by simp [relationWord]⟩
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨m + k, ?_⟩
    simp only [relationWord, Pi.add_apply, zpow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Subgroup.coe_mul]
  | inv a _ ha =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ha
    refine ⟨-m, ?_⟩
    simp only [relationWord, Pi.neg_apply, zpow_neg, Finset.prod_inv_distrib, Subgroup.coe_inv]

name: T3.CentralRootRelations.coordinate_relationWord
statement:
theorem coordinate_relationWord [DecidableEq I] (c : I → S →* Multiplicative (ZMod 3))
    (hc : ∀ i j, c i (w j) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (if i = j then 1 else 0))
    (m : I → ℤ) (i : I) :
    c i (projection S (relationWord S hS z hz w m)) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (m i : ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : AddCommGroup (ZMod 3) := (ZMod.commRing 3).toAddCommGroup
  change ((c i).comp (projection S)) (relationWord S hS z hz w m) = _
  rw [relationWord, map_prod]
  simp only [map_zpow, MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  have hproj (j : I) : projection S (bundledRelator S hS z hz w j) = w j := rfl
  simp only [hproj, hc]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i]
  · simp [← ofAdd_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  · intro b _ hbi
    simp [Ne.symm hbi]
  · simp

name: T3.CentralRootRelations.eq_one_of_inl_mem_normalClosure
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_inl_mem_normalClosure [Finite I] [DecidableEq I]
    (hG : HasExponentThree G) (hK : HasExponentThree K)
    (c : I → S →* Multiplicative (ZMod 3))
    (hc : ∀ i j, c i (w j) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (if i = j then 1 else 0)) {g : G}
    (hg : MonoidHom.inl G K g ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range (relator S z w))) : g = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_relationWord S hS z hz w hg
  have hcoeff (i : I) : (m i : ZMod 3) = 0 := by
    have hp : projection S (relationWord S hS z hz w m) = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg Prod.snd hm
    have hc' := coordinate_relationWord S hS z hz w c hc m i
    rw [hp, map_one] at hc'
    exact ofAdd_eq_one.mp hc'.symm
  have hword : relationWord S hS z hz w m = 1 := by
    apply Finset.prod_eq_one
    intro i _
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (m i) 3).mp (hcoeff i)
    norm_num at hk
    rw [hk, zpow_mul]
    have hcube : bundledRelator S hS z hz w i ^ (3 : ℤ) = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((z i)⁻¹, (w i : K)) ^ (3 : ℤ) = (1 : G × K)
      rw [show (3 : ℤ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, zpow_natCast]
      exact Prod.ext (by change ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 3 = 1; rw [inv_pow, hG (z i), inv_one])
        (hK (w i))
    rw [hcube, one_zpow]
  have h := congrArg Prod.fst hm
  simpa only [hword, Subgroup.coe_one, Prod.fst_one, MonoidHom.inl_apply] using h.symm

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.exists_layer_kernel_basis_representatives
statement:
theorem exists_layer_kernel_basis_representatives (f : G →* H) (k : ℕ)
    [Module.Finite (ZMod 3) (Layer G k)] :
    ∃ d ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod 3) (Layer G k),
      ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin d) (ZMod 3) (mapLayer f k).ker,
      ∃ g : Fin d → term G k,
        (∀ i, mk G k (g i) = (b i : Layer G k)) ∧
        (∀ i, f (g i) ∈ term H (k + 1)) ∧
        (term H (k + 1)).comap f ⊓ term G k =
          term G (k + 1) ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun i => (g i : G))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W := (mapLayer f k).ker
  let d := Module.finrank (ZMod 3) W
  let b := Module.finBasis (ZMod 3) W
  choose g hg using fun i : Fin d => mk_surjective G k (b i : Layer G k)
  have hfg (i : Fin d) : f (g i) ∈ term H (k + 1) := by
    have hi := (b i).property
    change mapLayer f k (b i : Layer G k) = 0 at hi
    rw [← hg i, mapLayer_mk, mk_eq_zero] at hi
    exact hi
  refine ⟨d, Submodule.finrank_le W, b, g, hg, hfg, ?_⟩
  let S := term G (k + 1) ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun i => (g i : G))
  have hspan (w : W) : (w : Layer G k) ∈ subgroupImage S k := by
    have hw : w ∈ Submodule.span (ZMod 3) (Set.range b) := by
      rw [b.span_eq]
      trivial
    induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [← hg i]
      exact (mem_subgroupImage S k _).mpr
        ⟨g i, (show Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun i => (g i : G)) ≤ S from le_sup_right)
          (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩), rfl⟩
    | zero => exact (subgroupImage S k).zero_mem
    | add x y hx hy ihx ihy => exact (subgroupImage S k).add_mem ihx ihy
    | smul c x hx ih => exact (subgroupImage S k).smul_mem c ih
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    let a : term G k := ⟨x, hx.2⟩
    have ha : mk G k a ∈ W := by
      change mapLayer f k (mk G k a) = 0
      rw [mapLayer_mk, mk_eq_zero]
      exact hx.1
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := (mem_subgroupImage S k _).mp (hspan ⟨mk G k a, ha⟩)
    have hxy : (a * y⁻¹ : term G k) ∈ relation G k := by
      change ((a * y⁻¹ : term G k) : G) ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries k
      apply (mk_eq_zero G k _).mp
      change mk G k a + -mk G k y = 0
      rw [he, add_neg_cancel]
    have hxyS : x * (y : G)⁻¹ ∈ S :=
      (show term G (k + 1) ≤ S from le_sup_left) hxy
    have h := S.mul_mem hxyS hy
    simpa using h
  · apply sup_le
    · intro x hx
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (termMap f (k + 1) ⟨x, hx⟩).property
      · exact Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_antitone (⊤ : Subgroup G) (by omega) hx
    · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hfg i, (g i).property⟩

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.exists_derived_defect_generators
statement:
theorem exists_derived_defect_generators [Group.FG G] (f : G →* H) :
    ∃ d ≤ Group.rank G, ∃ g : Fin d → G,
      (∀ i, f (g i) ∈ commutator H) ∧
      (commutator H).comap f = commutator G ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, b, g, _, hg, he⟩ := exists_layer_kernel_basis_representatives f 1
  refine ⟨d, hd.trans finrank_layerOne_le_rank, fun i => g i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [term, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.reduceSub, Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one] using hg
  · simpa only [term, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.reduceSub, Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one,
      Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_zero, inf_top_eq] using he

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.exists_lowerCentral_defect_generators
statement:
theorem exists_lowerCentral_defect_generators [Group.FG G] (f : G →* H)
    (hf : (commutator H).comap f = commutator G) :
    ∃ d ≤ (Group.rank G).choose 2, ∃ g : Fin d → G,
      (∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) ∧ (∀ i, f (g i) ∈ term H 3) ∧
      (term H 3).comap f = term G 3 ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, b, g, _, hg, he⟩ := exists_layer_kernel_basis_representatives f 2
  refine ⟨d, hd.trans finrank_layerTwo_le_rank, fun i => g i, ?_, hg, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact (g i).property
  · have hle : (term H 3).comap f ≤ term G 2 := by
      change (term H 3).comap f ≤ commutator G
      rw [← hf]
      apply Subgroup.comap_mono
      exact Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_antitone (⊤ : Subgroup H) (show 1 ≤ 2 by decide)
    simpa only [inf_eq_left.mpr hle] using he

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.map_le_enlarged
statement: theorem map_le_enlarged (g : Fin 3 → C) : C.map (baseMap g) ≤ enlarged g
proof: := le_sup_left

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.range_freeMap_le_enlarged
statement: theorem range_freeMap_le_enlarged (g : Fin 3 → C) : (freeMap g).range ≤ enlarged g
proof: := le_sup_right

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.newGenerators_card_le
statement: theorem newGenerators_card_le (g : Fin 3 → C) : (newGenerators g).card ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.enlarged_eq_closure
statement:
theorem enlarged_eq_closure (g : Fin 3 → C) :
    enlarged g =
      Subgroup.closure ((C.map (baseMap g) : Set (Extension g)) ∪ ↑(newGenerators g))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [enlarged, Subgroup.closure_union, Subgroup.closure_eq]
  congr 1
  rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← Free.closure_range_of (I := Fin 3),
    MonoidHom.map_closure]
  congr 1
  simp only [newGenerators, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, ← Set.image_univ,
    Set.image_image]
  rfl

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.map_commutator_le_of_range_le
statement:
private theorem map_commutator_le_of_range_le {A B : Type*} [Group A] [Group B]
    (f : A →* B) (S : Subgroup B) (hf : f.range ≤ S) :
    (commutator A).map f ≤ ⁅S, S⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.map_commutator, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mono hf hf

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.map_mem_commutator
statement:
private theorem map_mem_commutator {A B : Type*} [Group A] [Group B]
    (f : A →* B) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ commutator A) : f a ∈ commutator B
proof:
:=
  (termMap f 2 ⟨a, ha⟩).property

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.comap_commutator_quotientMap
statement:
theorem comap_commutator_quotientMap (g : Fin 3 → C)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G) :
    (commutator (Extension g)).comap
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (SharedCommutatorRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))) =
      commutator (SharedCommutatorRoots.Ambient G)
proof:
:= by
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (SharedCommutatorRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))
  have hmap : (commutator (SharedCommutatorRoots.Ambient G)).map q = commutator (Extension g) := by
    rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.map_commutator,
      Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective q (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _), commutator_def]
  change (commutator (Extension g)).comap q = _
  rw [← hmap]
  apply Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self
  change (QuotientGroup.mk' (SharedCommutatorRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))).ker ≤ _
  rw [QuotientGroup.ker_mk']
  exact SharedCommutatorRoots.kernel_le_commutator _ hg

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.root_generator_mem_enlarged
statement:
private theorem root_generator_mem_enlarged (g : Fin 3 → C) (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin 2) :
    SharedCommutatorRoots.generator (fun i => (g i : G)) i j ∈ enlarged g
proof:
:=
  range_freeMap_le_enlarged g ⟨Free.of (SharedCommutatorRoots.index i j), rfl⟩

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.image_defect_le_commutator
statement:
private theorem image_defect_le_commutator (g : Fin 3 → C)
    (hdefect : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) :
    (commutator G).comap C.subtype ≤
      ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆.comap ((baseMap g).comp C.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hdefect]
  apply sup_le
  · apply Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp
    apply map_commutator_le_of_range_le
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact map_le_enlarged g ⟨c, c.property, rfl⟩
  · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change SharedCommutatorRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G)) (g i : G) ∈
      ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆
    rw [SharedCommutatorRoots.baseMap_root]
    exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
      (root_generator_mem_enlarged g i 0) (root_generator_mem_enlarged g i 1)

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.inf_commutator_eq
statement:
theorem inf_commutator_eq (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin 3 → C)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G)
    (hdefect : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) :
    enlarged g ⊓ commutator (Extension g) = ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro a ⟨haD, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, k, hk, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.exists_mul_mul_commutator_of_mem_sup
      (C.map (baseMap g)) (freeMap g).range haD
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hu
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hv
    have hkD : k ∈ ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆ := hk
    have hkH : k ∈ commutator (Extension g) :=
      Subgroup.commutator_mono le_top le_top hkD
    have hprod : baseMap g c * freeMap g w ∈ commutator (Extension g) := by
      have hm := (commutator (Extension g)).mul_mem ha ((commutator _).inv_mem hkH)
      simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_right] using hm
    have hamb : Coproduct.inl c * Coproduct.inr w ∈
        commutator (SharedCommutatorRoots.Ambient G) := by
      rw [← comap_commutator_quotientMap g hg]
