      change (QuotientGroup.mk' (SharedCommutatorRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G))))
        (Coproduct.inl c * Coproduct.inr w) ∈ commutator (Extension g)
      simpa only [baseMap, SharedCommutatorRoots.baseMap, freeMap, MonoidHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
        using hprod
    have hcder : c ∈ commutator G := by
      have hm := map_mem_commutator (Coproduct.fst hG) hamb
      simpa only [map_mul, Coproduct.fst_inl, Coproduct.fst_inr, mul_one] using hm
    have hwder : w ∈ commutator (Free (Fin 3)) := by
      have hm := map_mem_commutator (Coproduct.snd Free.pow_three) hamb
      simpa only [map_mul, Coproduct.snd_inl Free.pow_three c,
        Coproduct.snd_inr Free.pow_three w, one_mul] using hm
    have hcD : baseMap g c ∈ ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆ :=
      image_defect_le_commutator g hdefect (show (⟨c, hc⟩ : C) ∈
        (commutator G).comap C.subtype from hcder)
    have hwD : freeMap g w ∈ ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆ :=
      map_commutator_le_of_range_le (freeMap g) (enlarged g) (range_freeMap_le_enlarged g)
        (Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ hwder)
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hcD hwD) hkD
  · exact le_inf
      ((Subgroup.commutator_le_sup (H₁ := enlarged g) (H₂ := enlarged g)).trans (sup_idem _).le)
      (Subgroup.commutator_mono le_top le_top)

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.hasExponentThree_extension
statement: theorem hasExponentThree_extension (g : Fin 3 → C) : HasExponentThree (Extension g)
proof:
:=
  SharedCommutatorRoots.hasExponentThree_extension _

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.baseMap_injective
statement:
theorem baseMap_injective (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin 3 → C)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G) : Function.Injective (baseMap g)
proof:
:=
  SharedCommutatorRoots.baseMap_injective hG _ hg

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.derived_strict
statement:
theorem derived_strict (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin 3 → C)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G)
    (hdefect : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) :
    (enlarged g).lowerCentralSeries 1 =
      (⊤ : Subgroup (Extension g)).lowerCentralSeries 1 ⊓ enlarged g
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_zero,
    ← commutator_def, inf_comm] using (inf_commutator_eq hG g hg hdefect).symm

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.rank_enlarged_le
statement:
theorem rank_enlarged_le [Group.FG C] (g : Fin 3 → C) :
    Group.rank (enlarged g) ≤ Group.rank C + 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := Group.rank_spec C
  let f := (baseMap g).comp C.subtype
  let S := s.image f
  have hS : Subgroup.closure (↑S : Set (Extension g)) = C.map (baseMap g) := by
    change Subgroup.closure (↑(s.image f) : Set (Extension g)) = _
    rw [Finset.coe_image, ← MonoidHom.map_closure, hs]
    change (⊤ : Subgroup C).map ((baseMap g).comp C.subtype) = _
    rw [← Subgroup.map_map, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map, Subgroup.range_subtype]
  let Z := S ∪ newGenerators g
  have hZ : Subgroup.closure (↑Z : Set (Extension g)) = enlarged g := by
    change Subgroup.closure (↑(S ∪ newGenerators g) : Set (Extension g)) = _
    rw [Finset.coe_union, Subgroup.closure_union, hS, enlarged_eq_closure,
      Subgroup.closure_union, Subgroup.closure_eq]
  calc
    Group.rank (enlarged g) = Group.rank (Subgroup.closure (↑Z : Set (Extension g))) :=
      (Subgroup.rank_congr hZ).symm
    _ ≤ Z.card := Subgroup.rank_closure_finset_le_card _
    _ ≤ S.card + (newGenerators g).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ Group.rank C + 3 := Nat.add_le_add
      (Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq hcard) (newGenerators_card_le g)

name: T3.SharedDerivedStrictification.exists_shared_derived_strictification
statement:
theorem exists_shared_derived_strictification (hG : HasExponentThree G) [Group.FG C]
    (g : Fin 3 → C) (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G)
    (hdefect : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) :
    ∃ (H : Type u) (hH : Group H),
      letI
proof:
:= hH
      HasExponentThree H ∧ ∃ f : G →* H, Function.Injective f ∧
        ∃ (D : Subgroup H) (hD : Group.FG D),
          letI := hD
          C.map f ≤ D ∧ ∃ Y : Finset H, Y.card ≤ 3 ∧
            D = Subgroup.closure ((C.map f : Set H) ∪ ↑Y) ∧
            Group.rank D ≤ Group.rank C + 3 ∧
            D.lowerCentralSeries 1 = (⊤ : Subgroup H).lowerCentralSeries 1 ⊓ D := by
  exact ⟨Extension g, inferInstance, hasExponentThree_extension g, baseMap g,
    baseMap_injective hG g hg, enlarged g, inferInstance, map_le_enlarged g,
    newGenerators g, newGenerators_card_le g, enlarged_eq_closure g,
    rank_enlarged_le g, derived_strict hG g hg hdefect⟩

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.index_lt
statement: private theorem index_lt (i : Fin n) : index i 0 < index i 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [index, Fin.lt_def]

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.pair_injective
statement: private theorem pair_injective : Function.Injective (pair (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have hv := congrArg (fun p => p.first.val) h
  simp only [pair, index, Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero] at hv
  exact Fin.ext (by omega)

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.relator_mem_commutator
statement:
theorem relator_mem_commutator (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) (i : Fin n) :
    relator g i ∈ commutator (Ambient G n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.mul_mem
  · exact (commutator _).inv_mem
      (termMap (Coproduct.inl (H := Free (Fin (2 * n)))) 2 ⟨g i, hg i⟩).property
  · simpa only [witness, map_commutatorElement, _root_.commutator_def] using
      Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
        (Subgroup.mem_top (Coproduct.inr (Free.of (index i 0)) : Ambient G n))
        (Subgroup.mem_top (Coproduct.inr (Free.of (index i 1)) : Ambient G n))

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.relationSubgroup_le_commutator
statement:
theorem relationSubgroup_le_commutator (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) :
    relationSubgroup g ≤ commutator (Ambient G n)
proof:
:=
  (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact relator_mem_commutator g hg i)

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.kernel_eq_sup_commutator
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_sup_commutator (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) :
    kernel g = relationSubgroup g ⊔ ⁅relationSubgroup g, (⊤ : Subgroup (Ambient G n))⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernel, ← Subgroup.normalClosure_closure_eq_normalClosure]
  exact normalClosure_eq_sup_commutator Fact.out (relationSubgroup_le_commutator g hg)

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.kernel_le_commutator
statement:
theorem kernel_le_commutator (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) :
    kernel g ≤ commutator (Ambient G n)
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact relator_mem_commutator g hg i)

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.hasExponentThree_extension
statement: theorem hasExponentThree_extension (g : Fin n → G) : HasExponentThree (Extension g)
proof: := Fact.out

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.baseMap_root
statement:
theorem baseMap_root (g : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    baseMap g (g i) = ⁅generator g i 0, generator g i 1⁆
proof:
:= by
  have h : (QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel g)) (relator g i) = 1 :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  simpa only [relator, witness, map_mul, map_inv, map_commutatorElement, inv_mul_eq_one,
    baseMap, MonoidHom.comp_apply, generator] using h

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.mk_two_derivedBracketHom
statement:
private theorem mk_two_derivedBracketHom {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : commutator A) (h : A) : mk A 2 (derivedBracketHom r h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_eq_zero A 2 _).mpr
  exact commutator_top_le_term_three (le_refl (commutator A))
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator r.property (Subgroup.mem_top h))

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.mk_two_normalWord
statement:
private theorem mk_two_normalWord {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : Fin n → commutator A) (m : Fin n → ℤ) (h : Fin n → A) :
    mk A 2 (normalWord r m h) = ∑ i, (m i : ZMod 3) • mk A 2 (r i)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsMulCommutative (commutator A) := isMulCommutative_commutator Fact.out
  let f : commutator A →* MulLayer A 2 := QuotientGroup.mk' (relation A 2)
  change Additive.ofMul (f (normalWord r m h)) = _
  rw [normalWord, map_prod, ofMul_prod]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [map_mul, map_zpow, ofMul_mul, ofMul_zpow]
  change m i • mk A 2 (r i) + mk A 2 (derivedBracketHom (r i) (h i)) = _
  rw [mk_two_derivedBracketHom, add_zero]
  exact (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul (ZMod 3) (m i) (mk A 2 (r i))).symm

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.freeInitial_linearIndependent
statement: theorem freeInitial_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent (ZMod 3) (freeInitial (n := n))
proof:
:=
  Free.layerTwoBasis.linearIndependent.comp pair pair_injective

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.mapLayer_snd_relator
statement:
private theorem mapLayer_snd_relator (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (i : Fin n) :
    mapLayer (Coproduct.snd (G := G) Free.pow_three) 2
      (mk (Ambient G n) 2 (bundledRelator g hg i)) = freeInitial i
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapLayer_mk (Coproduct.snd (G := G) Free.pow_three) 2 (bundledRelator g hg i),
    freeInitial, Free.layerTwoBasis_apply]
  apply congrArg (mk (Free (Fin (2 * n))) 2)
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Coproduct.snd Free.pow_three (relator g i) = witness i
  simp [relator, Coproduct.snd_inl Free.pow_three (g i),
    Coproduct.snd_inr Free.pow_three (witness i)]

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.coefficients_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coefficients_eq_zero (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) (h : Fin n → Ambient G n) {a : G}
    (ha : (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) m h : Ambient G n) = Coproduct.inl a) :
    ∀ i, (m i : ZMod 3) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : mapLayer (Coproduct.snd (G := G) Free.pow_three) 2
      (mk (Ambient G n) 2 (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) m h)) = 0 := by
    rw [mapLayer_mk (Coproduct.snd (G := G) Free.pow_three) 2
      (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) m h), mk_eq_zero]
    change Coproduct.snd Free.pow_three
      (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) m h : Ambient G n) ∈
        (⊤ : Subgroup (Free (Fin (2 * n)))).lowerCentralSeries 2
    rw [ha, Coproduct.snd_inl Free.pow_three a]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  rw [mk_two_normalWord, map_sum] at hz
  simp only [map_smul, mapLayer_snd_relator] at hz
  exact Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp freeInitial_linearIndependent _ hz

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.normalWord_zero_eq
statement:
private theorem normalWord_zero_eq {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : Fin n → commutator A) (h : Fin n → A) :
    (normalWord r 0 h : A) = (centralWord r h : A)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsMulCommutative (commutator A) := isMulCommutative_commutator Fact.out
  have hle : term A 3 ≤ commutator A :=
    (⊤ : Subgroup A).lowerCentralSeries_antitone (show 1 ≤ 2 by decide)
  have he : Subgroup.inclusion hle (centralWord r h) = normalWord r 0 h := by
    simp only [centralWord, map_prod, normalWord, Pi.zero_apply, zpow_zero, one_mul]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rfl
  exact congrArg Subtype.val he.symm

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.mk_three_centralWord
statement:
private theorem mk_three_centralWord {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : Fin n → commutator A) (h : Fin n → A) :
    mk A 3 (centralWord r h) = ∑ i,
      bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
        (mk A 2 (r i)) (mk A 1 ⟨h i, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩)
proof:
:= by
  unfold centralWord AssociatedGraded.mk
  rw [map_prod, ofMul_prod]
  rfl

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.zpow_eq_one_of_cast_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem zpow_eq_one_of_cast_eq_zero {A : Type*} [Group A]
    [Fact (HasExponentThree A)] (r : A) (m : ℤ) (hm : (m : ZMod 3) = 0) : r ^ m = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd m 3).mp hm
  norm_num at hk
  rw [hk, zpow_mul]
  have hc : r ^ (3 : ℤ) = 1 := by
    change r ^ ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1
    rw [zpow_natCast]
    exact (Fact.out : HasExponentThree A) r
  rw [hc, one_zpow]

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.normalWord_eq_zero_coefficients
statement:
private theorem normalWord_eq_zero_coefficients {A : Type*} [Group A]
    [Fact (HasExponentThree A)] (r : Fin n → commutator A) (m : Fin n → ℤ)
    (h : Fin n → A) (hm : ∀ i, (m i : ZMod 3) = 0) :
    normalWord r m h = normalWord r 0 h
proof:
:= by
  let : IsMulCommutative (commutator A) := isMulCommutative_commutator Fact.out
  unfold normalWord
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have he : r i ^ m i = 1 := Subtype.ext (zpow_eq_one_of_cast_eq_zero (r i : A) (m i) (hm i))
  simp only [he, Pi.zero_apply, zpow_zero, one_mul]

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.sum_tmul_freeInitial_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem sum_tmul_freeInitial_eq_zero {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module (ZMod 3) V] (s : Fin n → V)
    (hz : ∑ i, s i ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] freeInitial i = 0) : ∀ i, s i = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  let e := TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight (M := V)
    (Free.layerTwoBasis (I := Fin (2 * n)))
  have he := congrArg (fun z => e z (pair i)) hz
  simp only [map_sum, map_zero, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at he
  simpa only [e, freeInitial, TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight_apply_tmul_apply,
    Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, pair_injective.eq_iff, ite_smul,
    one_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true] using he

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.zpow_eq_pow_cast
statement:
private theorem zpow_eq_pow_cast {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : A) (m : ℤ) : r ^ m = r ^ (m : ZMod 3).val
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ((m - ((m : ZMod 3).val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod 3) = 0 := by simp
  have he := zpow_eq_one_of_cast_eq_zero r (m - ((m : ZMod 3).val : ℤ)) hz
  rw [zpow_sub, mul_inv_eq_one] at he
  simpa only [zpow_natCast] using he

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.mem_normalClosure_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem mem_normalClosure_singleton_iff {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : commutator A) (a : A) :
    a ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure ({(r : A)} : Set A) ↔
      ∃ m : ZMod 3, ∃ h : A, (r : A) ^ m.val * ⁅(r : A), h⁆ = a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    have hs : Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => (r : A)) = {(r : A)} := by ext; simp
    rw [← hs] at ha
    obtain ⟨m, h, hm⟩ := exists_normalWord (fun _ : Fin 1 => r) ha
    refine ⟨m 0, h 0, ?_⟩
    have he : (normalWord (fun _ : Fin 1 => r) m h : A) =
        (r : A) ^ m 0 * ⁅(r : A), h 0⁆ := by
      simp only [normalWord, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.prod_univ_zero, mul_one]
      rfl
    rw [he, zpow_eq_pow_cast] at hm
    exact hm
  · rintro ⟨m, h, rfl⟩
    have hr : (r : A) ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure ({(r : A)} : Set A) :=
      Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (Set.mem_singleton _)
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.pow_mem _ hr _)
      (Subgroup.commutator_le_left _ _
        (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator hr (Subgroup.mem_top h)))

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.mem_kernel_iff_mul_commutator
statement:
theorem mem_kernel_iff_mul_commutator (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (a : Ambient G n) :
    a ∈ kernel g ↔ ∃ k ∈ relationSubgroup g,
      ∃ p ∈ ⁅relationSubgroup g, (⊤ : Subgroup (Ambient G n))⁆, k * p = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernel, ← Subgroup.normalClosure_closure_eq_normalClosure]
  exact mem_normalClosure_iff_mul_commutator Fact.out (relationSubgroup_le_commutator g hg) a

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.relator_initial
statement:
private theorem relator_initial (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (i : Fin n) :
    mk (Ambient G n) 2 (bundledRelator g hg i) =
      -mapLayer Coproduct.inl 2 (mk G 2 ⟨g i, hg i⟩) +
        mapLayer Coproduct.inr 2 (freeInitial i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeInitial, Free.layerTwoBasis_apply]
  rfl

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.bracket_inr_inl
statement:
private theorem bracket_inr_inl {H : Type*} [Group H] [Fact (HasExponentThree H)]
    (q : Layer H 2) (s : Layer G 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (mapLayer Coproduct.inr 2 q) (mapLayer Coproduct.inl 1 s) =
      -Coproduct.mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide)
        (s ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Coproduct.mixedMap_tmul, bracketLayer_one_two, neg_neg]

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.relator_bracket_blocks
statement:
private theorem relator_bracket_blocks {H : Type*} [Group H] [Fact (HasExponentThree H)]
    (u : Layer G 2) (q : Layer H 2) (s : Layer G 1) (t : Layer H 1) :
    (Coproduct.layerThreeEquiv (G := G) (H := H)).symm
      (bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
        (-mapLayer Coproduct.inl 2 u + mapLayer Coproduct.inr 2 q)
        (mapLayer Coproduct.inl 1 s + mapLayer Coproduct.inr 1 t)) =
      (-bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) u s,
        -(u ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] t), -(s ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] q),
        bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) q t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, map_neg, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply]
  rw [← mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1),
    ← mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1),
    ← Coproduct.mixedMap_tmul (i := 2) (j := 1), bracket_inr_inl]
  simp

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.first_decomposition
proof:
:=
  (Coproduct.layerOneEquiv.apply_symm_apply
    (mk (Ambient G n) 1 ⟨h, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩)).symm

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.centralWord_blocks
statement:
private theorem centralWord_blocks (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (h : Fin n → Ambient G n) :
    (Coproduct.layerThreeEquiv (G := G) (H := Free (Fin (2 * n)))).symm
      (mk (Ambient G n) 3 (centralWord (bundledRelator g hg) h)) =
      ∑ i, (-bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (mk G 2 ⟨g i, hg i⟩) (firstLeft (h i)),
        -(mk G 2 ⟨g i, hg i⟩ ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] firstRight (h i)),
        -(firstLeft (h i) ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] freeInitial i),
        bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (freeInitial i) (firstRight (h i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_three_centralWord, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [relator_initial, first_decomposition]
  exact relator_bracket_blocks _ _ _ _

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.centralWord_eq_one
statement:
theorem centralWord_eq_one (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (h : Fin n → Ambient G n) {a : G}
    (ha : (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) 0 h : Ambient G n) = Coproduct.inl a) :
    a = 1
proof:
:= by
  let c := centralWord (bundledRelator g hg) h
  have hc : (c : Ambient G n) = Coproduct.inl a := (normalWord_zero_eq _ _).symm.trans ha
  have ha3 : a ∈ term G 3 := by
    have hm := (termMap (Coproduct.fst (H := Free (Fin (2 * n))) Fact.out) 3 c).property
    change Coproduct.fst Fact.out (c : Ambient G n) ∈ term G 3 at hm
    simpa only [hc, Coproduct.fst_inl] using hm
  have hmk : mk (Ambient G n) 3 c = mapLayer Coproduct.inl 3 (mk G 3 ⟨a, ha3⟩) := by
    rw [mapLayer_mk]
    apply congrArg (mk (Ambient G n) 3)
    exact Subtype.ext hc
  have he := centralWord_blocks g hg h
  change (Coproduct.layerThreeEquiv (G := G) (H := Free (Fin (2 * n)))).symm
    (mk (Ambient G n) 3 c) = _ at he
  rw [hmk, Coproduct.layerThreeEquiv_symm_inl] at he
  have hmixed := congrArg (fun z : Coproduct.LayerThreeBlocks (G := G) (H := Free (Fin (2 * n))) =>
    z.2.2.1) he
  have hz : ∑ i, firstLeft (h i) ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] freeInitial i = 0 := by
    simpa [Prod.fst_sum, Prod.snd_sum] using hmixed.symm
  have hs : ∀ i, firstLeft (h i) = 0 := sum_tmul_freeInitial_eq_zero _ hz
  have hpure := congrArg
    (fun z : Coproduct.LayerThreeBlocks (G := G) (H := Free (Fin (2 * n))) => z.1) he
  have hzero : mk G 3 ⟨a, ha3⟩ = 0 := by simpa [hs, Prod.fst_sum] using hpure
  have hmem := (mk_eq_zero G 3 ⟨a, ha3⟩).mp hzero
  simpa only [lowerCentralSeries_three_eq_bot Fact.out, Subgroup.mem_bot] using hmem

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel (g : Fin n → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    {a : G} (ha : Coproduct.inl a ∈ kernel g) : a = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, h, he⟩ := exists_normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) ha
  have hm := coefficients_eq_zero g hg m h he
  rw [normalWord_eq_zero_coefficients _ _ _ hm] at he
  exact centralWord_eq_one g hg h he

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.baseMap_ker
statement:
theorem baseMap_ker (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin n → G)
    (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) : (baseMap g).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree G) := ⟨hG⟩
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro a ha
  apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
  apply eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel g hg
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mp ha

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.baseMap_injective
statement:
theorem baseMap_injective (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin n → G)
    (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) : Function.Injective (baseMap g)
proof:
:=
  (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff _).mp (baseMap_ker hG g hg)

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.index_lt
statement: private theorem index_lt (i : Fin 3) : index i 0 < index i 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> decide

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.pair_injective
statement: private theorem pair_injective : Function.Injective pair
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [pair, index, IncreasingPair.ext_iff]

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.relator_mem_commutator
statement:
theorem relator_mem_commutator (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) (i : Fin 3) :
    relator g i ∈ commutator (Ambient G)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.mul_mem
  · exact (commutator _).inv_mem
      (termMap (Coproduct.inl (H := Free (Fin 3))) 2 ⟨g i, hg i⟩).property
  · simpa only [witness, map_commutatorElement, _root_.commutator_def] using
      Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
        (Subgroup.mem_top (Coproduct.inr (Free.of (index i 0)) : Ambient G))
        (Subgroup.mem_top (Coproduct.inr (Free.of (index i 1)) : Ambient G))

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.relationSubgroup_le_commutator
statement:
theorem relationSubgroup_le_commutator (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) :
    relationSubgroup g ≤ commutator (Ambient G)
proof:
:=
  (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact relator_mem_commutator g hg i)

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.kernel_eq_sup_commutator
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_sup_commutator (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) :
    kernel g = relationSubgroup g ⊔ ⁅relationSubgroup g, (⊤ : Subgroup (Ambient G))⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernel, ← Subgroup.normalClosure_closure_eq_normalClosure]
  exact normalClosure_eq_sup_commutator Fact.out (relationSubgroup_le_commutator g hg)

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.kernel_le_commutator
statement:
theorem kernel_le_commutator (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) :
    kernel g ≤ commutator (Ambient G)
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact relator_mem_commutator g hg i)

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.hasExponentThree_extension
statement: theorem hasExponentThree_extension (g : Fin 3 → G) : HasExponentThree (Extension g)
proof: := Fact.out

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.baseMap_root
statement:
theorem baseMap_root (g : Fin 3 → G) (i : Fin 3) :
    baseMap g (g i) = ⁅generator g i 0, generator g i 1⁆
proof:
:= by
  have h : (QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel g)) (relator g i) = 1 :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  simpa only [relator, witness, map_mul, map_inv, map_commutatorElement, inv_mul_eq_one,
    baseMap, MonoidHom.comp_apply, generator] using h

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.mk_two_derivedBracketHom
statement:
private theorem mk_two_derivedBracketHom {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : commutator A) (h : A) : mk A 2 (derivedBracketHom r h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_eq_zero A 2 _).mpr
  exact commutator_top_le_term_three (le_refl (commutator A))
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator r.property (Subgroup.mem_top h))

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.mk_two_normalWord
statement:
private theorem mk_two_normalWord {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : Fin 3 → commutator A) (m : Fin 3 → ℤ) (h : Fin 3 → A) :
    mk A 2 (normalWord r m h) = ∑ i, (m i : ZMod 3) • mk A 2 (r i)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsMulCommutative (commutator A) := isMulCommutative_commutator Fact.out
  let f : commutator A →* MulLayer A 2 := QuotientGroup.mk' (relation A 2)
  change Additive.ofMul (f (normalWord r m h)) = _
  rw [normalWord, map_prod, ofMul_prod]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [map_mul, map_zpow, ofMul_mul, ofMul_zpow]
  change m i • mk A 2 (r i) + mk A 2 (derivedBracketHom (r i) (h i)) = _
  rw [mk_two_derivedBracketHom, add_zero]
  exact (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul (ZMod 3) (m i) (mk A 2 (r i))).symm

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.freeInitial_linearIndependent
statement: theorem freeInitial_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent (ZMod 3) (freeInitial)
proof:
:=
  Free.layerTwoBasis.linearIndependent.comp pair pair_injective

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.mapLayer_snd_relator
statement:
private theorem mapLayer_snd_relator (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    mapLayer (Coproduct.snd (G := G) Free.pow_three) 2
      (mk (Ambient G) 2 (bundledRelator g hg i)) = freeInitial i
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapLayer_mk (Coproduct.snd (G := G) Free.pow_three) 2 (bundledRelator g hg i),
    freeInitial, Free.layerTwoBasis_apply]
  apply congrArg (mk (Free (Fin 3)) 2)
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Coproduct.snd Free.pow_three (relator g i) = witness i
  simp only [relator, map_mul, map_inv, Coproduct.snd_inl Free.pow_three (g i),
    Coproduct.snd_inr Free.pow_three (witness i), inv_one, one_mul]

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.coefficients_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coefficients_eq_zero (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (m : Fin 3 → ℤ) (h : Fin 3 → Ambient G) {a : G}
    (ha : (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) m h : Ambient G) = Coproduct.inl a) :
    ∀ i, (m i : ZMod 3) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : mapLayer (Coproduct.snd (G := G) Free.pow_three) 2
      (mk (Ambient G) 2 (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) m h)) = 0 := by
    rw [mapLayer_mk (Coproduct.snd (G := G) Free.pow_three) 2
      (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) m h), mk_eq_zero]
    change Coproduct.snd Free.pow_three
      (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) m h : Ambient G) ∈
        (⊤ : Subgroup (Free (Fin 3))).lowerCentralSeries 2
    rw [ha, Coproduct.snd_inl Free.pow_three a]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  rw [mk_two_normalWord, map_sum] at hz
  simp only [map_smul, mapLayer_snd_relator] at hz
  exact Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp freeInitial_linearIndependent _ hz

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.normalWord_zero_eq
statement:
private theorem normalWord_zero_eq {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : Fin 3 → commutator A) (h : Fin 3 → A) :
    (normalWord r 0 h : A) = (centralWord r h : A)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsMulCommutative (commutator A) := isMulCommutative_commutator Fact.out
  have hle : term A 3 ≤ commutator A :=
    (⊤ : Subgroup A).lowerCentralSeries_antitone (show 1 ≤ 2 by decide)
  have he : Subgroup.inclusion hle (centralWord r h) = normalWord r 0 h := by
    simp only [centralWord, map_prod, normalWord, Pi.zero_apply, zpow_zero, one_mul]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rfl
  exact congrArg Subtype.val he.symm

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.mk_three_centralWord
statement:
private theorem mk_three_centralWord {A : Type*} [Group A] [Fact (HasExponentThree A)]
    (r : Fin 3 → commutator A) (h : Fin 3 → A) :
    mk A 3 (centralWord r h) = ∑ i,
      bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
        (mk A 2 (r i)) (mk A 1 ⟨h i, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩)
proof:
:= by
  unfold centralWord AssociatedGraded.mk
  rw [map_prod, ofMul_prod]
  rfl

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.zpow_eq_one_of_cast_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem zpow_eq_one_of_cast_eq_zero {A : Type*} [Group A]
    [Fact (HasExponentThree A)] (r : A) (m : ℤ) (hm : (m : ZMod 3) = 0) : r ^ m = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd m 3).mp hm
  norm_num at hk
  rw [hk, zpow_mul]
  have hc : r ^ (3 : ℤ) = 1 := by
    change r ^ ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1
    rw [zpow_natCast]
    exact (Fact.out : HasExponentThree A) r
  rw [hc, one_zpow]

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.normalWord_eq_zero_coefficients
statement:
private theorem normalWord_eq_zero_coefficients {A : Type*} [Group A]
    [Fact (HasExponentThree A)] (r : Fin 3 → commutator A) (m : Fin 3 → ℤ)
    (h : Fin 3 → A) (hm : ∀ i, (m i : ZMod 3) = 0) :
    normalWord r m h = normalWord r 0 h
proof:
:= by
  let : IsMulCommutative (commutator A) := isMulCommutative_commutator Fact.out
  unfold normalWord
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have he : r i ^ m i = 1 := Subtype.ext (zpow_eq_one_of_cast_eq_zero (r i : A) (m i) (hm i))
  simp only [he, Pi.zero_apply, zpow_zero, one_mul]

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.sum_tmul_freeInitial_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem sum_tmul_freeInitial_eq_zero {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module (ZMod 3) V] (s : Fin 3 → V)
    (hz : ∑ i, s i ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] freeInitial i = 0) : ∀ i, s i = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  let e := TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight (M := V)
    (Free.layerTwoBasis (I := Fin 3))
  have he := congrArg (fun z => e z (pair i)) hz
  simp only [map_sum, map_zero, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at he
  simpa only [e, freeInitial, TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight_apply_tmul_apply,
    Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, pair_injective.eq_iff, ite_smul,
    one_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true] using he

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.mem_kernel_iff_mul_commutator
statement:
theorem mem_kernel_iff_mul_commutator (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (a : Ambient G) :
    a ∈ kernel g ↔ ∃ k ∈ relationSubgroup g,
      ∃ p ∈ ⁅relationSubgroup g, (⊤ : Subgroup (Ambient G))⁆, k * p = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernel, ← Subgroup.normalClosure_closure_eq_normalClosure]
  exact mem_normalClosure_iff_mul_commutator Fact.out (relationSubgroup_le_commutator g hg) a

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.relator_initial
statement:
private theorem relator_initial (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    mk (Ambient G) 2 (bundledRelator g hg i) =
      -mapLayer Coproduct.inl 2 (mk G 2 ⟨g i, hg i⟩) +
        mapLayer Coproduct.inr 2 (freeInitial i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeInitial, Free.layerTwoBasis_apply]
  rfl

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.bracket_inr_inl
statement:
private theorem bracket_inr_inl {H : Type*} [Group H] [Fact (HasExponentThree H)]
    (q : Layer H 2) (s : Layer G 1) :
    bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
      (mapLayer Coproduct.inr 2 q) (mapLayer Coproduct.inl 1 s) =
      -Coproduct.mixedMap (i := 1) (j := 2) (by decide) (by decide)
        (s ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Coproduct.mixedMap_tmul, bracketLayer_one_two, neg_neg]

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.relator_bracket_blocks
statement:
private theorem relator_bracket_blocks {H : Type*} [Group H] [Fact (HasExponentThree H)]
    (u : Layer G 2) (q : Layer H 2) (s : Layer G 1) (t : Layer H 1) :
    (Coproduct.layerThreeEquiv (G := G) (H := H)).symm
      (bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)
        (-mapLayer Coproduct.inl 2 u + mapLayer Coproduct.inr 2 q)
        (mapLayer Coproduct.inl 1 s + mapLayer Coproduct.inr 1 t)) =
      (-bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) u s,
        -(u ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] t), -(s ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] q),
        bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) q t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, map_neg, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply]
  rw [← mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1),
    ← mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1),
    ← Coproduct.mixedMap_tmul (i := 2) (j := 1), bracket_inr_inl]
  simp

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.first_decomposition
proof:
:=
  (Coproduct.layerOneEquiv.apply_symm_apply
    (mk (Ambient G) 1 ⟨h, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩)).symm

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.centralWord_blocks
statement:
private theorem centralWord_blocks (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (h : Fin 3 → Ambient G) :
    (Coproduct.layerThreeEquiv (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 3))).symm
      (mk (Ambient G) 3 (centralWord (bundledRelator g hg) h)) =
      ∑ i, (-bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (mk G 2 ⟨g i, hg i⟩) (firstLeft (h i)),
        -(mk G 2 ⟨g i, hg i⟩ ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] firstRight (h i)),
        -(firstLeft (h i) ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] freeInitial i),
        bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (freeInitial i) (firstRight (h i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_three_centralWord, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [relator_initial, first_decomposition]
  exact relator_bracket_blocks _ _ _ _

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.centralWord_eq_one
statement:
theorem centralWord_eq_one (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    (h : Fin 3 → Ambient G) {a : G}
    (ha : (normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) 0 h : Ambient G) = Coproduct.inl a) :
    a = 1
proof:
:= by
  let c := centralWord (bundledRelator g hg) h
  have hc : (c : Ambient G) = Coproduct.inl a := (normalWord_zero_eq _ _).symm.trans ha
  have ha3 : a ∈ term G 3 := by
    have hm := (termMap (Coproduct.fst (H := Free (Fin 3)) Fact.out) 3 c).property
    change Coproduct.fst Fact.out (c : Ambient G) ∈ term G 3 at hm
    simpa only [hc, Coproduct.fst_inl] using hm
  have hmk : mk (Ambient G) 3 c = mapLayer Coproduct.inl 3 (mk G 3 ⟨a, ha3⟩) := by
    rw [mapLayer_mk]
    apply congrArg (mk (Ambient G) 3)
    exact Subtype.ext hc
  have he := centralWord_blocks g hg h
  change (Coproduct.layerThreeEquiv (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 3))).symm
    (mk (Ambient G) 3 c) = _ at he
  rw [hmk, Coproduct.layerThreeEquiv_symm_inl] at he
  have hmixed := congrArg (fun z : Coproduct.LayerThreeBlocks (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 3)) =>
    z.2.2.1) he
  have hz : ∑ i, firstLeft (h i) ⊗ₜ[ZMod 3] freeInitial i = 0 := by
    simpa [Prod.fst_sum, Prod.snd_sum] using hmixed.symm
  have hs : ∀ i, firstLeft (h i) = 0 := sum_tmul_freeInitial_eq_zero _ hz
  have hpure := congrArg
    (fun z : Coproduct.LayerThreeBlocks (G := G) (H := Free (Fin 3)) => z.1) he
  have hzero : mk G 3 ⟨a, ha3⟩ = 0 := by simpa [hs, Prod.fst_sum] using hpure
  have hmem := (mk_eq_zero G 3 ⟨a, ha3⟩).mp hzero
  simpa only [lowerCentralSeries_three_eq_bot Fact.out, Subgroup.mem_bot] using hmem

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel (g : Fin 3 → G) (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G)
    {a : G} (ha : Coproduct.inl a ∈ kernel g) : a = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, h, he⟩ := exists_normalWord (bundledRelator g hg) ha
  have hm := coefficients_eq_zero g hg m h he
  rw [normalWord_eq_zero_coefficients _ _ _ hm] at he
  exact centralWord_eq_one g hg h he

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.baseMap_ker
statement:
theorem baseMap_ker (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin 3 → G)
    (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) : (baseMap g).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree G) := ⟨hG⟩
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro a ha
  apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
  apply eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel g hg
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mp ha

name: T3.SharedCommutatorRoots.baseMap_injective
statement:
theorem baseMap_injective (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin 3 → G)
    (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator G) : Function.Injective (baseMap g)
proof:
:=
  (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff _).mp (baseMap_ker hG g hg)

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.normalWord_mul
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalWord, Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, zpow_add, map_mul,
    mul_mul_mul_comm, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.normalWord_inv
statement:
private theorem normalWord_inv (r : Fin n → commutator G) (m : Fin n → ℤ)
    (h : Fin n → G) : normalWord r (-m) h⁻¹ = (normalWord r m h)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalWord, normalWord, ← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply, Pi.inv_apply, zpow_neg, map_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.normalWord_single
statement:
private theorem normalWord_single (r : Fin n → commutator G) (i : Fin n) (g : G) :
    (normalWord r (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.mulSingle i g⁻¹) : G) = g * r i * g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hword : normalWord r (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.mulSingle i g⁻¹) =
      r i * derivedBracketHom (r i) g⁻¹ := by
    rw [normalWord, Finset.prod_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hji
      simp [hji]
    · simp
  rw [hword]
  change (r i : G) * ⁅(r i : G), g⁻¹⁆ = g * r i * g⁻¹
  rw [commutator_inv_right Fact.out, mul_commutator_inv Fact.out]

name: T3.CommutatorRoots.exists_normalWord
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hi⟩ := Group.mem_conjugatesOfSet_iff.mp ha
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := isConj_iff.mp hi
    exact ⟨Pi.single i 1, Pi.mulSingle i g⁻¹, normalWord_single r i g⟩
  | one => exact ⟨0, 1, by simp [normalWord]⟩
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨m, h, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨k, l, rfl⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨m + k, h * l, by rw [normalWord_mul, Subgroup.coe_mul]⟩
  | inv a _ ha =>
    obtain ⟨m, h, rfl⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨-m, h⁻¹, by rw [normalWord_inv, Subgroup.coe_inv]⟩

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.prod_eq_sup_map
statement:
private theorem prod_eq_sup_map {K : Type*} [Group K] (A : Subgroup G) (B : Subgroup K) :
    A.prod B = A.map (MonoidHom.inl G K) ⊔ B.map (MonoidHom.inr G K)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le ?_ ?_)
  · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hx, hy⟩
    have hsplit : ((x, y) : G × K) = (x, 1) * (1, y) := by simp
    rw [hsplit]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mem_sup_left ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
      (Subgroup.mem_sup_right ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hx, Subgroup.one_mem _⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Subgroup.one_mem _, hy⟩

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.enlargedSubgroup_eq_sup
statement:
theorem enlargedSubgroup_eq_sup :
    enlargedSubgroup C g = C.map (SharedTripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))) ⊔
      Subgroup.closure (Set.range (newGenerator C g))
proof:
:= by
  rw [enlargedSubgroup, prod_eq_sup_map, Subgroup.map_sup, Subgroup.map_map,
    Subgroup.map_map, ← Free.closure_range_of, MonoidHom.map_closure, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.newGenerator_mem
statement:
private theorem newGenerator_mem (i : Fin 4) :
    newGenerator C g i ∈ enlargedSubgroup C g
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨C.one_mem, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.baseMap_mem
statement:
private theorem baseMap_mem (c : C) :
    SharedTripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G)) c ∈ enlargedSubgroup C g
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨c.property, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.kernel_le_product
statement:
private theorem kernel_le_product (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.center G) :
    SharedTripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)) ≤ C.prod ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [SharedTripleRoots.kernel_eq_closure _ hg]
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨C.inv_mem (g i).property, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.kernel_le_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
theorem kernel_le_lowerCentralSeries (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ term G 3) :
    SharedTripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)) ≤ term (G × Free (Fin 4)) 3
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [term, Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_prod]
  refine ⟨(term G 3).inv_mem (hg i), ?_⟩
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _))
    (Subgroup.mem_top _)

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.kernel_le_product_derived
statement:
theorem kernel_le_product_derived (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.center G)
    (hgC : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator C) :
    SharedTripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)) ≤ (C.prod ⊤).lowerCentralSeries 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [SharedTripleRoots.kernel_eq_closure _ hg, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_prod]
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · apply (C.lowerCentralSeries 1).inv_mem
    rw [← Subgroup.top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries]
    exact Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ (hgC i)
  · exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
      (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.lowerCentralSeries_enlargedSubgroup
statement:
private theorem lowerCentralSeries_enlargedSubgroup (k : ℕ) :
    (enlargedSubgroup C g).lowerCentralSeries k =
      ((C.lowerCentralSeries k).prod ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free (Fin 4))).lowerCentralSeries k)).map
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (SharedTripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [enlargedSubgroup, ← Subgroup.map_lowerCentralSeries, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_prod]

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.intersection_enlargedSubgroup
statement:
private theorem intersection_enlargedSubgroup
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.center G) (k : ℕ) :
    (⊤ : Subgroup (SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))).lowerCentralSeries k ⊓
        enlargedSubgroup C g =
      (((⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries k ⊓ C).prod
        ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free (Fin 4))).lowerCentralSeries k)).map
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (SharedTripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G))))
proof:
:= by
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (SharedTripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _
  have hker : q.ker ≤ C.prod ⊤ := by
    rw [QuotientGroup.ker_mk']
    exact kernel_le_product C g hg
  have hmap : ((⊤ : Subgroup (G × Free (Fin 4))).lowerCentralSeries k).map q =
      (⊤ : Subgroup (SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))).lowerCentralSeries k := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_lowerCentralSeries, Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective q hq]
  rw [← hmap, enlargedSubgroup, ← Subgroup.map_inf_of_ker_le hker,
    Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_prod]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_inf, Subgroup.mem_prod, Subgroup.mem_top, and_true]
  tauto

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.baseMap_generator_mem_lowerCentralSeries
proof:
:= by
  rw [SharedTripleRoots.baseMap_root]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (newGenerator_mem C g _) (newGenerator_mem C g _))
    (newGenerator_mem C g _)

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.isStrict_enlargedSubgroup
statement:
theorem isStrict_enlargedSubgroup (hG : HasExponentThree G)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ term G 3)
    (hfirst : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C)
    (hdefect : (term G 3).comap C.subtype =
      term C 3 ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) : IsStrict (enlargedSubgroup C g)
proof:
:= by
  have hcentral (i : Fin 4) : (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.center G :=
    lowerCentralSeries_two_le_center hG (hg i)
  have hfirst' : C.lowerCentralSeries 1 = (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries 1 ⊓ C := by
    rw [← Subgroup.top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries, Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one,
      ← hfirst, Subgroup.map_comap_eq, Subgroup.range_subtype]
    exact inf_comm _ _
  constructor
  · rw [lowerCentralSeries_enlargedSubgroup, intersection_enlargedSubgroup C g hcentral,
      hfirst']
  · apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_inf (Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono 2 le_top)
        (Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_le_self _ _)
    · rw [intersection_enlargedSubgroup C g hcentral]
      rintro x ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩
      let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (SharedTripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))
      let D := enlargedSubgroup C g
      let f : C →* SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)) :=
        (SharedTripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))).comp C.subtype
      have hbase : f.range ≤ D := by
        rintro y ⟨c, rfl⟩
        exact baseMap_mem C g c
      have hclosure : Subgroup.closure (Set.range g) ≤ (D.lowerCentralSeries 2).comap f := by
        apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
        rintro y ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact baseMap_generator_mem_lowerCentralSeries C g i
      have hintrinsic : term C 3 ≤ (D.lowerCentralSeries 2).comap f := by
        rw [← Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap]
        change ((⊤ : Subgroup C).lowerCentralSeries 2).map f ≤ D.lowerCentralSeries 2
        rw [Subgroup.map_lowerCentralSeries, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
        exact Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono 2 hbase
      have hca : (⟨a, ha.2⟩ : C) ∈ term C 3 ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g) := by
        rw [← hdefect]
        exact ha.1
      have hleft : q (a, 1) ∈ D.lowerCentralSeries 2 :=
        (sup_le hintrinsic hclosure) hca
      have hright : q (1, b) ∈ D.lowerCentralSeries 2 := by
        rw [lowerCentralSeries_enlargedSubgroup]
        exact Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨(C.lowerCentralSeries 2).one_mem, hb⟩
      have hprod : q (a, b) = q (a, 1) * q (1, b) := by rw [← map_mul]; simp
      rw [hprod]
      exact (D.lowerCentralSeries 2).mul_mem hleft hright

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.exists_generating_finset
statement:
theorem exists_generating_finset :
    ∃ Y : Finset (SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G))), Y.card ≤ 4 ∧
      enlargedSubgroup C g = C.map (SharedTripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))) ⊔
        Subgroup.closure (Y : Set (SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.image (newGenerator C g), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
  · simpa only [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ] using
      enlargedSubgroup_eq_sup C g

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.rank_enlargedSubgroup_le
statement:
theorem rank_enlargedSubgroup_le [Group.FG C] :
    Group.rank (enlargedSubgroup C g) ≤ Group.rank C + 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := Group.rank_spec C
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hgen⟩ := exists_generating_finset C g
  let f : C →* SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)) :=
    (SharedTripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))).comp C.subtype
  let S := s.image f
  have hS : Subgroup.closure (S : Set (SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))) =
      C.map (SharedTripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))) := by
    change Subgroup.closure
      (↑(s.image f) : Set (SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))) = _
    rw [Finset.coe_image, ← MonoidHom.map_closure, hs]
    change (⊤ : Subgroup C).map
      ((SharedTripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))).comp C.subtype) = _
    rw [← Subgroup.map_map, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map, Subgroup.range_subtype]
  have hgen' : Subgroup.closure
      (↑(S ∪ Y) : Set (SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))) =
      enlargedSubgroup C g := by
    rw [Finset.coe_union, Subgroup.closure_union, hS, hgen]
  calc
    Group.rank (enlargedSubgroup C g) = Group.rank
        (Subgroup.closure (↑(S ∪ Y) : Set (SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G))))) :=
      (Subgroup.rank_congr hgen').symm
    _ ≤ (S ∪ Y).card := Subgroup.rank_closure_finset_le_card _
    _ ≤ S.card + Y.card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ Group.rank C + 4 := Nat.add_le_add (Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq hcard) hY

name: T3.SharedLowerCentralStrictification.exists_shared_strict_extension
statement:
theorem exists_shared_strict_extension (hG : HasExponentThree G) [Group.FG C]
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ term G 3)
    (hfirst : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C)
    (hdefect : (term G 3).comap C.subtype =
      term C 3 ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) :
    ∃ (H : Type u) (_ : Group H), HasExponentThree H ∧
      ∃ f : G →* H, Function.Injective f ∧ ∃ (D : Subgroup H) (hD : Group.FG D),
        letI
proof:
:= hD
        C.map f ≤ D ∧ ∃ Y : Finset H, Y.card ≤ 4 ∧
          D = C.map f ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Y : Set H) ∧
          Group.rank D ≤ Group.rank C + 4 ∧ IsStrict D := by
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hgen⟩ := exists_generating_finset C g
  refine ⟨SharedTripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)), inferInstance,
    SharedTripleRoots.hasExponentThree_extension hG _, SharedTripleRoots.baseMap _, ?_,
    enlargedSubgroup C g, inferInstance, ?_, Y, hY, hgen,
    rank_enlargedSubgroup_le C g, isStrict_enlargedSubgroup C g hG hg hfirst hdefect⟩
  · exact SharedTripleRoots.baseMap_injective hG _ fun i =>
      lowerCentralSeries_two_le_center hG (hg i)
  · rw [enlargedSubgroup_eq_sup]
    exact le_sup_left

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.map_le_enlarged
statement: theorem map_le_enlarged (g : Fin n → C) : C.map (baseMap g) ≤ enlarged g
proof: := le_sup_left

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.range_freeMap_le_enlarged
statement: theorem range_freeMap_le_enlarged (g : Fin n → C) : (freeMap g).range ≤ enlarged g
proof: := le_sup_right

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.newGenerators_card_le
statement: theorem newGenerators_card_le (g : Fin n → C) : (newGenerators g).card ≤ 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.enlarged_eq_closure
statement:
theorem enlarged_eq_closure (g : Fin n → C) :
    enlarged g =
      Subgroup.closure ((C.map (baseMap g) : Set (Extension g)) ∪ ↑(newGenerators g))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [enlarged, Subgroup.closure_union, Subgroup.closure_eq]
  congr 1
  rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← Free.closure_range_of (I := Fin (2 * n)),
    MonoidHom.map_closure]
  congr 1
  simp only [newGenerators, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, ← Set.image_univ, Set.image_image]
  rfl

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.map_commutator_le_of_range_le
statement:
private theorem map_commutator_le_of_range_le {A B : Type*} [Group A] [Group B]
    (f : A →* B) (S : Subgroup B) (hf : f.range ≤ S) :
    (commutator A).map f ≤ ⁅S, S⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.map_commutator, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mono hf hf

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.map_mem_commutator
statement:
private theorem map_mem_commutator {A B : Type*} [Group A] [Group B]
    (f : A →* B) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ commutator A) : f a ∈ commutator B
proof:
:=
  (termMap f 2 ⟨a, ha⟩).property

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.comap_commutator_quotientMap
statement:
theorem comap_commutator_quotientMap (g : Fin n → C)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G) :
    (commutator (Extension g)).comap
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (CommutatorRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))) =
      commutator (CommutatorRoots.Ambient G n)
proof:
:= by
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (CommutatorRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))
  have hmap : (commutator (CommutatorRoots.Ambient G n)).map q = commutator (Extension g) := by
    rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.map_commutator,
      Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective q (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _), commutator_def]
  change (commutator (Extension g)).comap q = _
  rw [← hmap]
  apply Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self
  change (QuotientGroup.mk' (CommutatorRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))).ker ≤ _
  rw [QuotientGroup.ker_mk']
  exact CommutatorRoots.kernel_le_commutator _ hg

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.root_generator_mem_enlarged
statement:
private theorem root_generator_mem_enlarged (g : Fin n → C) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin 2) :
    CommutatorRoots.generator (fun i => (g i : G)) i j ∈ enlarged g
proof:
:=
  range_freeMap_le_enlarged g ⟨Free.of (CommutatorRoots.index i j), rfl⟩

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.image_defect_le_commutator
statement:
private theorem image_defect_le_commutator (g : Fin n → C)
    (hdefect : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) :
    (commutator G).comap C.subtype ≤
      ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆.comap ((baseMap g).comp C.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hdefect]
  apply sup_le
  · apply Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp
    apply map_commutator_le_of_range_le
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact map_le_enlarged g ⟨c, c.property, rfl⟩
  · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change CommutatorRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G)) (g i : G) ∈
      ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆
    rw [CommutatorRoots.baseMap_root]
    exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
      (root_generator_mem_enlarged g i 0) (root_generator_mem_enlarged g i 1)

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.inf_commutator_eq
statement:
theorem inf_commutator_eq (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin n → C)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G)
    (hdefect : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) :
    enlarged g ⊓ commutator (Extension g) = ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro a ⟨haD, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, k, hk, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.exists_mul_mul_commutator_of_mem_sup
      (C.map (baseMap g)) (freeMap g).range haD
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hu
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hv
    have hkD : k ∈ ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆ := hk
    have hkH : k ∈ commutator (Extension g) :=
      Subgroup.commutator_mono le_top le_top hkD
    have hprod : baseMap g c * freeMap g w ∈ commutator (Extension g) := by
      have hm := (commutator (Extension g)).mul_mem ha ((commutator _).inv_mem hkH)
      simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_right] using hm
    have hamb : Coproduct.inl c * Coproduct.inr w ∈
        commutator (CommutatorRoots.Ambient G n) := by
      rw [← comap_commutator_quotientMap g hg]
      change (QuotientGroup.mk' (CommutatorRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G))))
        (Coproduct.inl c * Coproduct.inr w) ∈ commutator (Extension g)
      simpa only [baseMap, CommutatorRoots.baseMap, freeMap, MonoidHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
        using hprod
    have hcder : c ∈ commutator G := by
      have hm := map_mem_commutator (Coproduct.fst hG) hamb
      simpa only [map_mul, Coproduct.fst_inl, Coproduct.fst_inr, mul_one] using hm
    have hwder : w ∈ commutator (Free (Fin (2 * n))) := by
      have hm := map_mem_commutator (Coproduct.snd Free.pow_three) hamb
      simpa only [map_mul, Coproduct.snd_inl Free.pow_three c,
        Coproduct.snd_inr Free.pow_three w, one_mul] using hm
    have hcD : baseMap g c ∈ ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆ :=
      image_defect_le_commutator g hdefect (show (⟨c, hc⟩ : C) ∈
        (commutator G).comap C.subtype from hcder)
    have hwD : freeMap g w ∈ ⁅enlarged g, enlarged g⁆ :=
      map_commutator_le_of_range_le (freeMap g) (enlarged g) (range_freeMap_le_enlarged g)
        (Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ hwder)
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hcD hwD) hkD
  · exact le_inf
      ((Subgroup.commutator_le_sup (H₁ := enlarged g) (H₂ := enlarged g)).trans (sup_idem _).le)
      (Subgroup.commutator_mono le_top le_top)

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.hasExponentThree_extension
statement: theorem hasExponentThree_extension (g : Fin n → C) : HasExponentThree (Extension g)
proof:
:=
  CommutatorRoots.hasExponentThree_extension _

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.baseMap_injective
statement:
theorem baseMap_injective (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin n → C)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G) : Function.Injective (baseMap g)
proof:
:=
  CommutatorRoots.baseMap_injective hG _ hg

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.derived_strict
statement:
theorem derived_strict (hG : HasExponentThree G) (g : Fin n → C)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ commutator G)
    (hdefect : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) :
    (enlarged g).lowerCentralSeries 1 =
      (⊤ : Subgroup (Extension g)).lowerCentralSeries 1 ⊓ enlarged g
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_zero,
    ← commutator_def, inf_comm] using (inf_commutator_eq hG g hg hdefect).symm

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.rank_enlarged_le
statement:
theorem rank_enlarged_le [Group.FG C] (g : Fin n → C) :
    Group.rank (enlarged g) ≤ Group.rank C + 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := Group.rank_spec C
  let f := (baseMap g).comp C.subtype
  let S := s.image f
  have hS : Subgroup.closure (↑S : Set (Extension g)) = C.map (baseMap g) := by
    change Subgroup.closure (↑(s.image f) : Set (Extension g)) = _
    rw [Finset.coe_image, ← MonoidHom.map_closure, hs]
    change (⊤ : Subgroup C).map ((baseMap g).comp C.subtype) = _
    rw [← Subgroup.map_map, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map, Subgroup.range_subtype]
  let Z := S ∪ newGenerators g
  have hZ : Subgroup.closure (↑Z : Set (Extension g)) = enlarged g := by
    change Subgroup.closure (↑(S ∪ newGenerators g) : Set (Extension g)) = _
    rw [Finset.coe_union, Subgroup.closure_union, hS, enlarged_eq_closure,
      Subgroup.closure_union, Subgroup.closure_eq]
  calc
    Group.rank (enlarged g) = Group.rank (Subgroup.closure (↑Z : Set (Extension g))) :=
      (Subgroup.rank_congr hZ).symm
    _ ≤ Z.card := Subgroup.rank_closure_finset_le_card _
    _ ≤ S.card + (newGenerators g).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ Group.rank C + 2 * n := Nat.add_le_add
      (Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq hcard) (newGenerators_card_le g)

name: T3.DerivedStrictification.exists_derived_strictification
statement:
theorem exists_derived_strictification (hG : HasExponentThree G) (C : Subgroup G)
    [Group.FG C] {m : ℕ} (hC : Group.rank C ≤ m) :
    ∃ (H : Type u) (hH : Group H),
      letI
proof:
:= hH
      HasExponentThree H ∧ ∃ f : G →* H, Function.Injective f ∧
        ∃ (D : Subgroup H) (hD : Group.FG D),
          letI := hD
          C.map f ≤ D ∧ ∃ Y : Finset H, Y.card ≤ 2 * m ∧
            D = Subgroup.closure ((C.map f : Set H) ∪ ↑Y) ∧
            Group.rank D ≤ 3 * m ∧
            D.lowerCentralSeries 1 = (⊤ : Subgroup H).lowerCentralSeries 1 ⊓ D := by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree G) := ⟨hG⟩
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree C) := ⟨fun c => Subtype.ext (hG c)⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd, g, hg, hdefect⟩ := exists_derived_defect_generators C.subtype
  have hdm : d ≤ m := hd.trans hC
  refine ⟨Extension g, inferInstance, hasExponentThree_extension g, baseMap g,
    baseMap_injective hG g hg, enlarged g, inferInstance, map_le_enlarged g,
    newGenerators g, (newGenerators_card_le g).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hdm),
    enlarged_eq_closure g, ?_, derived_strict hG g hg hdefect⟩
  exact (rank_enlarged_le g).trans (by omega)

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.prod_eq_sup_map
statement:
private theorem prod_eq_sup_map {K : Type*} [Group K] (A : Subgroup G) (B : Subgroup K) :
    A.prod B = A.map (MonoidHom.inl G K) ⊔ B.map (MonoidHom.inr G K)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le ?_ ?_)
  · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hx, hy⟩
    have hsplit : ((x, y) : G × K) = (x, 1) * (1, y) := by simp
    rw [hsplit]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mem_sup_left ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
      (Subgroup.mem_sup_right ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hx, Subgroup.one_mem _⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Subgroup.one_mem _, hy⟩

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.enlargedSubgroup_eq_sup
statement:
theorem enlargedSubgroup_eq_sup :
    enlargedSubgroup C g = C.map (TripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))) ⊔
      Subgroup.closure (Set.range (newGenerator C g))
proof:
:= by
  rw [enlargedSubgroup, prod_eq_sup_map, Subgroup.map_sup, Subgroup.map_map,
    Subgroup.map_map, ← Free.closure_range_of, MonoidHom.map_closure, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.newGenerator_mem
statement:
private theorem newGenerator_mem (i : Fin (3 * n)) :
    newGenerator C g i ∈ enlargedSubgroup C g
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨C.one_mem, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.baseMap_mem
statement:
private theorem baseMap_mem (c : C) :
    TripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G)) c ∈ enlargedSubgroup C g
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨c.property, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.kernel_le_product
statement:
private theorem kernel_le_product (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.center G) :
    TripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)) ≤ C.prod ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [TripleRoots.kernel_eq_closure _ hg]
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨C.inv_mem (g i).property, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.kernel_le_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
theorem kernel_le_lowerCentralSeries (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ term G 3) :
    TripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)) ≤ term (G × Free (Fin (3 * n))) 3
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [term, Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_prod]
  refine ⟨(term G 3).inv_mem (hg i), ?_⟩
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _))
    (Subgroup.mem_top _)

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.kernel_le_product_derived
statement:
theorem kernel_le_product_derived (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.center G)
    (hgC : ∀ i, g i ∈ commutator C) :
    TripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)) ≤ (C.prod ⊤).lowerCentralSeries 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [TripleRoots.kernel_eq_closure _ hg, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_prod]
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · apply (C.lowerCentralSeries 1).inv_mem
    rw [← Subgroup.top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries]
    exact Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ (hgC i)
  · exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
      (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.lowerCentralSeries_enlargedSubgroup
statement:
private theorem lowerCentralSeries_enlargedSubgroup (k : ℕ) :
    (enlargedSubgroup C g).lowerCentralSeries k =
      ((C.lowerCentralSeries k).prod ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free (Fin (3 * n)))).lowerCentralSeries k)).map
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (TripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [enlargedSubgroup, ← Subgroup.map_lowerCentralSeries, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_prod]

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.intersection_enlargedSubgroup
statement:
private theorem intersection_enlargedSubgroup
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.center G) (k : ℕ) :
    (⊤ : Subgroup (TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))).lowerCentralSeries k ⊓
        enlargedSubgroup C g =
      (((⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries k ⊓ C).prod
        ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free (Fin (3 * n)))).lowerCentralSeries k)).map
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (TripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G))))
proof:
:= by
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (TripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _
  have hker : q.ker ≤ C.prod ⊤ := by
    rw [QuotientGroup.ker_mk']
    exact kernel_le_product C g hg
  have hmap : ((⊤ : Subgroup (G × Free (Fin (3 * n)))).lowerCentralSeries k).map q =
      (⊤ : Subgroup (TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))).lowerCentralSeries k := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_lowerCentralSeries, Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective q hq]
  rw [← hmap, enlargedSubgroup, ← Subgroup.map_inf_of_ker_le hker,
    Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_prod]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_inf, Subgroup.mem_prod, Subgroup.mem_top, and_true]
  tauto

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.baseMap_generator_mem_lowerCentralSeries
proof:
:= by
  rw [TripleRoots.baseMap_root]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (newGenerator_mem C g _) (newGenerator_mem C g _))
    (newGenerator_mem C g _)

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.isStrict_enlargedSubgroup
statement:
theorem isStrict_enlargedSubgroup (hG : HasExponentThree G)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i : G) ∈ term G 3)
    (hfirst : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C)
    (hdefect : (term G 3).comap C.subtype =
      term C 3 ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g)) : IsStrict (enlargedSubgroup C g)
proof:
:= by
  have hcentral (i : Fin n) : (g i : G) ∈ Subgroup.center G :=
    lowerCentralSeries_two_le_center hG (hg i)
  have hfirst' : C.lowerCentralSeries 1 = (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries 1 ⊓ C := by
    rw [← Subgroup.top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries, Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one,
      ← hfirst, Subgroup.map_comap_eq, Subgroup.range_subtype]
    exact inf_comm _ _
  constructor
  · rw [lowerCentralSeries_enlargedSubgroup, intersection_enlargedSubgroup C g hcentral,
      hfirst']
  · apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_inf (Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono 2 le_top)
        (Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_le_self _ _)
    · rw [intersection_enlargedSubgroup C g hcentral]
      rintro x ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩
      let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (TripleRoots.kernel (fun i => (g i : G)))
      let D := enlargedSubgroup C g
      let f : C →* TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)) :=
        (TripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))).comp C.subtype
      have hbase : f.range ≤ D := by
        rintro y ⟨c, rfl⟩
        exact baseMap_mem C g c
      have hclosure : Subgroup.closure (Set.range g) ≤ (D.lowerCentralSeries 2).comap f := by
        apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
        rintro y ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact baseMap_generator_mem_lowerCentralSeries C g i
      have hintrinsic : term C 3 ≤ (D.lowerCentralSeries 2).comap f := by
        rw [← Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap]
        change ((⊤ : Subgroup C).lowerCentralSeries 2).map f ≤ D.lowerCentralSeries 2
        rw [Subgroup.map_lowerCentralSeries, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
        exact Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono 2 hbase
      have hca : (⟨a, ha.2⟩ : C) ∈ term C 3 ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Set.range g) := by
        rw [← hdefect]
        exact ha.1
      have hleft : q (a, 1) ∈ D.lowerCentralSeries 2 :=
        (sup_le hintrinsic hclosure) hca
      have hright : q (1, b) ∈ D.lowerCentralSeries 2 := by
        rw [lowerCentralSeries_enlargedSubgroup]
        exact Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨(C.lowerCentralSeries 2).one_mem, hb⟩
      have hprod : q (a, b) = q (a, 1) * q (1, b) := by rw [← map_mul]; simp
      rw [hprod]
      exact (D.lowerCentralSeries 2).mul_mem hleft hright

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.exists_generating_finset
statement:
theorem exists_generating_finset :
    ∃ Y : Finset (TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G))), Y.card ≤ 3 * n ∧
      enlargedSubgroup C g = C.map (TripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))) ⊔
        Subgroup.closure (Y : Set (TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.image (newGenerator C g), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
  · simpa only [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ] using
      enlargedSubgroup_eq_sup C g

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.rank_enlargedSubgroup_le
statement:
theorem rank_enlargedSubgroup_le [Group.FG C] :
    Group.rank (enlargedSubgroup C g) ≤ Group.rank C + 3 * n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := Group.rank_spec C
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hgen⟩ := exists_generating_finset C g
  let f : C →* TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)) :=
    (TripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))).comp C.subtype
  let S := s.image f
  have hS : Subgroup.closure (S : Set (TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))) =
      C.map (TripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))) := by
    change Subgroup.closure (↑(s.image f) : Set (TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))) = _
    rw [Finset.coe_image, ← MonoidHom.map_closure, hs]
    change (⊤ : Subgroup C).map ((TripleRoots.baseMap (fun i => (g i : G))).comp C.subtype) = _
    rw [← Subgroup.map_map, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map, Subgroup.range_subtype]
  have hgen' : Subgroup.closure (↑(S ∪ Y) : Set (TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G)))) =
      enlargedSubgroup C g := by
    rw [Finset.coe_union, Subgroup.closure_union, hS, hgen]
  calc
    Group.rank (enlargedSubgroup C g) = Group.rank
        (Subgroup.closure (↑(S ∪ Y) : Set (TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (g i : G))))) :=
      (Subgroup.rank_congr hgen').symm
    _ ≤ (S ∪ Y).card := Subgroup.rank_closure_finset_le_card _
    _ ≤ S.card + Y.card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ Group.rank C + 3 * n := Nat.add_le_add (Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq hcard) hY

name: T3.LowerCentralStrictification.exists_strict_extension
statement:
theorem exists_strict_extension (hG : HasExponentThree G) [Group.FG C]
    (hfirst : (commutator G).comap C.subtype = commutator C)
    {m : ℕ} (hC : Group.rank C ≤ m) :
    ∃ (H : Type u) (_ : Group H), HasExponentThree H ∧
      ∃ f : G →* H, Function.Injective f ∧ ∃ (D : Subgroup H) (hD : Group.FG D),
        letI
proof:
:= hD
        C.map f ≤ D ∧ ∃ Y : Finset H, Y.card ≤ 3 * m.choose 2 ∧
          D = C.map f ⊔ Subgroup.closure (Y : Set H) ∧
          Group.rank D ≤ m + 3 * m.choose 2 ∧ IsStrict D := by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree G) := ⟨hG⟩
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree C) := ⟨fun c => Subtype.ext (hG c)⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd, a, _, ha, hdefect⟩ := exists_lowerCentral_defect_generators C.subtype hfirst
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hgen⟩ := exists_generating_finset C a
  have hdm : d ≤ m.choose 2 := hd.trans (Nat.choose_mono 2 hC)
  refine ⟨TripleRoots.Extension (fun i => (a i : G)), inferInstance,
    TripleRoots.hasExponentThree_extension hG _, TripleRoots.baseMap _, ?_,
    enlargedSubgroup C a, inferInstance, ?_, Y, ?_, hgen, ?_,
    isStrict_enlargedSubgroup C a hG ha hfirst hdefect⟩
  · exact TripleRoots.baseMap_injective hG _ fun i =>
      lowerCentralSeries_two_le_center hG (ha i)
  · rw [enlargedSubgroup_eq_sup]
    exact le_sup_left
  · exact hY.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hdm)
  · exact (rank_enlargedSubgroup_le C a).trans (Nat.add_le_add hC (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hdm))

name: T3.TripleRoots.index_lt
statement: private theorem index_lt (i : Fin n) {j k : Fin 3} (h : j < k) : index i j < index i k
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [index, Fin.mk_lt_mk, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left] using (show j.val < k.val from h)

name: T3.TripleRoots.index_zero_injective
statement: private theorem index_zero_injective : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin n => index i 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  apply Fin.ext
  have := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [index, Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero] at this
  omega

name: T3.TripleRoots.witness_mem_center
statement: theorem witness_mem_center (i : Fin n) : witness i ∈ Subgroup.center (Free (Fin (3 * n)))
proof:
:=
  T3.commutator_mem_center_of_mem_commutator Free.pow_three
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)) _

name: T3.TripleRoots.relator_mem_center
statement:
theorem relator_mem_center (z : Fin n → G) (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Subgroup.center G) (i : Fin n) :
    relator z i ∈ Subgroup.center (G × Free (Fin (3 * n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
  intro a
  exact Prod.ext (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp ((Subgroup.center G).inv_mem (hz i)) a.1)
    (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (witness_mem_center i) a.2)

name: T3.TripleRoots.kernel_eq_closure
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_closure (z : Fin n → G) (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Subgroup.center G) :
    kernel z = Subgroup.closure (Set.range (relator z))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (relator z)) ≤ Subgroup.center _ :=
    (Subgroup.closure_le _).2 (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact relator_mem_center z hz i)
  have : (Subgroup.closure (Set.range (relator z))).Normal := by
    constructor
    intro a ha g
    rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (hc ha) g, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
    exact ha
  exact le_antisymm (Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal Subgroup.subset_closure)
    Subgroup.closure_le_normalClosure

name: T3.TripleRoots.exists_relationWord
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernel_eq_closure z hz] at ha
  induction ha using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
    refine ⟨Pi.single i 1, ?_⟩
    simp [relationWord, Pi.single_apply, bundledRelator]
  | one => exact ⟨0, by simp [relationWord]⟩
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨m + k, ?_⟩
    simp only [relationWord, Pi.add_apply, zpow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Subgroup.coe_mul]
  | inv a _ ha =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ha
    refine ⟨-m, ?_⟩
    simp only [relationWord, Pi.neg_apply, zpow_neg, Finset.prod_inv_distrib, Subgroup.coe_inv]

name: T3.TripleRoots.coordinate_bundledRelator
proof:
:= by
  change Multiplicative.ofAdd ((Free.toLvdW (witness j)).triple _ _ _) = _
  rw [witness, map_commutatorElement, map_commutatorElement,
    Free.toLvdW_of, Free.toLvdW_of, Free.toLvdW_of,
    LvdW.triple_commutator_of_triple_of_lt (index_lt j (by decide)) (index_lt j (by decide))
      (index_lt i (by decide)) (index_lt i (by decide))]
  have h : (index i 0 = index j 0 ∧ index i 1 = index j 1 ∧
      index i 2 = index j 2) ↔ i = j :=
    ⟨fun h => index_zero_injective h.1, fun h => by subst j; simp⟩
  simp only [h]

name: T3.TripleRoots.coordinate_relationWord
proof:
:= by
  let : AddCommGroup (ZMod 3) := (ZMod.commRing 3).toAddCommGroup
  rw [relationWord, map_prod]
  simp only [map_zpow, coordinate_bundledRelator]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i]
  · simp [← ofAdd_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  · intro b _ hbi
    simp [Ne.symm hbi]
  · simp

name: T3.TripleRoots.eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_relationWord z hz hg
  have hcoeff (i : Fin n) : (m i : ZMod 3) = 0 := by
    have hc : coordinate i (relationWord z hz m) = 1 := by
      change Multiplicative.ofAdd
        ((Free.toLvdW ((relationWord z hz m : G × Free (Fin (3 * n))).2)).triple
          (index i 0) (index i 1) (index i 2)) = 1
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    simpa only [coordinate_relationWord, ofAdd_eq_one] using hc
  have hword : relationWord z hz m = 1 := by
    apply Finset.prod_eq_one
    intro i _
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (m i) 3).mp (hcoeff i)
    norm_num at hk
    rw [hk, zpow_mul]
    have hcube : bundledRelator z hz i ^ (3 : ℤ) = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((z i)⁻¹, witness i) ^ (3 : ℤ) = (1 : G × Free (Fin (3 * n)))
      rw [show (3 : ℤ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, zpow_natCast]
      exact Prod.ext (by change ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 3 = 1; rw [inv_pow, hG (z i), inv_one])
        (Free.pow_three _)
    rw [hcube, one_zpow]
  have h := congrArg Prod.fst hm
  simpa only [hword, Subgroup.coe_one, Prod.fst_one, MonoidHom.inl_apply] using h.symm

name: T3.TripleRoots.hasExponentThree_extension
statement:
theorem hasExponentThree_extension (hG : HasExponentThree G) (z : Fin n → G) :
    HasExponentThree (Extension z)
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree G) := ⟨hG⟩
  exact Fact.out

name: T3.TripleRoots.baseMap_ker
statement:
theorem baseMap_ker (hG : HasExponentThree G) (z : Fin n → G)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Subgroup.center G) : (baseMap z).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro g hg
  apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
  apply eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel hG z hz
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mp hg

name: T3.TripleRoots.baseMap_injective
statement:
theorem baseMap_injective (hG : HasExponentThree G) (z : Fin n → G)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Subgroup.center G) : Function.Injective (baseMap z)
proof:
:=
  (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff _).mp (baseMap_ker hG z hz)

name: T3.TripleRoots.baseMap_root
statement:
theorem baseMap_root (z : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    baseMap z (z i) = ⁅⁅generator z i 0, generator z i 1⁆, generator z i 2⁆
proof:
:= by
  change (QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel z)) (MonoidHom.inl G _ (z i)) =
    ⁅⁅(QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel z)) (MonoidHom.inr G _ (Free.of (index i 0))),
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel z)) (MonoidHom.inr G _ (Free.of (index i 1)))⁆,
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel z)) (MonoidHom.inr G _ (Free.of (index i 2)))⁆
  rw [← map_commutatorElement, ← map_commutatorElement, ← map_commutatorElement,
    ← map_commutatorElement]
  rw [QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.eq]
  have h : (MonoidHom.inl G (Free (Fin (3 * n))) (z i))⁻¹ *
      MonoidHom.inr G _ (witness i) = relator z i := by
    simp only [MonoidHom.inl_apply, MonoidHom.inr_apply, Prod.inv_mk,
      Prod.mk_mul_mk, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, relator]
  change (MonoidHom.inl G (Free (Fin (3 * n))) (z i))⁻¹ *
    MonoidHom.inr G _ (witness i) ∈ kernel z
  rw [h]
  exact Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: T3.SharedTriple.independent
statement:
theorem independent : LinearIndependent (ZMod 3)
    (fun t : IncreasingTriple (Fin 4) => AssociatedGraded.mk (Free (Fin 4)) 3 (triple t))
proof:
:= by
  convert (Module.Basis.ofRepr (Free.layerThreeEquiv (I := Fin 4))).linearIndependent using 1
  funext t
  apply Free.layerThreeEquiv.injective
  simpa only [triple, Module.Basis.coe_ofRepr, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
    Free.layerThreeEquiv_tripleCommutator t

name: T3.SharedTriple.number_of_triples
statement: theorem number_of_triples : Nat.card (IncreasingTriple (Fin 4)) = 4
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [IncreasingTriple.natCard_eq_choose]

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.tripleIndex_injective
statement: private theorem tripleIndex_injective : Function.Injective tripleIndex
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [tripleIndex, IncreasingTriple.ext_iff]

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.independent
statement:
theorem independent : LinearIndependent (ZMod 3)
    (fun i : Fin 4 => mk (Free (Fin 4)) 3 (SharedTriple.triple (tripleIndex i)))
proof:
:=
  SharedTriple.independent.comp tripleIndex tripleIndex_injective

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.witness_mem_center
statement: theorem witness_mem_center (i : Fin 4) : witness i ∈ Subgroup.center (Free (Fin 4))
proof:
:=
  T3.commutator_mem_center_of_mem_commutator Free.pow_three
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)) _

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.kernel_eq_closure
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_closure (z : Fin 4 → G) (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Subgroup.center G) :
    kernel z = Subgroup.closure (Set.range (relator z))
proof:
:=
  CentralRootRelations.normalClosure_eq_closure (term (Free (Fin 4)) 3)
    (lowerCentralSeries_two_le_center Free.pow_three) z hz
    (fun i => SharedTriple.triple (tripleIndex i))

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.coordinate_witness
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change (Free.tripleFinsuppReadout (SharedTriple.triple (tripleIndex j))).toAdd
    (tripleIndex i) = if i = j then 1 else 0
  have h := congrArg (fun f : IncreasingTriple (Fin 4) →₀ ZMod 3 => f (tripleIndex i))
    (Free.layerThreeEquiv_tripleCommutator (tripleIndex j))
  simpa only [Free.layerThreeEquiv_mk, SharedTriple.triple,
    Finsupp.single_apply, tripleIndex_injective.eq_iff, eq_comm] using h

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel
proof:
:=
  CentralRootRelations.eq_one_of_inl_mem_normalClosure (term (Free (Fin 4)) 3)
    (lowerCentralSeries_two_le_center Free.pow_three) z hz
    (fun i => SharedTriple.triple (tripleIndex i)) hG Free.pow_three coordinate
    coordinate_witness hg

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.hasExponentThree_extension
statement:
theorem hasExponentThree_extension (hG : HasExponentThree G) (z : Fin 4 → G) :
    HasExponentThree (Extension z)
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree G) := ⟨hG⟩
  exact Fact.out

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.baseMap_ker
statement:
theorem baseMap_ker (hG : HasExponentThree G) (z : Fin 4 → G)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Subgroup.center G) : (baseMap z).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro g hg
  apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
  apply eq_one_of_inl_mem_kernel hG z hz
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mp hg

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.baseMap_injective
statement:
theorem baseMap_injective (hG : HasExponentThree G) (z : Fin 4 → G)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Subgroup.center G) : Function.Injective (baseMap z)
proof:
:=
  (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff _).mp (baseMap_ker hG z hz)

name: T3.SharedTripleRoots.baseMap_root
statement:
theorem baseMap_root (z : Fin 4 → G) (i : Fin 4) :
    baseMap z (z i) =
      ⁅⁅generator z (tripleIndex i).first, generator z (tripleIndex i).second⁆,
        generator z (tripleIndex i).third⁆
proof:
:= by
  change (QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel z)) (MonoidHom.inl G _ (z i)) =
    ⁅⁅(QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel z)) (MonoidHom.inr G _ (Free.of ((tripleIndex i).first))),
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel z)) (MonoidHom.inr G _ (Free.of ((tripleIndex i).second)))⁆,
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (kernel z)) (MonoidHom.inr G _ (Free.of ((tripleIndex i).third)))⁆
  rw [← map_commutatorElement, ← map_commutatorElement, ← map_commutatorElement,
    ← map_commutatorElement]
  rw [QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.eq]
