  have h : (MonoidHom.inl G (Free (Fin 4)) (z i))⁻¹ *
      MonoidHom.inr G _ (witness i) = relator z i := by
    simp only [MonoidHom.inl_apply, MonoidHom.inr_apply, Prod.inv_mk,
      Prod.mk_mul_mk, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, relator]
  change (MonoidHom.inl G (Free (Fin 4)) (z i))⁻¹ *
    MonoidHom.inr G _ (witness i) ∈ kernel z
  rw [h]
  exact Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: T3.wedgeVV_eq_ιMulti
statement:
theorem wedgeVV_eq_ιMulti (u v : V) :
    wedgeVV R V u v = exteriorPower.ιMulti R 2 ![u, v]
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [wedgeVV, gradedMul, oneEquiv_symm_coe,
    exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_succ_apply]

name: T3.wedgeQV_wedgeVV_eq_ιMulti
statement:
theorem wedgeQV_wedgeVV_eq_ιMulti (u v w : V) :
    wedgeQV R V (wedgeVV R V u v) w = exteriorPower.ιMulti R 3 ![u, v, w]
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [wedgeQV, wedgeVV, gradedMul, oneEquiv_symm_coe,
    exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_succ_apply, mul_assoc]

name: T3.exteriorPower_two_basis
statement:
theorem exteriorPower_two_basis (b : Basis I R V) (p : IncreasingPair I) :
    b.exteriorPower 2 (IncreasingPair.equivPowersetCard p) =
      wedgeVV R V (b p.first) (b p.second)
proof:
:= by
  rw [exteriorPower.basis_apply, wedgeVV_eq_ιMulti]
  change exteriorPower.ιMulti R 2
      (⇑b ∘ ⇑(Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm (IncreasingPair.equivPowersetCard p))) = _
  rw [IncreasingPair.ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_equivPowersetCard]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: T3.exteriorPower_three_basis
statement:
theorem exteriorPower_three_basis (b : Basis I R V) (t : IncreasingTriple I) :
    b.exteriorPower 3 (IncreasingTriple.equivPowersetCard t) =
      wedgeQV R V (wedgeVV R V (b t.first) (b t.second)) (b t.third)
proof:
:= by
  rw [exteriorPower.basis_apply, wedgeQV_wedgeVV_eq_ιMulti]
  change exteriorPower.ιMulti R 3
      (⇑b ∘ ⇑(Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm (IncreasingTriple.equivPowersetCard t))) = _
  rw [IncreasingTriple.ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_equivPowersetCard]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: T3.Free.sigmaOne_apply
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_apply (x : AssociatedGraded.Layer (Free I) 1) :
    sigmaOne b x = (exteriorPower.oneEquiv (ZMod 3) V).symm (b.repr.symm (layerOneEquiv x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_apply
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_apply (x : AssociatedGraded.Layer (Free I) 2) :
    sigmaTwo b x = (b.exteriorPower 2).repr.symm
      (Finsupp.domLCongr (R := ZMod 3) IncreasingPair.equivPowersetCard (layerTwoEquiv x))
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_apply
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_apply (x : AssociatedGraded.Layer (Free I) 3) :
    sigmaThree b x = (b.exteriorPower 3).repr.symm
      (Finsupp.domLCongr (R := ZMod 3) IncreasingTriple.equivPowersetCard (layerThreeEquiv x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.Free.sigmaOne_of
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_of (i : I) :
    sigmaOne b (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 1 ⟨of i, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩) =
      (exteriorPower.oneEquiv (ZMod 3) V).symm (b i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaOne_apply, layerOneEquiv_of, Basis.repr_symm_single, one_smul]

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_commutator
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_commutator (p : IncreasingPair I) :
    sigmaTwo b (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 2
      (derivedCommutator (of p.first) (of p.second))) =
      wedgeVV (ZMod 3) V (b p.first) (b p.second)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaTwo_apply, layerTwoEquiv_commutator, Finsupp.domLCongr_single,
    Basis.repr_symm_single, one_smul, exteriorPower_two_basis]

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_tripleCommutator
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_tripleCommutator (t : IncreasingTriple I) :
    sigmaThree b (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 3
      ⟨⁅⁅of t.first, of t.second⁆, of t.third⁆,
        commutator_mem_gammaThree
          (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)) _⟩) =
      wedgeQV (ZMod 3) V (wedgeVV (ZMod 3) V (b t.first) (b t.second)) (b t.third)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaThree_apply, layerThreeEquiv_tripleCommutator, Finsupp.domLCongr_single,
    Basis.repr_symm_single, one_smul, exteriorPower_three_basis]

name: T3.Free.generatorWord_two
statement:
private theorem generatorWord_two (l : Fin 2 → ZMod 3) :
    generatorWord l = of 0 ^ (l 0).val * of 1 ^ (l 1).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite (Fin 2)
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, true_iff]
    omega
  simp [generatorWord, hu, Finset.sort_insert]

name: T3.Free.pairWord_two
statement:
private theorem pairWord_two (m : IncreasingPair (Fin 2) → ZMod 3) :
    (pairWord m : Free (Fin 2)) = ⁅of (0 : Fin 2), of 1⁆ ^ (m FreeTwo.pairIndex).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite (IncreasingPair (Fin 2))
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (IncreasingPair (Fin 2))) = {FreeTwo.pairIndex} := by
    ext p
    simp [FreeTwo.pair_eq p]
  simp [pairWord, hu, FreeTwo.pairIndex]

name: T3.Free.tripleWord_two
statement:
private theorem tripleWord_two (n : IncreasingTriple (Fin 2) → ZMod 3) :
    ((tripleWord n : (genReadout (I := Fin 2)).ker) : Free (Fin 2)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : IsEmpty (IncreasingTriple (Fin 2)) := ⟨fun t => by
    have h1 := t.first_lt_second
    have h2 := t.second_lt_third
    have h3 := t.third.isLt
    simp only [Fin.lt_def] at h1 h2
    omega⟩
  simp [tripleWord, Finset.univ_eq_empty]

name: T3.Free.exists_normalForm_two
statement:
private theorem exists_normalForm_two (g : Free (Fin 2)) :
    ∃ i j k : Fin 3, g = of 0 ^ i.val * of 1 ^ j.val * ⁅of (0 : Fin 2), of 1⁆ ^ k.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨l, m, n⟩, rfl⟩ := normalWord_bijective.surjective g
  refine ⟨⟨(l 0).val, (l 0).val_lt⟩, ⟨(l 1).val, (l 1).val_lt⟩,
    ⟨(m FreeTwo.pairIndex).val, (m FreeTwo.pairIndex).val_lt⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [normalWord, generatorWord_two, pairWord_two, tripleWord_two, mul_one]

name: T3.Free.nonStrictLift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem nonStrictLift_zero : nonStrictLift (of 0) = ⁅of (0 : Fin 3), of 1⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp [nonStrictLift]

name: T3.Free.nonStrictLift_one
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem nonStrictLift_one : nonStrictLift (of 1) = of 2
proof: := by simp [nonStrictLift]

name: T3.Free.nonStrictLift_injective
statement: theorem nonStrictLift_injective : Function.Injective nonStrictLift
proof:
:= by
  apply (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff nonStrictLift).mp
  refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro g hg
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker] at hg
  obtain ⟨i, j, k, rfl⟩ := exists_normalForm_two g
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_commutatorElement,
    nonStrictLift_zero, nonStrictLift_one] at hg
  have h := congrArg toLvdW hg
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, map_one] at h
  have hgen := congrArg (fun c : LvdW (Fin 3) => c.gen 2) h
  have hpair := congrArg (fun c : LvdW (Fin 3) => c.pair 0 1) h
  have htriple := congrArg (fun c : LvdW (Fin 3) => c.triple 0 1 2) h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k
  all_goals
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul,
      LvdW.mul_gen, LvdW.mul_pair, LvdW.mul_triple, LvdW.one_gen, LvdW.one_pair,
      LvdW.one_triple, LvdW.commutator_gen, LvdW.commutator_pair,
      LvdW.triple_commutator_triple, LvdW.of_gen, LvdW.of_pair, LvdW.of_triple,
      Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte] at hgen hpair htriple
    solve
    | exfalso; revert hgen; decide
    | exfalso; revert hpair; decide
    | exfalso; revert htriple; decide
    | simp

name: T3.Free.nonStrictSubgroup_eq_closure
statement:
theorem nonStrictSubgroup_eq_closure :
    nonStrictSubgroup = Subgroup.closure {⁅of (0 : Fin 3), of 1⁆, of 2}
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonStrictSubgroup, MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← closure_range_of,
    MonoidHom.map_closure, ← Set.range_comp]
  congr 1
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  · simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨0, nonStrictLift_zero⟩
    · exact ⟨1, nonStrictLift_one⟩

name: T3.Free.nonStrictGenerator_coe
proof: := nonStrictLift_zero

name: T3.Free.free_generator_not_mem_commutator
statement:
private theorem free_generator_not_mem_commutator {I : Type*} [LinearOrder I] (i : I) :
    of i ∉ commutator (Free I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hi
  have h := toLvdW_gen_eq_zero_of_mem_commutator hi i
  exact one_ne_zero (by simpa only [toLvdW_of, LvdW.of_gen_self] using h)

name: T3.Free.centralSeriesCoincide_fin_three
statement: theorem centralSeriesCoincide_fin_three : CentralSeriesCoincide (Free (Fin 3))
proof:
:= by
  let : Nontrivial (Free (Fin 1)) := nontrivial_of_ne (of 0) 1 (fun h =>
    free_generator_not_mem_commutator (0 : Fin 1) (h ▸ (commutator _).one_mem))
  let e : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2 ≃ Fin 3 := finSumFinEquiv
  let eF : Free (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2) ≃* Free (Fin 3) :=
    MonoidHom.toMulEquiv (map e) (map e.symm)
      (hom_ext fun i => by simp) (hom_ext fun i => by simp)
  exact (Coproduct.centralSeriesCoincide_freeTwo (G := Free (Fin 1))).mulEquiv
    (sumEquivCoproduct.symm.trans eF)

name: T3.Free.nonStrictSecondGenerator_coe
proof: := nonStrictLift_one

name: T3.Free.nonStrictSubgroup_mem_commutator_iff
statement:
theorem nonStrictSubgroup_mem_commutator_iff (g : nonStrictSubgroup) :
    g ∈ commutator nonStrictSubgroup ↔
      ∃ k : Fin 3, g = ⁅nonStrictGenerator, nonStrictSecondGenerator⁆ ^ k.val
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hm : (commutator nonStrictSubgroup).map nonStrictEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom ≤
        commutator (Free (Fin 2)) := by
      rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.map_commutator, commutator_def]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mono le_top le_top
    have hi : nonStrictEquiv.symm g ∈ AssociatedGraded.term (Free (Fin 2)) 2 :=
      hm (Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ hg)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (FreeTwo.mem_term_two_iff _).mp hi
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    apply nonStrictEquiv.symm.injective
    simpa only [map_pow, map_commutatorElement, nonStrictGenerator,
      nonStrictSecondGenerator, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hk
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact Subgroup.pow_mem _
      (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)) _

name: T3.Free.nonStrictGenerator_not_mem_commutator
statement:
theorem nonStrictGenerator_not_mem_commutator :
    nonStrictGenerator ∉ commutator nonStrictSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply free_generator_not_mem_commutator (0 : Fin 2)
  have hm : (commutator nonStrictSubgroup).map nonStrictEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom ≤
      commutator (Free (Fin 2)) := by
    rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.map_commutator, commutator_def]
    exact Subgroup.commutator_mono le_top le_top
  simpa only [nonStrictGenerator, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using
    hm (Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ h)

name: T3.Free.nonStrictSubgroup_not_isStrict
statement: theorem nonStrictSubgroup_not_isStrict : ¬ IsStrict nonStrictSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply nonStrictGenerator_not_mem_commutator
  have hc := (isStrict_iff_comap_subtype nonStrictSubgroup).mp h
  rw [Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one] at hc
  rw [hc.1]
  change (nonStrictGenerator : Free (Fin 3)) ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup (Free (Fin 3))).lowerCentralSeries 1
  rw [nonStrictGenerator_coe, Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)

name: T3.Free.nonStrictWitness_ne_one
statement: theorem nonStrictWitness_ne_one : nonStrictWitness ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  let p : nonStrictSubgroup →* Free (Fin 3) :=
    (lift pow_three (fun _ : Fin 2 => of (0 : Fin 3))).comp nonStrictEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom
  let q : Free (Fin 2) →* Free (Fin 3) :=
    lift pow_three (fun i => if i = 0 then of 1 else of 2)
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (Coproduct.lift pow_three p q) h
  have hp : p nonStrictGenerator = of 0 := by simp [p, nonStrictGenerator]
  have hq0 : q (of 0) = of 1 := by simp [q]
  have hq1 : q (of 1) = of 2 := by simp [q]
  simp only [nonStrictWitness, map_commutatorElement, map_one] at hh
  change ⁅⁅p nonStrictGenerator, q (of 0)⁆, q (of 1)⁆ = 1 at hh
  rw [hp, hq0, hq1] at hh
  exact triple_commutator_of_ne_one (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1)
    (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2) (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2) hh

name: T3.Free.map_nonStrictWitness
statement:
theorem map_nonStrictWitness :
    Coproduct.map nonStrictSubgroup.subtype (MonoidHom.id (Free (Fin 2))) nonStrictWitness = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nonStrictWitness, map_commutatorElement, Coproduct.map_inl, Coproduct.map_inr,
    MonoidHom.id_apply, Subgroup.subtype_apply, nonStrictGenerator_coe,
    map_commutatorElement]
  exact commutator_quadruple Coproduct.pow_three _ _ _ _

name: T3.Free.nonStrict_coproduct_map_not_injective
statement:
theorem nonStrict_coproduct_map_not_injective :
    ¬ Function.Injective (Coproduct.map nonStrictSubgroup.subtype
      (MonoidHom.id (Free (Fin 2))))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact nonStrictWitness_ne_one (h (map_nonStrictWitness.trans (map_one _).symm))

name: T3.Free.nonStrict_not_amalgamable
statement:
theorem nonStrict_not_amalgamable :
    ¬ Amalgamation.AmalgamableOver nonStrictSubgroup.subtype
      (Coproduct.inl (H := Free (Fin 2)))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, hij⟩
  let : Group K := hK
  have ha : i (nonStrictGenerator : Free (Fin 3)) = j (Coproduct.inl nonStrictGenerator) :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun hij nonStrictGenerator
  have hw : j nonStrictWitness = 1 := by
    simp only [nonStrictWitness, map_commutatorElement, ← ha, nonStrictGenerator_coe]
    exact commutator_quadruple hpow _ _ _ _
  exact nonStrictWitness_ne_one (hj (hw.trans (map_one j).symm))

name: T3.Free.val_nsmul_single
statement:
private theorem val_nsmul_single {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (p : α) (m : ZMod 3) :
    m.val • Pi.single p (1 : ZMod 3) = (Pi.single p m : α → ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  funext q
  rcases eq_or_ne q p with rfl | hqp
  · simp [ZMod.natCast_rightInverse m]
  · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hqp]

name: T3.Free.readout_word
statement:
private theorem readout_word {α G : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Group G]
    (f : G →* Multiplicative (α → ZMod 3)) (b : α → G)
    (hb : ∀ a, f (b a) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (Pi.single a (1 : ZMod 3)))
    {c : α →₀ ZMod 3} (l : List α) (hn : l.Nodup) (hl : l.toFinset = c.support) :
    f ((l.map fun a => b a ^ (c a).val).prod) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (c : α → ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : f ((l.map fun a => b a ^ (c a).val).prod) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd ((l.map fun a => Pi.single a (c a)).sum) := by
    clear hn hl
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a l ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, map_mul, map_pow, hb,
        ← ofAdd_nsmul, val_nsmul_single, ih, List.sum_cons, ofAdd_add]
  rw [hp]
  congr 1
  rw [← List.sum_toFinset _ hn, hl]
  ext a
  classical
  by_cases ha : a ∈ c.support
  · simp [Pi.single_apply, ha]
  · simp [Pi.single_apply, ha, Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp ha]

name: T3.Free.genReadout_generatorWordFinsupp
statement:
theorem genReadout_generatorWordFinsupp (l : I →₀ ZMod 3) :
    genReadout (generatorWordFinsupp l) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (l : I → ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply readout_word _ _ ?_ _ (Finset.sort_nodup _ _) (Finset.sort_toFinset _ _)
  intro i
  rw [genReadout_apply, toLvdW_of]
  exact congrArg _ (funext fun j => by rw [LvdW.of_gen, Pi.single_apply])

name: T3.Free.pairReadout_pairWordFinsupp
statement:
theorem pairReadout_pairWordFinsupp (m : IncreasingPair I →₀ ZMod 3) :
    pairReadout (pairWordFinsupp m) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (m : IncreasingPair I → ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply readout_word _ _ ?_ _ (Finset.nodup_toList _) (Finset.toList_toFinset _)
  intro p
  rw [pairReadout_apply]
  refine congrArg _ (funext fun q => ?_)
  rw [map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of,
    LvdW.commutator_of_pair_of_lt p.first_lt_second q.first_lt_second, Pi.single_apply]
  simp only [IncreasingPair.ext_iff]

name: T3.Free.tripleReadout_tripleWordFinsupp
statement:
theorem tripleReadout_tripleWordFinsupp (n : IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3) :
    tripleReadout (tripleWordFinsupp n) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (n : IncreasingTriple I → ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply readout_word _ _ ?_ _ (Finset.nodup_toList _) (Finset.toList_toFinset _)
  intro t
  rw [tripleReadout_apply]
  refine congrArg _ (funext fun s => ?_)
  rw [map_commutatorElement, map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of,
    LvdW.triple_commutator_of_triple_of_lt t.first_lt_second t.second_lt_third
      s.first_lt_second s.second_lt_third, Pi.single_apply]
  simp only [IncreasingTriple.ext_iff]

name: T3.Free.genReadout_normalWordFinsupp
statement:
theorem genReadout_normalWordFinsupp (l : I →₀ ZMod 3) (m : IncreasingPair I →₀ ZMod 3)
    (n : IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3) :
    genReadout (normalWordFinsupp l m n) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (l : I → ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : genReadout (pairWordFinsupp m : Free I) = 1 := (pairWordFinsupp m).property
  have hn : genReadout ((tripleWordFinsupp n : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) : Free I) = 1 :=
    (tripleWordFinsupp n).val.property
  rw [normalWordFinsupp, map_mul, map_mul, genReadout_generatorWordFinsupp, hm, hn,
    mul_one, mul_one]

name: T3.Free.normalWordFinsupp_injective
statement:
theorem normalWordFinsupp_injective : Function.Injective
    (fun c : (I →₀ ZMod 3) × (IncreasingPair I →₀ ZMod 3) × (IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3) =>
      normalWordFinsupp c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨l, m, n⟩ ⟨l', m', n'⟩ h
  have hl : l = l' := by
    have hgen := congrArg genReadout h
    rw [genReadout_normalWordFinsupp, genReadout_normalWordFinsupp] at hgen
    exact DFunLike.coe_injective (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hgen)
  subst l'
  have hp : pairWordFinsupp m * (tripleWordFinsupp n : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) =
      pairWordFinsupp m' * (tripleWordFinsupp n' : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply mul_left_cancel (a := generatorWordFinsupp l)
    simpa only [normalWordFinsupp, mul_assoc, Subgroup.coe_mul] using h
  have hm : m = m' := by
    have hn : pairReadout (tripleWordFinsupp n : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) = 1 :=
      (tripleWordFinsupp n).property
    have hn' : pairReadout (tripleWordFinsupp n' : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) = 1 :=
      (tripleWordFinsupp n').property
    have hpair := congrArg pairReadout hp
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, pairReadout_pairWordFinsupp, pairReadout_pairWordFinsupp, hn, hn',
      mul_one, mul_one] at hpair
    exact DFunLike.coe_injective (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hpair)
  subst m'
  have ht : tripleWordFinsupp n = tripleWordFinsupp n' := Subtype.ext (mul_left_cancel hp)
  have hn := congrArg tripleReadout ht
  rw [tripleReadout_tripleWordFinsupp, tripleReadout_tripleWordFinsupp] at hn
  have hn' : n = n' := DFunLike.coe_injective (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hn)
  subst n'
  rfl

name: T3.Free.tripleReadout_injective
statement: theorem tripleReadout_injective : Function.Injective (tripleReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff, eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords
  · intro i
    have h := x.val.property
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, genReadout_apply, ofAdd_eq_one] at h
    exact congrFun h i
  · intro p
    have h := x.property
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, pairReadout_apply, ofAdd_eq_one] at h
    exact congrFun h p
  · intro t
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, tripleReadout_apply, ofAdd_eq_one] at hx
    exact congrFun hx t

name: T3.Free.normalWordFinsupp_surjective
statement:
theorem normalWordFinsupp_surjective : Function.Surjective
    (fun c : (I →₀ ZMod 3) × (IncreasingPair I →₀ ZMod 3) × (IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3) =>
      normalWordFinsupp c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  let l : I →₀ ZMod 3 := Finsupp.ofSupportFinite (toLvdW g).gen (finite_support_gen g)
  have hl : genReadout (generatorWordFinsupp l) = genReadout g :=
    genReadout_generatorWordFinsupp l
  let x : (genReadout (I := I)).ker := ⟨(generatorWordFinsupp l)⁻¹ * g, by
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, map_mul, map_inv, hl]
    exact inv_mul_cancel _⟩
  let m : IncreasingPair I →₀ ZMod 3 := Finsupp.ofSupportFinite
    (fun p => (toLvdW x.val).pair p.first p.second) (finite_support_pair x.val)
  have hm : pairReadout (pairWordFinsupp m) = pairReadout x :=
    pairReadout_pairWordFinsupp m
  let y : (pairReadout (I := I)).ker := ⟨(pairWordFinsupp m)⁻¹ * x, by
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, map_mul, map_inv, hm]
    exact inv_mul_cancel _⟩
  let n : IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3 := Finsupp.ofSupportFinite
    (fun t => (toLvdW y.val.val).triple t.first t.second t.third)
    (finite_support_triple y.val.val)
  have hn : tripleReadout (tripleWordFinsupp n) = tripleReadout y :=
    tripleReadout_tripleWordFinsupp n
  have hy : tripleWordFinsupp n = y := tripleReadout_injective hn
  refine ⟨(l, m, n), ?_⟩
  change normalWordFinsupp l m n = g
  rw [normalWordFinsupp, hy]
  change generatorWordFinsupp l * (pairWordFinsupp m : Free I) *
    ((pairWordFinsupp m : Free I)⁻¹ * ((generatorWordFinsupp l)⁻¹ * g)) = g
  group

name: T3.Free.normalWordFinsupp_bijective
statement:
theorem normalWordFinsupp_bijective : Function.Bijective
    (fun c : (I →₀ ZMod 3) × (IncreasingPair I →₀ ZMod 3) × (IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3) =>
      normalWordFinsupp c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2)
proof:
:=
  ⟨normalWordFinsupp_injective, normalWordFinsupp_surjective⟩

name: T3.Free.existsUnique_normalWordFinsupp
statement:
theorem existsUnique_normalWordFinsupp (g : Free I) :
    ∃! c : (I →₀ ZMod 3) × (IncreasingPair I →₀ ZMod 3) × (IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3),
      normalWordFinsupp c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2 = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := normalWordFinsupp_surjective g
  exact ⟨c, hc, fun d hd => normalWordFinsupp_injective (hd.trans hc.symm)⟩

name: T3.Free.closure_range_of
statement:
theorem closure_range_of :
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range (of : I → Free I)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let q := T3.powerQuotientMk (G := FreeGroup I) (n := 3)
  have h := congrArg (Subgroup.map q) (FreeGroup.closure_range_of I)
  rw [MonoidHom.map_closure, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map,
    MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr (T3.powerQuotientMk_surjective
      (G := FreeGroup I) (n := 3))] at h
  have hrange :
      Set.range (of : I → Free I) = q '' Set.range (FreeGroup.of : I → FreeGroup I) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨FreeGroup.of i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [hrange]
  exact h

name: T3.mem_closure_range_of_closure_range_eq_top
statement:
theorem mem_closure_range_of_closure_range_eq_top
    (x : I → G) (hgen : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤)
    (f : G →* H) (g : G) :
    f g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun i => f (x i))
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) := by
    rw [hgen]
    trivial
  induction hg using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩
  | one => simp
  | mul a b _ _ ha hb => simpa using Subgroup.mul_mem _ ha hb
  | inv a _ ha => simpa using Subgroup.inv_mem _ ha

name: T3.closure_range_comp_of_surjective
statement:
theorem closure_range_comp_of_surjective
    (x : I → G) (hgen : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤)
    (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun i => f (x i)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro y _
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hf y
  exact mem_closure_range_of_closure_range_eq_top x hgen f g

name: T3.finite_of_commuting_generators
statement:
theorem finite_of_commuting_generators
    (x : J → G) (hpow : ∀ j, x j ^ 3 = 1)
    (hcomm : IsMulCommutative G)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) : Finite G
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite J
  let : IsMulCommutative G := hcomm
  let K : J → Subgroup G := fun j => Subgroup.zpowers (x j)
  have hfin (j : J) : (K j : Set G).Finite := by
    apply IsOfFinOrder.finite_zpowers
    exact isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨3, by omega, hpow j⟩
  let (j : J) : Finite (K j) := hfin j
  have hcommK : Pairwise fun i j => ∀ a b : G, a ∈ K i → b ∈ K j → Commute a b := by
    intro i j hij a b ha hb
    exact (commute_iff_eq a b).2 (mul_comm' a b)
  let φ : (∀ j, K j) →* G := Subgroup.noncommPiCoprod hcommK
  apply Finite.of_surjective φ
  rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_top]
  dsimp only [φ]
  rw [Subgroup.noncommPiCoprod_range]
  change (⨆ j, Subgroup.zpowers (x j)) = ⊤
  simp_rw [Subgroup.zpowers_eq_closure, ← Subgroup.closure_iUnion]
  simpa only [Set.iUnion_singleton_eq_range] using hgen

name: T3.natCard_le_three_pow_of_commuting_generators
statement:
theorem natCard_le_three_pow_of_commuting_generators
    (x : J → G) (hpow : ∀ j, x j ^ 3 = 1)
    (hcomm : IsMulCommutative G)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) :
    Nat.card G ≤ 3 ^ Nat.card J
proof:
:= by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite J
  let : IsMulCommutative G := hcomm
  let K : J → Subgroup G := fun j => Subgroup.zpowers (x j)
  have hfin (j : J) : (K j : Set G).Finite := by
    apply IsOfFinOrder.finite_zpowers
    exact isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨3, by omega, hpow j⟩
  let (j : J) : Finite (K j) := hfin j
  have hcommK : Pairwise fun i j => ∀ a b : G, a ∈ K i → b ∈ K j → Commute a b := by
    intro i j hij a b ha hb
    exact (commute_iff_eq a b).2 (mul_comm' a b)
  let φ : (∀ j, K j) →* G := Subgroup.noncommPiCoprod hcommK
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_top]
    dsimp only [φ]
    rw [Subgroup.noncommPiCoprod_range]
    change (⨆ j, Subgroup.zpowers (x j)) = ⊤
    simp_rw [Subgroup.zpowers_eq_closure, ← Subgroup.closure_iUnion]
    simpa only [Set.iUnion_singleton_eq_range] using hgen
  calc
    Nat.card G ≤ Nat.card (∀ j, K j) :=
      Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective φ hφ
    _ = ∏ j, Nat.card (K j) := Nat.card_pi
    _ ≤ ∏ _j : J, 3 := by
      gcongr with j
      rw [Nat.card_zpowers]
      exact orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one (by omega) (hpow j)
    _ = 3 ^ Nat.card J := by
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: T3.pow_three_quotient
statement:
theorem pow_three_quotient (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (hG : ∀ g : G, g ^ 3 = 1) (x : G ⧸ N) :
    x ^ 3 = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N x
  rw [← map_pow, hG, map_one]

name: T3.finite_abelianization
statement:
theorem finite_abelianization
    (x : J → G) (hpow : ∀ g : G, g ^ 3 = 1)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) :
    Finite (G ⧸ commutator G)
proof:
:= by
  let q : G →* G ⧸ commutator G := QuotientGroup.mk' (commutator G)
  apply finite_of_commuting_generators (x := fun j => q (x j))
  · exact fun _ => pow_three_quotient (commutator G) hpow _
  · exact Subgroup.Normal.quotient_commutative_iff_commutator_le.mpr le_rfl
  · exact closure_range_comp_of_surjective x hgen q
      (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (commutator G))

name: T3.natCard_abelianization_le_three_pow
statement:
theorem natCard_abelianization_le_three_pow
    (x : J → G) (hpow : ∀ g : G, g ^ 3 = 1)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤) :
    Nat.card (G ⧸ commutator G) ≤ 3 ^ Nat.card J
proof:
:= by
  let q : G →* G ⧸ commutator G := QuotientGroup.mk' (commutator G)
  apply natCard_le_three_pow_of_commuting_generators (x := fun j => q (x j))
  · exact fun _ => pow_three_quotient (commutator G) hpow _
  · exact Subgroup.Normal.quotient_commutative_iff_commutator_le.mpr le_rfl
  · exact closure_range_comp_of_surjective x hgen q
      (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (commutator G))

name: T3.closure_range_subtype
statement:
theorem closure_range_subtype (x : I → G) :
    Subgroup.closure
        (Set.range fun i =>
          (⟨x i, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ :
            Subgroup.closure (Set.range x))) =
      ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let K := Subgroup.closure (Set.range x)
  let y : I → K := fun i => ⟨x i, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  change Subgroup.closure (Set.range y) = ⊤
  rw [← Subgroup.map_subtype_inj, MonoidHom.map_closure]
  have himage : K.subtype '' Set.range y = Set.range x := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [himage, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map, K.range_subtype]

name: T3.IncreasingPair.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {p q : IncreasingPair I} (h₁ : p.first = q.first) (h₂ : p.second = q.second) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  cases q
  subst h₁ h₂
  rfl

name: T3.IncreasingPair.eq_equivPowersetCard_iff
statement:

    s = equivPowersetCard ⟨a, b, hab⟩ ↔
      Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s 0 = a ∧
        Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s 1 = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Equiv.symm_apply_eq, IncreasingPair.ext_iff, equivPowersetCard_symm_first,
    equivPowersetCard_symm_second]

name: T3.IncreasingPair.natCard_eq_choose

name: T3.Free.derivedCommutator_mem_gammaThree
statement:
theorem derivedCommutator_mem_gammaThree (a b c : Free I) :
    derivedCommutator ⁅a, b⁆ c ∈ GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  change ⁅⁅a, b⁆, c⁆ ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2
  rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ,
    Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top a) (Subgroup.mem_top b))
    (Subgroup.mem_top c)

name: T3.Free.generatorPair_mem_increasingPairQuotientClosure
statement:
theorem generatorPair_mem_increasingPairQuotientClosure (i j : I) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I))
        (derivedCommutator (of i) (of j)) ∈
      increasingPairQuotientClosure (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  let K := increasingPairQuotientClosure (I := I)
  let q : Derived (I := I) →* PairQuotient (I := I) :=
    QuotientGroup.mk' (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I))
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    change q (derivedCommutator (of i) (of i)) ∈ K
    rw [show derivedCommutator (of i) (of i) = 1 by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact commutatorElement_self (of i), map_one]
    exact K.one_mem
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hij | hji
  · exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨⟨i, j, hij⟩, rfl⟩
  · have h :
        derivedCommutator (of i) (of j) =
          (derivedCommutator (of j) (of i))⁻¹ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (commutatorElement_inv (of j) (of i)).symm
    rw [h, map_inv]
    exact K.inv_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨⟨j, i, hji⟩, rfl⟩)

name: T3.Free.commutator_mem_increasingPairQuotientClosure
statement:
theorem commutator_mem_increasingPairQuotientClosure (a b : Free I) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)) (derivedCommutator a b) ∈
      increasingPairQuotientClosure (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  let K := increasingPairQuotientClosure (I := I)
  let q : Derived (I := I) →* PairQuotient (I := I) :=
    QuotientGroup.mk' (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I))
  have extend_right (x y : Free I)
      (hbase : ∀ j : I, q (derivedCommutator x (of j)) ∈ K) :
      q (derivedCommutator x y) ∈ K := by
    have hmem := mem_closure_range_of_closure_range_eq_top
      (of : I → Free I) (closure_range_of (I := I))
      (commutatorPairQuotientRightHom x) y
    exact (Subgroup.closure_le K).2 (by
      rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact hbase j) hmem
  have h₁ (i : I) (y : Free I) : q (derivedCommutator (of i) y) ∈ K :=
    extend_right (of i) y fun j => generatorPair_mem_increasingPairQuotientClosure i j
  apply extend_right a b
  intro j
  have h := h₁ j a
  have heq :
      derivedCommutator a (of j) = (derivedCommutator (of j) a)⁻¹ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (commutatorElement_inv (of j) a).symm
  rw [heq, map_inv]
  exact K.inv_mem h

name: T3.Free.closure_range_increasingPairQuotient
statement:
theorem closure_range_increasingPairQuotient :
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range (increasingPairQuotient (I := I))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let K := increasingPairQuotientClosure (I := I)
  let q : Derived (I := I) →* PairQuotient (I := I) :=
    QuotientGroup.mk' (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I))
  apply top_unique
  intro y _
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)) y
  have lift_mem {g : Free I} (hg : g ∈ commutator (Free I)) :
      q ⟨g, hg⟩ ∈ K := by
    induction hg using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem u hu =>
        obtain ⟨a, -, b, -, rfl⟩ := hu
        exact commutator_mem_increasingPairQuotientClosure a b
    | one =>
        change q 1 ∈ K
        rw [map_one]
        exact K.one_mem
    | mul u v huD hvD hu hv =>
        rw [show (⟨u * v, Subgroup.mul_mem _ huD hvD⟩ : Derived (I := I)) =
          (⟨u, huD⟩ : Derived (I := I)) * ⟨v, hvD⟩ by rfl, map_mul]
        exact K.mul_mem hu hv
    | inv u huD hu =>
        rw [show (⟨u⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ huD⟩ : Derived (I := I)) =
          (⟨u, huD⟩ : Derived (I := I))⁻¹ by rfl, map_inv]
        exact K.inv_mem hu
  exact lift_mem d.2

name: T3.Free.tripleCommutator_of_mem_increasingTripleClosure
statement:
theorem tripleCommutator_of_mem_increasingTripleClosure (i j k : I) :
    ⁅⁅of i, of j⁆, of k⁆ ∈ increasingTripleClosure (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  let K := increasingTripleClosure (I := I)
  have hG : ∀ x : Free I, x ^ 3 = 1 := pow_three
  have hcanonical {a b c : I} (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) :
      ⁅⁅of a, of b⁆, of c⁆ ∈ K := by
    apply Subgroup.subset_closure
    exact ⟨⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc⟩, rfl⟩
  have hcyclic {a b c : I} (h : ⁅⁅of a, of b⁆, of c⁆ ∈ K) :
      ⁅⁅of b, of c⁆, of a⁆ ∈ K := by
    rw [← commutator_triple_cyclic hG (of a) (of b) (of c)]
    exact h
  have hswap {a b c : I} (h : ⁅⁅of a, of b⁆, of c⁆ ∈ K) :
      ⁅⁅of b, of a⁆, of c⁆ ∈ K := by
    rw [commutator_triple_swap hG (of b) (of a) (of c)]
    exact K.inv_mem h
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · subst k
    rw [commutator_self_right hG]
    exact K.one_mem
  by_cases hik : i = k
  · subst k
    rw [commutator_triple_cyclic hG, commutator_self_right hG]
    exact K.one_mem
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hij | hji
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hjk with hjk | hkj
    · exact hcanonical hij hjk
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hik with hik | hki
      · exact hcyclic (hswap (hcanonical hik hkj))
      · exact hcyclic (hcanonical hki hij)
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hjk with hjk | hkj
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hik with hik | hki
      · exact hswap (hcanonical hji hik)
      · exact hcyclic (hcyclic (hcanonical hjk hki))
    · exact hswap (hcyclic (hcanonical hkj hji))

name: T3.Free.commutator_triple_mem_increasingTripleClosure
statement:
theorem commutator_triple_mem_increasingTripleClosure (a b c : Free I) :
    ⁅⁅a, b⁆, c⁆ ∈ increasingTripleClosure (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  let K := increasingTripleClosure (I := I)
  have hG : ∀ x : Free I, x ^ 3 = 1 := pow_three
  have extend_right (x y z : Free I)
      (hbase : ∀ k : I, ⁅⁅x, y⁆, of k⁆ ∈ K) :
      ⁅⁅x, y⁆, z⁆ ∈ K := by
    have hmem := mem_closure_range_of_closure_range_eq_top
      (of : I → Free I) (closure_range_of (I := I))
      (commutatorTripleRightHom hG x y) z
    exact (Subgroup.closure_le K).2 (by
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact hbase k) hmem
  have h₁ (i j : I) (z : Free I) : ⁅⁅of i, of j⁆, z⁆ ∈ K :=
    extend_right (of i) (of j) z fun k =>
      tripleCommutator_of_mem_increasingTripleClosure i j k
  have h₂ (i : I) (y z : Free I) : ⁅⁅of i, y⁆, z⁆ ∈ K := by
    apply extend_right (of i) y z
    intro k
    have h := h₁ i k y
    have heq : ⁅⁅of i, y⁆, of k⁆ = ⁅⁅of i, of k⁆, y⁆⁻¹ :=
      mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv.mp (commutator_triple_antisymm hG (of i) (of k) y)
    rw [heq]
    exact K.inv_mem h
  apply extend_right a b c
  intro k
  have h := h₂ k a b
  rw [commutator_triple_cyclic hG (of k) a b] at h
  exact h

name: T3.Free.lowerCentralSeries_two_eq_increasingTripleClosure
statement:
theorem lowerCentralSeries_two_eq_increasingTripleClosure :
    (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2 =
      increasingTripleClosure (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  let K := increasingTripleClosure (I := I)
  have hG : ∀ x : Free I, x ^ 3 = 1 := pow_three
  have hKcenter : K ≤ Subgroup.center (Free I) := by
    change Subgroup.closure (Set.range (increasingTripleCommutator (I := I))) ≤
      Subgroup.center (Free I)
    refine (Subgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact commutator_triple_mem_center hG (of t.first) (of t.second) (of t.third)
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ,
      Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one]
    refine Subgroup.commutator_le.mpr fun d hd g _ => ?_
    induction hd using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem u hu =>
        obtain ⟨p, -, q, -, rfl⟩ := hu
        exact commutator_triple_mem_increasingTripleClosure p q g
    | one => simp
    | mul u v _ _ hu hv =>
        have h : ⁅u * v, g⁆ = ⁅v, g⁆ * ⁅u, g⁆ := by
          rw [commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul,
            Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (hKcenter hv) u]
          group
        rw [h]
        exact K.mul_mem hv hu
    | inv u _ hu =>
        have hc : ⁅g, u⁆ ∈ K := by
          rw [← commutatorElement_inv]
          exact K.inv_mem hu
        have h : ⁅u⁻¹, g⁆ = ⁅g, u⁆ := by
          rw [commutatorElement_inv_left,
            Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (hKcenter hc) u⁻¹]
          group
        rw [h]
        exact hc
  · rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ,
      Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one]
    change Subgroup.closure (Set.range (increasingTripleCommutator (I := I))) ≤
      ⁅commutator (Free I), ⊤⁆
    refine (Subgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
      (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
        (Subgroup.mem_top (of t.first)) (Subgroup.mem_top (of t.second)))
      (Subgroup.mem_top (of t.third))

name: T3.Free.finite_pairQuotient
statement: theorem finite_pairQuotient : Finite (PairQuotient (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (IncreasingPair I) :=
    Finite.of_equiv (Set.powersetCard I 2) IncreasingPair.equivPowersetCard.symm
  apply finite_of_commuting_generators (x := increasingPairQuotient (I := I))
  · intro p
    exact pow_three_quotient (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I))
      (fun d : Derived (I := I) => Subtype.ext (pow_three d.1)) _
  · exact Function.Surjective.isMulCommutative
      (f := QuotientGroup.mk' (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)))
      (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)))
      (isMulCommutative_commutator (G := Free I) pow_three)
  · exact closure_range_increasingPairQuotient

name: T3.Free.natCard_pairQuotient_le
statement:
theorem natCard_pairQuotient_le :
    Nat.card (PairQuotient (I := I)) ≤ 3 ^ (Nat.card I).choose 2
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (IncreasingPair I) :=
    Finite.of_equiv (Set.powersetCard I 2) IncreasingPair.equivPowersetCard.symm
  calc
    Nat.card (PairQuotient (I := I)) ≤ 3 ^ Nat.card (IncreasingPair I) := by
      apply natCard_le_three_pow_of_commuting_generators
          (x := increasingPairQuotient (I := I))
      · intro p
        exact pow_three_quotient (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I))
          (fun d : Derived (I := I) => Subtype.ext (pow_three d.1)) _
      · exact Function.Surjective.isMulCommutative
          (f := QuotientGroup.mk' (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)))
          (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)))
          (isMulCommutative_commutator (G := Free I) pow_three)
      · exact closure_range_increasingPairQuotient
    _ = 3 ^ (Nat.card I).choose 2 := by
      rw [IncreasingPair.natCard_eq_choose]

name: T3.Free.finite_lowerCentralSeries_two
statement:
theorem finite_lowerCentralSeries_two :
    Finite ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2)
proof:
:= by
  let K := increasingTripleClosure (I := I)
  let : Finite (IncreasingTriple I) :=
    Finite.of_equiv (Set.powersetCard I 3) IncreasingTriple.equivPowersetCard.symm
  rw [lowerCentralSeries_two_eq_increasingTripleClosure]
  apply finite_of_commuting_generators
      (x := fun t : IncreasingTriple I =>
        (⟨increasingTripleCommutator t, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩ : K))
  · intro t
    exact Subtype.ext (pow_three (increasingTripleCommutator t))
  · have hKle : K ≤ commutator (Free I) := by
      change increasingTripleClosure (I := I) ≤ commutator (Free I)
      rw [← lowerCentralSeries_two_eq_increasingTripleClosure]
      exact (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries_antitone
        (show 1 ≤ 2 by omega)
    exact ⟨⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext
      (commute_of_mem_commutator pow_three (hKle a.2) (hKle b.2)).eq⟩⟩
  · exact closure_range_subtype (increasingTripleCommutator (I := I))

name: T3.Free.natCard_lowerCentralSeries_two_le
statement:
theorem natCard_lowerCentralSeries_two_le :
    Nat.card ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2) ≤
      3 ^ (Nat.card I).choose 3
proof:
:= by
  let K := increasingTripleClosure (I := I)
  let : Finite (IncreasingTriple I) :=
    Finite.of_equiv (Set.powersetCard I 3) IncreasingTriple.equivPowersetCard.symm
  rw [lowerCentralSeries_two_eq_increasingTripleClosure]
  calc
    Nat.card K ≤ 3 ^ Nat.card (IncreasingTriple I) := by
      apply natCard_le_three_pow_of_commuting_generators
          (x := fun t : IncreasingTriple I =>
            (⟨increasingTripleCommutator t, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩ : K))
      · intro t
        exact Subtype.ext (pow_three (increasingTripleCommutator t))
      · have hKle : K ≤ commutator (Free I) := by
          change increasingTripleClosure (I := I) ≤ commutator (Free I)
          rw [← lowerCentralSeries_two_eq_increasingTripleClosure]
          exact (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries_antitone
            (show 1 ≤ 2 by omega)
        exact ⟨⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext
          (commute_of_mem_commutator pow_three (hKle a.2) (hKle b.2)).eq⟩⟩
      · exact closure_range_subtype (increasingTripleCommutator (I := I))
    _ = 3 ^ (Nat.card I).choose 3 := by
      rw [IncreasingTriple.natCard_eq_choose]

name: T3.Free.finite_gammaThreeInDerived
statement: theorem finite_gammaThreeInDerived : Finite (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  have hle :
      (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2 ≤
        commutator (Free I) :=
    (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries_antitone
      (show 1 ≤ 2 by omega)
  let : Finite ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2) :=
    finite_lowerCentralSeries_two
  exact Finite.of_equiv
    ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2)
    (Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe hle).symm.toEquiv

name: T3.Free.finite_derived
statement: theorem finite_derived : Finite (Derived (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)) := finite_gammaThreeInDerived
  let : Finite (PairQuotient (I := I)) := finite_pairQuotient
  exact Finite.of_subgroup_quotient (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I))

name: T3.Free.natCard_derived_le
statement:
theorem natCard_derived_le :
    Nat.card (Derived (I := I)) ≤
      3 ^ ((Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hle :
      (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2 ≤
        commutator (Free I) :=
    (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries_antitone
      (show 1 ≤ 2 by omega)
  have hcard :
      Nat.card (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)) =
        Nat.card ((⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2) :=
    Nat.card_congr (Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe hle).toEquiv
  rw [Subgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup]
  calc
    Nat.card (PairQuotient (I := I)) * Nat.card (GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)) ≤
        3 ^ (Nat.card I).choose 2 * 3 ^ (Nat.card I).choose 3 := by
      rw [hcard]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul natCard_pairQuotient_le natCard_lowerCentralSeries_two_le
    _ = 3 ^ ((Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3) := by
      rw [pow_add]

name: T3.Free.finite
statement: theorem finite : Finite (Free I)
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (Derived (I := I)) := finite_derived
  let : Finite (Free I ⧸ commutator (Free I)) :=
    finite_abelianization (of : I → Free I) pow_three closure_range_of
  exact Finite.of_subgroup_quotient (commutator (Free I))

name: T3.Free.natCard_le
statement:
theorem natCard_le :
    Nat.card (Free I) ≤
      3 ^ (Nat.card I + (Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup
    (commutator (Free I))]
  calc
    Nat.card (Free I ⧸ commutator (Free I)) *
          Nat.card (commutator (Free I)) ≤
        3 ^ Nat.card I * 3 ^ ((Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3) := by
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul
        (natCard_abelianization_le_three_pow
          (of : I → Free I) pow_three closure_range_of)
        natCard_derived_le
    _ = 3 ^ (Nat.card I + (Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3) := by
      rw [← pow_add, add_assoc]

name: T3.LvdW.triple_inv_mul_eq_zero

proof:
:= by
  let : AddCommGroup (ZMod 3) := (ZMod.commRing 3).toAddCommGroup
  simp only [mul_triple, inv_triple, inv_pair, inv_gen]
  rw [htriple, congrFun hgen a, congrFun hgen b, congrFun hgen c]

name: T3.LvdW.commutator_of_pair_of_lt
statement:
theorem commutator_of_pair_of_lt {i j a b : I} (hij : i < j) (hab : a < b) :
    ⁅of i, of j⁆.pair a b = if a = i ∧ b = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  let : AddCommGroup (ZMod 3) := (ZMod.commRing 3).toAddCommGroup
  rw [commutator_pair]
  have h₂ : (of i).gen b * (of j).gen a = 0 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne b i with rfl | hbi
    · rcases eq_or_ne a j with rfl | haj
      · exact absurd (hij.trans hab) (lt_irrefl _)
      · simp [of_gen_of_ne haj]
    · simp [of_gen_of_ne hbi]
  rw [h₂, sub_zero, of_gen, of_gen]
  by_cases hai : a = i <;> by_cases hbj : b = j <;> simp [hai, hbj]

name: T3.LvdW.triple_commutator_of_triple_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  let : AddCommGroup (ZMod 3) := (ZMod.commRing 3).toAddCommGroup
  rw [triple_commutator_triple]
  have h₁ : (of j).gen c * (of k).gen b = 0 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne c j with rfl | hcj
    · rcases eq_or_ne b k with rfl | hbk
      · exact absurd (hjk.trans hbc) (lt_irrefl _)
      · simp [of_gen_of_ne hbk]
    · simp [of_gen_of_ne hcj]
  have h₂ : (of i).gen b * ((of j).gen a * (of k).gen c - (of j).gen c * (of k).gen a) = 0 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne b i with rfl | hbi
    · have haj : a ≠ j := fun h => lt_asymm hij (h ▸ hab)
      have hak : a ≠ k := fun h => lt_asymm (hij.trans hjk) (h ▸ hab)
      simp [of_gen_of_ne haj, of_gen_of_ne hak]
    · simp [of_gen_of_ne hbi]
  have h₃ : (of i).gen c * ((of j).gen a * (of k).gen b - (of j).gen b * (of k).gen a) = 0 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne c i with rfl | hci
    · have haj : a ≠ j := fun h => lt_asymm hij (h ▸ (hab.trans hbc))
      have hbj : b ≠ j := fun h => lt_asymm hij (h ▸ hbc)
      simp [of_gen_of_ne haj, of_gen_of_ne hbj]
    · simp [of_gen_of_ne hci]
  rw [h₁, sub_zero, h₂, sub_zero, h₃, add_zero, of_gen, of_gen, of_gen]
  by_cases hai : a = i <;> by_cases hbj : b = j <;> by_cases hck : c = k <;>
    simp [hai, hbj, hck]

statement:

    ⁅a, b⁆ ∈ (genReadout (I := I)).ker
proof:
:= by

  exact commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute.mpr (Commute.all _ _)

name: T3.Free.tripleCommutator_mem_pairReadout_ker
statement:
theorem tripleCommutator_mem_pairReadout_ker (i j k : I) :
    (⟨⁅⁅of i, of j⁆, of k⁆, commutator_mem_genReadout_ker _ _⟩ :
        (genReadout (I := I)).ker) ∈ (pairReadout (I := I)).ker
proof:
:= by
