  funext q
  rw [map_commutatorElement, map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of]
  exact LvdW.triple_commutator_pair _ _ _ _ _

name: T3.Free.genReadout_surjective
statement: theorem genReadout_surjective : Function.Surjective (genReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  suffices h : ∃ g, genReadout (I := I) g = Multiplicative.ofAdd v.toAdd by simpa using h
  refine Pi.single_induction (fun w => ∃ g, genReadout (I := I) g = Multiplicative.ofAdd w)
    v.toAdd ⟨1, by rw [map_one, ofAdd_zero]⟩ ?_ ?_
  · rintro f₁ f₂ ⟨g₁, h₁⟩ ⟨g₂, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨g₁ * g₂, by rw [map_mul, h₁, h₂, ← ofAdd_add]⟩
  · intro i m
    refine ⟨of i ^ m.val, ?_⟩
    have hgen : genReadout (I := I) (of i) =
        Multiplicative.ofAdd (Pi.single i (1 : ZMod 3)) := by
      rw [genReadout_apply, toLvdW_of]
      exact congrArg _ (funext fun j => by rw [LvdW.of_gen, Pi.single_apply])
    rw [map_pow, hgen, ← ofAdd_nsmul, val_nsmul_single]

name: T3.Free.pairReadout_surjective
statement: theorem pairReadout_surjective : Function.Surjective (pairReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  suffices h : ∃ g, pairReadout (I := I) g = Multiplicative.ofAdd v.toAdd by simpa using h
  refine Pi.single_induction (fun w => ∃ g, pairReadout (I := I) g = Multiplicative.ofAdd w)
    v.toAdd ⟨1, by rw [map_one, ofAdd_zero]⟩ ?_ ?_
  · rintro f₁ f₂ ⟨g₁, h₁⟩ ⟨g₂, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨g₁ * g₂, by rw [map_mul, h₁, h₂, ← ofAdd_add]⟩
  · intro p m
    refine ⟨(⟨⁅of p.first, of p.second⁆, commutator_mem_genReadout_ker _ _⟩ :
        (genReadout (I := I)).ker) ^ m.val, ?_⟩
    have hbase :
        pairReadout (I := I)
            ⟨⁅of p.first, of p.second⁆, commutator_mem_genReadout_ker _ _⟩ =
          Multiplicative.ofAdd (Pi.single p (1 : ZMod 3)) := by
      rw [pairReadout_apply]
      refine congrArg _ (funext fun q => ?_)
      rw [map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of,
        LvdW.commutator_of_pair_of_lt p.first_lt_second q.first_lt_second, Pi.single_apply]
      simp only [IncreasingPair.ext_iff]
    rw [map_pow, hbase, ← ofAdd_nsmul, val_nsmul_single]

name: T3.Free.tripleReadout_surjective
statement: theorem tripleReadout_surjective : Function.Surjective (tripleReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  suffices h : ∃ g, tripleReadout (I := I) g = Multiplicative.ofAdd v.toAdd by simpa using h
  refine Pi.single_induction (fun w => ∃ g, tripleReadout (I := I) g = Multiplicative.ofAdd w)
    v.toAdd ⟨1, by rw [map_one, ofAdd_zero]⟩ ?_ ?_
  · rintro f₁ f₂ ⟨g₁, h₁⟩ ⟨g₂, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨g₁ * g₂, by rw [map_mul, h₁, h₂, ← ofAdd_add]⟩
  · intro t m
    refine ⟨(⟨⟨⁅⁅of t.first, of t.second⁆, of t.third⁆, commutator_mem_genReadout_ker _ _⟩,
        tripleCommutator_mem_pairReadout_ker _ _ _⟩ :
          (pairReadout (I := I)).ker) ^ m.val, ?_⟩
    have hbase :
        tripleReadout (I := I)
            ⟨⟨⁅⁅of t.first, of t.second⁆, of t.third⁆, commutator_mem_genReadout_ker _ _⟩,
              tripleCommutator_mem_pairReadout_ker _ _ _⟩ =
          Multiplicative.ofAdd (Pi.single t (1 : ZMod 3)) := by
      rw [tripleReadout_apply]
      refine congrArg _ (funext fun s => ?_)
      rw [map_commutatorElement, map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of,
        LvdW.triple_commutator_of_triple_of_lt t.first_lt_second t.second_lt_third
          s.first_lt_second s.second_lt_third,
        Pi.single_apply]
      simp only [IncreasingTriple.ext_iff]
    rw [map_pow, hbase, ← ofAdd_nsmul, val_nsmul_single]

name: T3.Free.card_mult_fun
statement:
private theorem card_mult_fun {α : Type*} [Finite α] :
    Nat.card (Multiplicative (α → ZMod 3)) = 3 ^ Nat.card α
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr Multiplicative.toAdd, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_zmod]

name: T3.Free.card_free_eq_mul
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (Free I) := finite
  rw [Subgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup (genReadout (I := I)).ker,
    Nat.card_congr (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective _ genReadout_surjective).toEquiv,
    card_mult_fun]

name: T3.Free.card_genKer_eq_mul
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (Free I) := finite
  rw [Subgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup (pairReadout (I := I)).ker,
    Nat.card_congr (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective _ pairReadout_surjective).toEquiv,
    card_mult_fun, IncreasingPair.natCard_eq_choose]

name: T3.Free.card_pairKer_eq_mul
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (Free I) := finite
  rw [Subgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup (tripleReadout (I := I)).ker,
    Nat.card_congr
      (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective _ tripleReadout_surjective).toEquiv,
    card_mult_fun, IncreasingTriple.natCard_eq_choose]

name: T3.Free.tripleReadout_ker_eq_bot
statement: theorem tripleReadout_ker_eq_bot : (tripleReadout (I := I)).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (Free I) := finite
  rw [← Subgroup.card_eq_one]
  have hchain : Nat.card (Free I) =
      3 ^ (Nat.card I + (Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3) *
        Nat.card (tripleReadout (I := I)).ker := by
    rw [card_free_eq_mul, card_genKer_eq_mul, card_pairKer_eq_mul, pow_add, pow_add]
    ring
  have hupper := natCard_le (I := I)
  rw [hchain] at hupper
  have hupper' :
      3 ^ (Nat.card I + (Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3) *
          Nat.card (tripleReadout (I := I)).ker ≤
        3 ^ (Nat.card I + (Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3) * 1 := by
    rwa [mul_one]
  have hk₁ : Nat.card (tripleReadout (I := I)).ker ≤ 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hupper' (pow_pos (by norm_num) _)
  have hk₂ : 0 < Nat.card (tripleReadout (I := I)).ker := Nat.card_pos
  omega

name: T3.Free.natCard_genReadout_ker
statement:
theorem natCard_genReadout_ker :
    Nat.card (genReadout (I := I)).ker =
      3 ^ ((Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_genKer_eq_mul, card_pairKer_eq_mul, tripleReadout_ker_eq_bot, Subgroup.card_bot,
    mul_one, pow_add]

name: T3.Free.natCard_pairReadout_ker
statement:
theorem natCard_pairReadout_ker :
    Nat.card (pairReadout (I := I)).ker = 3 ^ (Nat.card I).choose 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_pairKer_eq_mul, tripleReadout_ker_eq_bot, Subgroup.card_bot, mul_one]

name: T3.Free.eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords_of_finite
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords_of_finite {g : Free I}
    (hgen : ∀ i, (toLvdW g).gen i = 0)
    (hpair : ∀ p : IncreasingPair I, (toLvdW g).pair p.first p.second = 0)
    (htriple : ∀ t : IncreasingTriple I, (toLvdW g).triple t.first t.second t.third = 0) :
    g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : g ∈ (genReadout (I := I)).ker := by
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, genReadout_apply, ofAdd_eq_one]
    exact funext fun i => hgen i
  have h₂ : (⟨g, h₁⟩ : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) ∈ (pairReadout (I := I)).ker := by
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, pairReadout_apply, ofAdd_eq_one]
    exact funext fun p => hpair p
  have h₃ : (⟨⟨g, h₁⟩, h₂⟩ : (pairReadout (I := I)).ker) ∈ (tripleReadout (I := I)).ker := by
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, tripleReadout_apply, ofAdd_eq_one]
    exact funext fun t => htriple t
  rw [tripleReadout_ker_eq_bot, Subgroup.mem_bot] at h₃
  exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp (Subtype.ext_iff.mp h₃)

name: T3.Free.toLvdW_injective_of_finite
statement: theorem toLvdW_injective_of_finite : Function.Injective (toLvdW (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff, eq_bot_iff]
  intro g hg
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker] at hg
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  refine eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords_of_finite (fun i => ?_) (fun p => ?_) (fun t => ?_) <;>
    simp [hg]

name: T3.Free.natCard_eq
statement:
theorem natCard_eq :
    Nat.card (Free I) =
      3 ^ (Nat.card I + (Nat.card I).choose 2 + (Nat.card I).choose 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_free_eq_mul, card_genKer_eq_mul, card_pairKer_eq_mul, tripleReadout_ker_eq_bot,
    Subgroup.card_bot, mul_one, pow_add, pow_add]
  ring

name: T3.Free.natCard_eq_pow_freeOrderExponent
statement:
theorem natCard_eq_pow_freeOrderExponent :
    Nat.card (Free I) = 3 ^ freeOrderExponent (Nat.card I)
proof:
:=
  natCard_eq

name: T3.Free.collect_toLvdW_injective_of_finite
statement:
theorem collect_toLvdW_injective_of_finite :
    Function.Injective fun g : Free I => LvdW.collect (toLvdW g)
proof:
:= by
  intro g h hgh
  have hgen : (toLvdW g).gen = (toLvdW h).gen := congrArg Prod.fst hgh
  have hpair : ∀ p : IncreasingPair I,
      (toLvdW g).pair p.first p.second = (toLvdW h).pair p.first p.second :=
    fun p => congrFun (congrArg (fun z => z.2.1) hgh) p
  have htriple : ∀ t : IncreasingTriple I,
      (toLvdW g).triple t.first t.second t.third =
        (toLvdW h).triple t.first t.second t.third :=
    fun t => congrFun (congrArg (fun z => z.2.2) hgh) t
  have key : h⁻¹ * g = 1 := by
    refine eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords_of_finite (fun i => ?_) (fun p => ?_) (fun t => ?_)
    · rw [map_mul, map_inv]
      exact LvdW.gen_inv_mul_eq_zero hgen i
    · rw [map_mul, map_inv]
      exact LvdW.pair_inv_mul_eq_zero hgen (hpair p)
    · rw [map_mul, map_inv]
      exact LvdW.triple_inv_mul_eq_zero hgen (htriple t)
  exact (inv_mul_eq_one.mp key).symm

name: T3.Free.collect_toLvdW_bijective
statement:
theorem collect_toLvdW_bijective :
    Function.Bijective fun g : Free I => LvdW.collect (toLvdW g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.bijective_iff_injective_and_card]
  refine ⟨collect_toLvdW_injective_of_finite, ?_⟩
  rw [natCard_eq, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_fun,
    Nat.card_zmod, IncreasingPair.natCard_eq_choose, IncreasingTriple.natCard_eq_choose,
    pow_add, pow_add]
  ring

name: T3.Free.collectEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem collectEquiv_apply (g : Free I) :
    collectEquiv g = LvdW.collect (toLvdW g)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.Free.collect_bijOn_range
statement:
theorem collect_bijOn_range :
    Set.BijOn (LvdW.collect (I := I)) (Set.range (toLvdW (I := I))) Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x _ => Set.mem_univ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨g, rfl⟩ y ⟨h, rfl⟩ hxy
    exact congrArg toLvdW (collect_toLvdW_injective_of_finite hxy)
  · rintro c -
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := collect_toLvdW_bijective.surjective c
    exact ⟨toLvdW g, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hg⟩

name: T3.Free.genReadout_generatorWord
statement:
theorem genReadout_generatorWord (l : I → ZMod 3) :
    genReadout (generatorWord l) = Multiplicative.ofAdd l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  apply readout_word _ _ ?_ _ (Finset.sort_nodup _ _) (Finset.sort_toFinset _ _)
  intro i
  rw [genReadout_apply, toLvdW_of]
  exact congrArg _ (funext fun j => by rw [LvdW.of_gen, Pi.single_apply])

name: T3.Free.pairReadout_pairWord
statement:
theorem pairReadout_pairWord (m : IncreasingPair I → ZMod 3) :
    pairReadout (pairWord m) = Multiplicative.ofAdd m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite (IncreasingPair I)
  apply readout_word _ _ ?_ _ (Finset.nodup_toList _) (Finset.toList_toFinset _)
  intro p
  rw [pairReadout_apply]
  refine congrArg _ (funext fun q => ?_)
  rw [map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of,
    LvdW.commutator_of_pair_of_lt p.first_lt_second q.first_lt_second, Pi.single_apply]
  simp only [IncreasingPair.ext_iff]

name: T3.Free.tripleReadout_tripleWord
statement:
theorem tripleReadout_tripleWord (n : IncreasingTriple I → ZMod 3) :
    tripleReadout (tripleWord n) = Multiplicative.ofAdd n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite (IncreasingTriple I)
  apply readout_word _ _ ?_ _ (Finset.nodup_toList _) (Finset.toList_toFinset _)
  intro t
  rw [tripleReadout_apply]
  refine congrArg _ (funext fun s => ?_)
  rw [map_commutatorElement, map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of,
    LvdW.triple_commutator_of_triple_of_lt t.first_lt_second t.second_lt_third
      s.first_lt_second s.second_lt_third, Pi.single_apply]
  simp only [IncreasingTriple.ext_iff]

name: T3.Free.genReadout_normalWord
statement:
theorem genReadout_normalWord (l : I → ZMod 3) (m : IncreasingPair I → ZMod 3)
    (n : IncreasingTriple I → ZMod 3) :
    genReadout (normalWord l m n) = Multiplicative.ofAdd l
proof:
:= by
  have hm : genReadout (pairWord m : Free I) = 1 := (pairWord m).property
  have hn : genReadout ((tripleWord n : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) : Free I) = 1 :=
    (tripleWord n).val.property
  rw [normalWord, map_mul, map_mul, genReadout_generatorWord, hm, hn, mul_one, mul_one]

name: T3.Free.normalWord_injective
statement:
theorem normalWord_injective : Function.Injective
    (fun c : (I → ZMod 3) × (IncreasingPair I → ZMod 3) × (IncreasingTriple I → ZMod 3) =>
      normalWord c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨l, m, n⟩ ⟨l', m', n'⟩ h
  have hl : l = l' := by
    have hgen := congrArg genReadout h
    rw [genReadout_normalWord, genReadout_normalWord] at hgen
    exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hgen
  subst l'
  have hp : pairWord m * (tripleWord n : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) =
      pairWord m' * (tripleWord n' : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply mul_left_cancel (a := generatorWord l)
    simpa only [normalWord, mul_assoc, Subgroup.coe_mul] using h
  have hm : m = m' := by
    have hn : pairReadout (tripleWord n : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) = 1 :=
      (tripleWord n).property
    have hn' : pairReadout (tripleWord n' : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) = 1 :=
      (tripleWord n').property
    have hpair := congrArg pairReadout hp
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, pairReadout_pairWord, pairReadout_pairWord, hn, hn',
      mul_one, mul_one] at hpair
    exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hpair
  subst m'
  have ht : tripleWord n = tripleWord n' := Subtype.ext (mul_left_cancel hp)
  have hn := congrArg tripleReadout ht
  rw [tripleReadout_tripleWord, tripleReadout_tripleWord] at hn
  have hn' : n = n' := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hn
  subst n'
  rfl

name: T3.Free.normalWord_bijective
statement:
theorem normalWord_bijective : Function.Bijective
    (fun c : (I → ZMod 3) × (IncreasingPair I → ZMod 3) × (IncreasingTriple I → ZMod 3) =>
      normalWord c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (Free I) := finite
  rw [Nat.bijective_iff_injective_and_card]
  refine ⟨normalWord_injective, ?_⟩
  rw [natCard_eq, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_fun,
    Nat.card_zmod, IncreasingPair.natCard_eq_choose, IncreasingTriple.natCard_eq_choose,
    pow_add, pow_add]
  ring

name: T3.Free.existsUnique_normalWord
statement:
theorem existsUnique_normalWord (g : Free I) :
    ∃! c : (I → ZMod 3) × (IncreasingPair I → ZMod 3) × (IncreasingTriple I → ZMod 3),
      normalWord c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2 = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := normalWord_bijective.surjective g
  exact ⟨c, hc, fun d hd => normalWord_injective (hd.trans hc.symm)⟩

name: T3.LvdW.mem_tripleLayer
statement:
theorem mem_tripleLayer {x : LvdW I} :
    x ∈ tripleLayer ↔ (∀ i, x.gen i = 0) ∧ ∀ i j, x.pair i j = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: T3.Free.gammaThree_le_derived
statement:
theorem gammaThree_le_derived :
    GammaThree (I := I) ≤ commutator (Free I)
proof:
:=
  (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries_antitone (show 1 ≤ 2 by omega)

name: T3.Free.commutator_mem_gammaThree
proof:
:= by
  change ⁅k, w⁆ ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2
  rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 by omega, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ,
    Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator hk (Subgroup.mem_top w)

name: T3.Free.commutator_le_genReadout_ker
statement:
theorem commutator_le_genReadout_ker :
    commutator (Free I) ≤ (genReadout (I := I)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_def]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_le.mpr fun p _ q _ => commutator_mem_genReadout_ker p q

name: T3.Free.toLvdW_gen_eq_zero_of_mem_commutator
statement:
theorem toLvdW_gen_eq_zero_of_mem_commutator {g : Free I}
    (hg : g ∈ commutator (Free I)) : ∀ i, (toLvdW g).gen i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := commutator_le_genReadout_ker hg
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, genReadout_apply, ofAdd_eq_one] at h
  exact fun i => congrFun h i

name: T3.Free.toLvdW_mem_tripleLayer
statement:
theorem toLvdW_mem_tripleLayer {g : Free I} (hg : g ∈ GammaThree (I := I)) :
    toLvdW g ∈ LvdW.tripleLayer (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  have hg' : g ∈ increasingTripleClosure (I := I) := by
    rw [← lowerCentralSeries_two_eq_increasingTripleClosure]
    exact hg
  have hle : increasingTripleClosure (I := I) ≤ (LvdW.tripleLayer (I := I)).comap toLvdW := by
    refine (Subgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subgroup.mem_comap]
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩ <;>
      rw [increasingTripleCommutator, map_commutatorElement, map_commutatorElement,
        toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of]
    · exact LvdW.triple_commutator_gen _ _ _ _
    · exact LvdW.triple_commutator_pair _ _ _ _ _
  exact hle hg'

name: T3.Free.pairWordFinsupp_mem_derived
statement:
theorem pairWordFinsupp_mem_derived (m : IncreasingPair I →₀ ZMod 3) :
    (pairWordFinsupp m : Free I) ∈ Derived (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change pairWordFinsupp m ∈ (Derived (I := I)).comap (genReadout (I := I)).ker.subtype
  unfold pairWordFinsupp
  apply Subgroup.list_prod_mem
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  apply Subgroup.pow_mem
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)

name: T3.Free.tripleWordFinsupp_mem_gammaThree
statement:
theorem tripleWordFinsupp_mem_gammaThree (n : IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3) :
    ((tripleWordFinsupp n : (genReadout (I := I)).ker) : Free I) ∈ GammaThree (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change tripleWordFinsupp n ∈ (GammaThree (I := I)).comap
    ((genReadout (I := I)).ker.subtype.comp (pairReadout (I := I)).ker.subtype)
  unfold tripleWordFinsupp
  apply Subgroup.list_prod_mem
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  apply Subgroup.pow_mem
  exact commutator_mem_gammaThree
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)) _

name: T3.Free.derived_eq_genReadout_ker
statement:
theorem derived_eq_genReadout_ker :
    Derived (I := I) = (genReadout (I := I)).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm commutator_le_genReadout_ker
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨⟨l, m, n⟩, hword⟩ := normalWordFinsupp_surjective g
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, ← hword, genReadout_normalWordFinsupp, ofAdd_eq_one] at hg
  have hl : l = 0 := DFunLike.coe_injective hg
  rw [← hword]
  change normalWordFinsupp l m n ∈ Derived (I := I)
  rw [normalWordFinsupp, hl]
  simpa [generatorWordFinsupp] using (Derived (I := I)).mul_mem
    (pairWordFinsupp_mem_derived m)
    (gammaThree_le_derived (tripleWordFinsupp_mem_gammaThree n))

name: T3.Free.pairReadout_ker_eq_gammaThree
statement:
theorem pairReadout_ker_eq_gammaThree :
    (pairReadout (I := I)).ker =
      (GammaThree (I := I)).comap (genReadout (I := I)).ker.subtype
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    let y : (pairReadout (I := I)).ker := ⟨x, hx⟩
    let n : IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3 := Finsupp.ofSupportFinite
      (fun t => (toLvdW y.val.val).triple t.first t.second t.third)
      (finite_support_triple y.val.val)
    have hn : tripleReadout (tripleWordFinsupp n) = tripleReadout y :=
      tripleReadout_tripleWordFinsupp n
    have hy : tripleWordFinsupp n = y := tripleReadout_injective hn
    have hmem := tripleWordFinsupp_mem_gammaThree n
    rw [hy] at hmem
    exact hmem
  · intro x hx
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, pairReadout_apply, ofAdd_eq_one]
    funext p
    exact (toLvdW_mem_tripleLayer hx).2 p.first p.second

name: T3.Free.genFinsuppReadout_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem genFinsuppReadout_apply (g : Free I) (i : I) :
    (genFinsuppReadout g).toAdd i = (toLvdW g).gen i
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.genFinsuppReadout_eq_one
statement:
theorem genFinsuppReadout_eq_one (g : Free I) :
    genFinsuppReadout g = 1 ↔ genReadout g = 1
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.coe_eq_zero.symm

name: T3.Free.genFinsuppReadout_surjective
statement: theorem genFinsuppReadout_surjective : Function.Surjective (genFinsuppReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  refine ⟨generatorWordFinsupp l.toAdd, ?_⟩
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  ext i
  exact congrFun (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (genReadout_generatorWordFinsupp l.toAdd)) i

name: T3.Free.genFinsuppReadout_ker
statement: theorem genFinsuppReadout_ker : (genFinsuppReadout (I := I)).ker = Derived (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, genFinsuppReadout_eq_one, ← MonoidHom.mem_ker,
    ← derived_eq_genReadout_ker]

name: T3.Free.pairFinsuppReadout_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pairFinsuppReadout_apply (g : Derived (I := I)) (p : IncreasingPair I) :
    (pairFinsuppReadout g).toAdd p = (toLvdW (g : Free I)).pair p.first p.second
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.pairFinsuppReadout_eq_one
statement:
theorem pairFinsuppReadout_eq_one (g : Derived (I := I)) :
    pairFinsuppReadout g = 1 ↔ pairReadout (derivedToGenKer g) = 1
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.coe_eq_zero.symm

name: T3.Free.pairFinsuppReadout_surjective
statement: theorem pairFinsuppReadout_surjective : Function.Surjective (pairFinsuppReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  refine ⟨⟨pairWordFinsupp m.toAdd, pairWordFinsupp_mem_derived m.toAdd⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  ext p
  exact congrFun (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (pairReadout_pairWordFinsupp m.toAdd)) p

name: T3.Free.pairFinsuppReadout_ker
statement:
theorem pairFinsuppReadout_ker :
    (pairFinsuppReadout (I := I)).ker = GammaThreeInDerived (I := I)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, pairFinsuppReadout_eq_one, ← MonoidHom.mem_ker,
    pairReadout_ker_eq_gammaThree]
  rfl

name: T3.Free.tripleFinsuppReadout_apply
statement:
theorem tripleFinsuppReadout_apply (g : GammaThree (I := I)) (t : IncreasingTriple I) :
    (tripleFinsuppReadout g).toAdd t =
      (toLvdW (g : Free I)).triple t.first t.second t.third
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.tripleFinsuppReadout_surjective
statement:
theorem tripleFinsuppReadout_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (tripleFinsuppReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  refine ⟨⟨(tripleWordFinsupp n.toAdd).val.val,
    tripleWordFinsupp_mem_gammaThree n.toAdd⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  ext t
  exact congrFun (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (tripleReadout_tripleWordFinsupp n.toAdd)) t

name: T3.Free.tripleFinsuppReadout_injective
statement: theorem tripleFinsuppReadout_injective : Function.Injective (tripleFinsuppReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  intro g h hgh
  have hread : tripleReadout (gammaThreeToPairKer g) = tripleReadout (gammaThreeToPairKer h) := by
    apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    funext t
    exact congrArg (fun z : Multiplicative (IncreasingTriple I →₀ ZMod 3) => z.toAdd t) hgh
  have hker := tripleReadout_injective hread
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun x : (pairReadout (I := I)).ker => x.val.val) hker)

name: T3.Free.tripleFinsuppReadout_ker
statement: theorem tripleFinsuppReadout_ker : (tripleFinsuppReadout (I := I)).ker = ⊥
proof:
:=
  (tripleFinsuppReadout (I := I)).ker_eq_bot tripleFinsuppReadout_injective

name: T3.Free.layerEquivOfReadout_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem layerEquivOfReadout_mk {J : Type*} (n : ℕ)
    (f : AssociatedGraded.term (Free I) n →* Multiplicative (J →₀ ZMod 3))
    (hker : f.ker = AssociatedGraded.relation (Free I) n) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f)
    (x : AssociatedGraded.term (Free I) n) :
    layerEquivOfReadout n f hker hsurj (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) n x) = (f x).toAdd
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.layerOneReadout_ker
statement:
theorem layerOneReadout_ker :
    (layerOneReadout (I := I)).ker = AssociatedGraded.relation (Free I) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [layerOneReadout, ← MonoidHom.comap_ker, genFinsuppReadout_ker]
  rfl

name: T3.Free.layerOneReadout_surjective
statement: theorem layerOneReadout_surjective : Function.Surjective (layerOneReadout (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := genFinsuppReadout_surjective l
  exact ⟨⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩, hg⟩

name: T3.Free.layerOneEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem layerOneEquiv_mk (x : AssociatedGraded.term (Free I) 1) :
    layerOneEquiv (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 1 x) =
      (genFinsuppReadout (x : Free I)).toAdd
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.layerTwoEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem layerTwoEquiv_mk (x : AssociatedGraded.term (Free I) 2) :
    layerTwoEquiv (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 2 x) = (pairFinsuppReadout x).toAdd
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.relation_three_eq_bot
statement: theorem relation_three_eq_bot : AssociatedGraded.relation (Free I) 3 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  unfold AssociatedGraded.relation
  rw [lowerCentralSeries_three_eq_bot (pow_three (X := I)), MonoidHom.comap_bot]
  exact MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot _ Subtype.val_injective

name: T3.Free.layerThreeEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem layerThreeEquiv_mk (x : AssociatedGraded.term (Free I) 3) :
    layerThreeEquiv (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 3 x) = (tripleFinsuppReadout x).toAdd
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.layerOneEquiv_of
statement:
theorem layerOneEquiv_of (i : I) :
    layerOneEquiv (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 1 ⟨of i, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩) =
      Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [layerOneEquiv_mk, genFinsuppReadout_apply, toLvdW_of, LvdW.of_gen]
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: T3.Free.layerTwoEquiv_commutator
statement:
theorem layerTwoEquiv_commutator (p : IncreasingPair I) :
    layerTwoEquiv (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 2
      (derivedCommutator (of p.first) (of p.second))) = Finsupp.single p 1
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  rw [layerTwoEquiv_mk (derivedCommutator (of p.first) (of p.second)),
    pairFinsuppReadout_apply]
  change (toLvdW ⁅of p.first, of p.second⁆).pair q.first q.second = _
  rw [map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of,
    LvdW.commutator_of_pair_of_lt p.first_lt_second q.first_lt_second, Finsupp.single_apply]
  simp only [IncreasingPair.ext_iff, eq_comm]

name: T3.Free.layerThreeEquiv_tripleCommutator
statement:
theorem layerThreeEquiv_tripleCommutator (t : IncreasingTriple I) :
    layerThreeEquiv (AssociatedGraded.mk (Free I) 3
      ⟨⁅⁅of t.first, of t.second⁆, of t.third⁆,
        commutator_mem_gammaThree
          (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)) _⟩) =
      Finsupp.single t 1
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [layerThreeEquiv_mk, tripleFinsuppReadout_apply]
  rw [map_commutatorElement, map_commutatorElement, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of, toLvdW_of,
    LvdW.triple_commutator_of_triple_of_lt t.first_lt_second t.second_lt_third
      s.first_lt_second s.second_lt_third, Finsupp.single_apply]
  simp only [IncreasingTriple.ext_iff, eq_comm]

name: T3.pow_mem_powerSubgroup
statement: theorem pow_mem_powerSubgroup (g : G) : g ^ n ∈ powerSubgroup G n
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨g, rfl⟩

name: T3.powerSubgroup_le_iff
statement:
theorem powerSubgroup_le_iff {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal] :
    powerSubgroup G n ≤ N ↔ ∀ g : G, g ^ n ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h g ↦ h (pow_mem_powerSubgroup G n g)
  · exact fun h ↦ Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal fun _ ⟨g, hg⟩ ↦ hg ▸ h g

name: T3.powerSubgroup_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem powerSubgroup_le_ker_iff {H : Type v} [Group H] (f : G →* H) :
    powerSubgroup G n ≤ f.ker ↔ ∀ g : G, f g ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerSubgroup_le_iff]
  simp

name: T3.powerQuotientMk_surjective
statement: theorem powerQuotientMk_surjective : Function.Surjective (powerQuotientMk (G := G) (n := n))
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: T3.powerQuotientMk_pow_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerQuotientMk_pow_eq_one (g : G) : powerQuotientMk (G := G) (n := n) g ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pow]
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (g ^ n)).2 (pow_mem_powerSubgroup G n g)

name: T3.powerQuotient_hasExponent
statement: theorem powerQuotient_hasExponent : ∀ q : PowerQuotient G n, q ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := powerQuotientMk_surjective (G := G) (n := n) q
  exact powerQuotientMk_pow_eq_one g

name: T3.powerQuotientLift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerQuotientLift_mk {H : Type v} [Group H] (f : G →* H)
    (h : ∀ g : G, f g ^ n = 1) (g : G) :
    powerQuotientLift f h (powerQuotientMk (G := G) (n := n) g) = f g
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.powerQuotientMk_comp_injective_of_retraction
statement:
theorem powerQuotientMk_comp_injective_of_retraction {Q : Type v} [Group Q]
    (i : Q →* G) (r : G →* Q) (hri : r.comp i = MonoidHom.id Q)
    (hQ : ∀ q : Q, q ^ n = 1) :
    Function.Injective ((powerQuotientMk (G := G) (n := n)).comp i)
proof:
:= by
  let rbar : PowerQuotient G n →* Q := powerQuotientLift r fun g ↦ hQ (r g)
  apply
    (show Function.LeftInverse rbar ((powerQuotientMk (G := G) (n := n)).comp i) from
      ?_).injective
  intro q
  change r (i q) = q
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hri q

name: T3.Free.pow_three
statement: theorem pow_three (g : Free X) : g ^ 3 = 1
proof:
:=
  by apply powerQuotient_hasExponent

name: T3.Free.lift_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_of (hH : ∀ h : H, h ^ 3 = 1) (f : X → H) (x : X) :
    lift hH f (of x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [of, lift, powerQuotientLift_mk, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]

name: T3.Free.hom_ext
statement: theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : Free X →* H} (h : ∀ x : X, φ (of x) = ψ (of x)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : φ.comp (powerQuotientMk (G := FreeGroup X) (n := 3))
      = ψ.comp (powerQuotientMk (G := FreeGroup X) (n := 3)) :=
    FreeGroup.ext_hom _ _ h
  refine MonoidHom.ext fun g => ?_
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := powerQuotientMk_surjective (G := FreeGroup X) (n := 3) g
  exact congrArg (fun k : FreeGroup X →* H => k g) hcomp

name: T3.Free.map_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_of (f : X → Y) (x : X) : map f (of x) = of (f x)
proof:
:=
  lift_of _ _ x

name: T3.Free.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map (id : X → X) = MonoidHom.id (Free X)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun x => map_of _ x

name: T3.Free.map_comp
statement: theorem map_comp (f : X → Y) (g : Y → Z) : (map g).comp (map f) = map (g ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun x => by
    rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, map_of, map_of, map_of, Function.comp_apply]

name: T3.Free.map_injective_of_leftInverse
statement:
theorem map_injective_of_leftInverse {f : X → Y} {r : Y → X}
    (hr : Function.LeftInverse r f) : Function.Injective (map f)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ g : Free X, map r (map f g) = g := by
    intro g
    have h : (map r).comp (map f) = MonoidHom.id (Free X) := by
      rw [map_comp, show r ∘ f = id from funext hr, map_id]
    exact congrArg (fun k : Free X →* Free X => k g) h
  intro a b hab
  rw [← hcomp a, hab, hcomp b]

name: T3.Free.toLvdW_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLvdW_of (i : I) : toLvdW (Free.of i) = LvdW.of i
proof:
:=
  Free.lift_of _ _ i

name: T3.Free.commutator_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem commutator_of_ne_one {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ⁅Free.of i, Free.of j⁆ ≠ (1 : Free I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro h
  have hmap : ⁅LvdW.of i, LvdW.of j⁆ = (1 : LvdW I) := by
    rw [← toLvdW_of i, ← toLvdW_of j, ← map_commutatorElement, h, map_one]
  have hcoord := LvdW.commutator_pair (LvdW.of i) (LvdW.of j) i j
  rw [hmap, LvdW.one_pair, LvdW.of_gen_self, LvdW.of_gen_self, LvdW.of_gen_of_ne hij,
    LvdW.of_gen_of_ne hij.symm] at hcoord
  exact zero_ne_one (by linear_combination hcoord)

name: T3.Free.triple_commutator_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem triple_commutator_of_ne_one {i j k : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    ⁅⁅Free.of i, Free.of j⁆, Free.of k⁆ ≠ (1 : Free I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro h
  refine LvdW.triple_commutator_of_ne_one hij hik hjk ?_
  rw [← toLvdW_of i, ← toLvdW_of j, ← toLvdW_of k, ← map_commutatorElement,
    ← map_commutatorElement, h, map_one]

name: T3.Free.lowerCentralSeries_two_ne_bot
statement:
theorem lowerCentralSeries_two_ne_bot {i j k : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (⊤ : Subgroup (Free I)).lowerCentralSeries 2 ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine triple_commutator_of_ne_one hij hik hjk ?_
  rw [← Subgroup.mem_bot, ← h]
  simp only [Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_zero]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _))
    (Subgroup.mem_top _)

name: T3.LvdW.three_eq_zero
statement: protected theorem three_eq_zero : (3 : ZMod 3) = 0
proof: := by decide

name: T3.LvdW.mul_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_gen (x y : LvdW I) (i : I) : (x * y).gen i = x.gen i + y.gen i
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.mul_pair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_pair (x y : LvdW I) (i j : I) :
    (x * y).pair i j = x.pair i j + y.pair i j - x.gen j * y.gen i
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.mul_triple
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_triple (x y : LvdW I) (i j k : I) :
    (x * y).triple i j k =
      x.triple i j k + y.triple i j k + x.pair i j * y.gen k - x.pair i k * y.gen j
        + (x.pair j k - x.gen j * x.gen k - x.gen j * y.gen k + x.gen k * y.gen j) * y.gen i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.LvdW.one_gen
statement: @[simp] theorem one_gen (i : I) : (1 : LvdW I).gen i = 0
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.one_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem one_pair (i j : I) : (1 : LvdW I).pair i j = 0
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.one_triple
statement: @[simp] theorem one_triple (i j k : I) : (1 : LvdW I).triple i j k = 0
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.inv_gen
statement: @[simp] theorem inv_gen (x : LvdW I) (i : I) : x⁻¹.gen i = -x.gen i
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.inv_pair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_pair (x : LvdW I) (i j : I) : x⁻¹.pair i j = -x.pair i j - x.gen i * x.gen j
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.inv_triple
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_triple (x : LvdW I) (i j k : I) :
    x⁻¹.triple i j k =
      -x.triple i j k + x.pair i j * x.gen k - x.pair i k * x.gen j + x.pair j k * x.gen i
        - x.gen i * x.gen j * x.gen k
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.LvdW.mul_assoc'
statement: protected theorem mul_assoc' (x y z : LvdW I) : x * y * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  refine LvdW.ext (funext fun i => ?_) (funext fun i => funext fun j => ?_)
    (funext fun i => funext fun j => funext fun k => ?_)
  · simp only [mul_gen]; ring
  · simp only [mul_gen, mul_pair]; ring
  · simp only [mul_gen, mul_pair, mul_triple]
    linear_combination (-(x.gen k * y.gen j * z.gen i)) * LvdW.three_eq_zero

name: T3.LvdW.one_mul'
statement: protected theorem one_mul' (x : LvdW I) : 1 * x = x
proof:
:= by
  refine LvdW.ext (funext fun i => ?_) (funext fun i => funext fun j => ?_)
    (funext fun i => funext fun j => funext fun k => ?_)
  · simp only [mul_gen, one_gen]; ring
  · simp only [mul_pair, one_gen, one_pair]; ring
  · simp only [mul_triple, one_gen, one_pair, one_triple]; ring

name: T3.LvdW.inv_mul_cancel'
statement: protected theorem inv_mul_cancel' (x : LvdW I) : x⁻¹ * x = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine LvdW.ext (funext fun i => ?_) (funext fun i => funext fun j => ?_)
    (funext fun i => funext fun j => funext fun k => ?_)
  · simp only [mul_gen, inv_gen, one_gen]; ring
  · simp only [mul_pair, inv_gen, inv_pair, one_pair]; ring
  · simp only [mul_triple, inv_gen, inv_pair, inv_triple, one_triple]
    linear_combination (-(x.gen i * x.gen j * x.gen k)) * LvdW.three_eq_zero

name: T3.LvdW.pow_three
statement: theorem pow_three (x : LvdW I) : x ^ 3 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, pow_one]
  refine LvdW.ext (funext fun i => ?_) (funext fun i => funext fun j => ?_)
    (funext fun i => funext fun j => funext fun k => ?_)
  · simp only [mul_gen, one_gen]
    linear_combination (x.gen i) * LvdW.three_eq_zero
  · simp only [mul_gen, mul_pair, one_pair]
    linear_combination (x.pair i j - x.gen i * x.gen j) * LvdW.three_eq_zero
  · simp only [mul_gen, mul_pair, mul_triple, one_triple]
    linear_combination (x.triple i j k + x.gen i * x.pair j k - x.gen j * x.pair i k
      + x.gen k * x.pair i j - 2 * (x.gen i * x.gen j * x.gen k)) * LvdW.three_eq_zero

name: T3.LvdW.commutator_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem commutator_gen (x y : LvdW I) (i : I) : ⁅x, y⁆.gen i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutatorElement_def, mul_gen, inv_gen]; ring

name: T3.LvdW.commutator_pair
statement:
theorem commutator_pair (x y : LvdW I) (i j : I) :
    ⁅x, y⁆.pair i j = x.gen i * y.gen j - x.gen j * y.gen i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutatorElement_def, mul_gen, mul_pair, inv_gen, inv_pair]; ring

name: T3.LvdW.triple_commutator_gen
statement: theorem triple_commutator_gen (x y z : LvdW I) (i : I) : ⁅⁅x, y⁆, z⁆.gen i = 0
proof:
:=
  commutator_gen _ z i

name: T3.LvdW.triple_commutator_pair
statement: theorem triple_commutator_pair (x y z : LvdW I) (i j : I) : ⁅⁅x, y⁆, z⁆.pair i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_pair, commutator_gen, commutator_gen]; ring

name: T3.LvdW.triple_commutator_triple
statement:
theorem triple_commutator_triple (x y z : LvdW I) (i j k : I) :
    ⁅⁅x, y⁆, z⁆.triple i j k =
      x.gen i * (y.gen j * z.gen k - y.gen k * z.gen j)
        - x.gen j * (y.gen i * z.gen k - y.gen k * z.gen i)
        + x.gen k * (y.gen i * z.gen j - y.gen j * z.gen i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutatorElement_def, mul_gen, mul_pair, mul_triple, inv_gen, inv_pair, inv_triple]
  ring

name: T3.LvdW.of_gen
statement: theorem of_gen (i j : I) : (of i).gen j = if j = i then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.of_gen_self
statement: @[simp] theorem of_gen_self (i : I) : (of i).gen i = 1
proof: := ite_eq_left rfl

name: T3.LvdW.of_gen_of_ne
statement: theorem of_gen_of_ne {i j : I} (h : j ≠ i) : (of i).gen j = 0
proof: := ite_eq_right h

name: T3.LvdW.of_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem of_pair (i j k : I) : (of i).pair j k = 0
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.of_triple
statement: @[simp] theorem of_triple (i j k l : I) : (of i).triple j k l = 0
proof: := rfl

name: T3.LvdW.triple_commutator_of_triple
statement:
theorem triple_commutator_of_triple {i j k : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    ⁅⁅of i, of j⁆, of k⁆.triple i j k = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [triple_commutator_triple, of_gen_self, of_gen_self, of_gen_self,
    of_gen_of_ne hij.symm, of_gen_of_ne hik.symm, of_gen_of_ne hij, of_gen_of_ne hjk.symm,
    of_gen_of_ne hik, of_gen_of_ne hjk]
  ring

name: T3.LvdW.triple_commutator_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem triple_commutator_of_ne_one {i j k : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    ⁅⁅of i, of j⁆, of k⁆ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := triple_commutator_of_triple hij hik hjk
  rw [h, one_triple] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: T3.Free.sigmaOne_mapLayer_of_basis
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_mapLayer_of_basis
    (h : ∀ i, sigmaOne c (mapLayer φ 1 (layerOneBasis i)) =
      (exteriorPower.oneEquiv (ZMod 3) W).symm (f (b i)))
    (x : Layer (Free I) 1) :
    sigmaOne c (mapLayer φ 1 x) = exteriorPower.map 1 f (sigmaOne b x)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (sigmaOne c).toLinearMap.comp (mapLayer φ 1) =
      (exteriorPower.map 1 f).comp (sigmaOne b).toLinearMap := by
    apply (layerOneBasis (I := I)).ext
    intro i
    change sigmaOne c (mapLayer φ 1 (layerOneBasis i)) =
      exteriorPower.map 1 f (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis i))
    rw [h, layerOneBasis_apply, sigmaOne_of, exteriorPower_map_oneEquiv_symm]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he x

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_mapLayer
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_mapLayer
    (h : ∀ x, sigmaOne c (mapLayer φ 1 x) = exteriorPower.map 1 f (sigmaOne b x))
    (x : Layer (Free I) 2) :
    sigmaTwo c (mapLayer φ 2 x) = exteriorPower.map 2 f (sigmaTwo b x)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (sigmaTwo c).toLinearMap.comp (mapLayer φ 2) =
      (exteriorPower.map 2 f).comp (sigmaTwo b).toLinearMap := by
    apply (layerTwoBasis (I := I)).ext
    intro p
    change sigmaTwo c (mapLayer φ 2 (layerTwoBasis p)) =
      exteriorPower.map 2 f (sigmaTwo b (layerTwoBasis p))
    rw [layerTwoBasis_eq_bracket, mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 1) (j := 1),
      sigmaTwo_bracketLayer, sigmaTwo_bracketLayer, h, h,
      exteriorPower_map_gradedMul (i := 1) (j := 1)]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he x

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_mapLayer
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_mapLayer
    (h : ∀ x, sigmaOne c (mapLayer φ 1 x) = exteriorPower.map 1 f (sigmaOne b x))
    (x : Layer (Free I) 3) :
    sigmaThree c (mapLayer φ 3 x) = exteriorPower.map 3 f (sigmaThree b x)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Basis (IncreasingTriple I) (ZMod 3) (Layer (Free I) 3) := Basis.ofRepr layerThreeEquiv
  have hb (t : IncreasingTriple I) : e t = bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
      (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (layerOneBasis t.first) (layerOneBasis t.second))
      (layerOneBasis t.third) := by
    apply layerThreeEquiv.injective
    rw [layerOneBasis_apply, layerOneBasis_apply, layerOneBasis_apply, bracketLayer_mk,
      bracketLayer_mk]
    change layerThreeEquiv (layerThreeEquiv.symm _) = _
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact (layerThreeEquiv_tripleCommutator t).symm
  have he : (sigmaThree c).toLinearMap.comp (mapLayer φ 3) =
      (exteriorPower.map 3 f).comp (sigmaThree b).toLinearMap := by
    apply e.ext
    intro t
    change sigmaThree c (mapLayer φ 3 (e t)) = exteriorPower.map 3 f (sigmaThree b (e t))
    rw [hb, mapLayer_bracketLayer (i := 2) (j := 1), sigmaThree_bracketLayer,
      sigmaThree_bracketLayer, sigmaTwo_mapLayer b c φ f h, h,
      exteriorPower_map_gradedMul (i := 2) (j := 1)]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he x

name: T3.Free.sigmaOne_map_inl
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_map_inl (x : Layer (Free I) 1) :
    sigmaOne (b.prod c) (mapLayer (map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 1 x) =
      exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inl (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaOne b x)
proof:
:= by
  apply sigmaOne_mapLayer_of_basis
  intro i
  rw [layerOneBasis_apply, mapLayer_mk]
  change sigmaOne (b.prod c) (mk (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1 ⟨map Sum.inl (of i), _⟩) = _
  rw [map_of, sigmaOne_of, Basis.prod_apply]
  rfl

name: T3.Free.sigmaOne_map_inr
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_map_inr (x : Layer (Free J) 1) :
    sigmaOne (b.prod c) (mapLayer (map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 1 x) =
      exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inr (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaOne c x)
proof:
:= by
  apply sigmaOne_mapLayer_of_basis
  intro j
  rw [layerOneBasis_apply, mapLayer_mk]
  change sigmaOne (b.prod c) (mk (Free (I ⊕ J)) 1 ⟨map Sum.inr (of j), _⟩) = _
  rw [map_of, sigmaOne_of, Basis.prod_apply]
  rfl

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_map_inl
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_map_inl (x : Layer (Free I) 2) :
    sigmaTwo (b.prod c) (mapLayer (map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 2 x) =
      exteriorPower.map 2 (LinearMap.inl (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaTwo b x)
proof:
:=
  sigmaTwo_mapLayer b (b.prod c) _ _ (sigmaOne_map_inl b c) x

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_map_inr
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_map_inr (x : Layer (Free J) 2) :
    sigmaTwo (b.prod c) (mapLayer (map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 2 x) =
      exteriorPower.map 2 (LinearMap.inr (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaTwo c x)
proof:
:=
  sigmaTwo_mapLayer c (b.prod c) _ _ (sigmaOne_map_inr b c) x

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_map_inl
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_map_inl (x : Layer (Free I) 3) :
    sigmaThree (b.prod c) (mapLayer (map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 3 x) =
      exteriorPower.map 3 (LinearMap.inl (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaThree b x)
proof:
:=
  sigmaThree_mapLayer b (b.prod c) _ _ (sigmaOne_map_inl b c) x

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_map_inr
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_map_inr (x : Layer (Free J) 3) :
    sigmaThree (b.prod c) (mapLayer (map (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)) 3 x) =
      exteriorPower.map 3 (LinearMap.inr (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaThree c x)
proof:
:=
  sigmaThree_mapLayer c (b.prod c) _ _ (sigmaOne_map_inr b c) x

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_bracket_factors
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_bracket_factors (x : Layer (Free I) 1) (y : Layer (Free J) 1) :
    sigmaTwo (b.prod c) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
      (mapLayer (map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 1 x) (mapLayer (map Sum.inr) 1 y)) =
      gradedMul (exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inl (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaOne b x))
        (exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inr (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaOne c y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaTwo_bracketLayer, sigmaOne_map_inl, sigmaOne_map_inr]

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_bracket_factors_two_one
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_bracket_factors_two_one (q : Layer (Free I) 2) (y : Layer (Free J) 1) :
    sigmaThree (b.prod c) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
      (mapLayer (map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 2 q) (mapLayer (map Sum.inr) 1 y)) =
      gradedMul (exteriorPower.map 2 (LinearMap.inl (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaTwo b q))
        (exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inr (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaOne c y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaThree_bracketLayer, sigmaTwo_map_inl, sigmaOne_map_inr]

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_bracket_factors_one_two
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_bracket_factors_one_two (x : Layer (Free I) 1) (q : Layer (Free J) 2) :
    sigmaThree (b.prod c) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
      (mapLayer (map (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)) 1 x) (mapLayer (map Sum.inr) 2 q)) =
      -gradedMul (exteriorPower.map 1 (LinearMap.inl (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaOne b x))
        (exteriorPower.map 2 (LinearMap.inr (ZMod 3) V W) (sigmaTwo c q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracketLayer_one_two, map_neg, sigmaThree_bracketLayer,
    sigmaTwo_map_inr, sigmaOne_map_inl, gradedMul_one_two_comm]

name: T3.Free.pairedCommutator_mem_commutator
statement:
theorem pairedCommutator_mem_commutator (n : ℕ) :
    pairedCommutator n ∈ commutator (Free ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.list_prod_mem
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)

name: T3.Free.sigmaOne_layerOneBasis
statement:
private theorem sigmaOne_layerOneBasis (x : Layer (Free ℕ) 1) :
    sigmaOne (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ)) x = (exteriorPower.oneEquiv (ZMod 3) _).symm x
proof:
:= by
  change (exteriorPower.oneEquiv (ZMod 3) _).symm
    (layerOneEquiv.symm (layerOneEquiv x)) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_pairedCommutator
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_pairedCommutator (n : ℕ) :
    sigmaTwo (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ))
      (mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨pairedCommutator n, pairedCommutator_mem_commutator n⟩) =
      exteriorPower.pairedForm (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ)) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change sigmaTwo _ 0 = _
    simp [exteriorPower.pairedForm]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hp : pairedCommutator (n + 1) =
        pairedCommutator n * ⁅of (2 * n), of (2 * n + 1)⁆ := by
      simp [pairedCommutator, List.range_succ]
    have hm : (⟨pairedCommutator (n + 1), pairedCommutator_mem_commutator (n + 1)⟩ :
        term (Free ℕ) 2) = ⟨pairedCommutator n, pairedCommutator_mem_commutator n⟩ *
          ⟨⁅of (2 * n), of (2 * n + 1)⁆,
            Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext hp
    have hc : sigmaTwo (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ))
        (mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨⁅of (2 * n), of (2 * n + 1)⁆,
          Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top _) (Subgroup.mem_top _)⟩) =
        wedgeVV (ZMod 3) _ (layerOneBasis (2 * n)) (layerOneBasis (2 * n + 1)) :=
      sigmaTwo_commutator (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ)) ⟨2 * n, 2 * n + 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hm, mk_mul, map_add, ih, hc]
    simp [exteriorPower.pairedForm, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: T3.Free.pairedCommutator_ne_one
statement: theorem pairedCommutator_ne_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : pairedCommutator n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hz : (mk (Free ℕ) 2
      ⟨pairedCommutator n, pairedCommutator_mem_commutator n⟩) = 0 := by
    apply (mk_eq_zero _ _ _).mpr
    change pairedCommutator n ∈ _
    rw [h]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  have heq := sigmaTwo_pairedCommutator n
  rw [hz, map_zero] at heq
  exact exteriorPower.pairedForm_ne_zero (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ)) hn heq.symm

name: T3.Free.first_mk_mem_range
statement:
private theorem first_mk_mem_range (D : Subgroup (Free ℕ)) (a : Free ℕ) (ha : a ∈ D) :
    mk (Free ℕ) 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩ ∈ LinearMap.range (mapLayer D.subtype 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mk D 1 ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [mapLayer_mk]
  rfl

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_mem_wedgeSpan
statement:
private theorem sigmaTwo_mem_wedgeSpan (D : Subgroup (Free ℕ))
    {a : Free ℕ} (ha : a ∈ D.lowerCentralSeries 1) :
    sigmaTwo (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ))
      (mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨a, (Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono 1 (show D ≤ ⊤ from le_top)) ha⟩) ∈
      exteriorPower.wedgeSpan (LinearMap.range (mapLayer D.subtype 1))
proof:
:= by
  change a ∈ ⁅D, D⁆ at ha
  induction ha using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem a ha =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := ha
    have heq := sigmaTwo_bracketLayer (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ))
      (mk (Free ℕ) 1 ⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩)
      (mk (Free ℕ) 1 ⟨y, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩)
    rw [bracketLayer_mk, sigmaOne_layerOneBasis, sigmaOne_layerOneBasis] at heq
    change sigmaTwo (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ))
      (mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨⁅x, y⁆, _⟩) =
        wedgeVV (ZMod 3) _ (mk (Free ℕ) 1 ⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩)
          (mk (Free ℕ) 1 ⟨y, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩) at heq
    rw [heq]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, first_mk_mem_range D x hx,
      _, first_mk_mem_range D y hy, rfl⟩
  | one =>
    change sigmaTwo _ 0 ∈ _
    simp
  | mul a b ha hb hia hib =>
    have ham : a ∈ term (Free ℕ) 2 :=
      Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono 1 (show D ≤ ⊤ from le_top) ha
    have hbm : b ∈ term (Free ℕ) 2 :=
      Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono 1 (show D ≤ ⊤ from le_top) hb
    have hm : (mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨a * b, (term (Free ℕ) 2).mul_mem ham hbm⟩) =
        mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨a, ham⟩ + mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨b, hbm⟩ := rfl
    rw [hm, map_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hia hib
  | inv a ha hia =>
    have ham : a ∈ term (Free ℕ) 2 :=
      Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono 1 (show D ≤ ⊤ from le_top) ha
    have hi : (mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨a⁻¹, (term (Free ℕ) 2).inv_mem ham⟩) =
        -mk (Free ℕ) 2 ⟨a, ham⟩ := rfl
    rw [hi, map_neg]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ hia

name: T3.Free.pairedCommutator_rank_le
statement:
theorem pairedCommutator_rank_le (D : Subgroup (Free ℕ)) [Group.FG D] (n : ℕ)
    (h : pairedCommutator n ∈ D.lowerCentralSeries 1) : 2 * n ≤ Group.rank D
proof:
:= by
  have hw := sigmaTwo_mem_wedgeSpan D h
  rw [sigmaTwo_pairedCommutator] at hw
  exact (exteriorPower.pairedForm_finrank_le (layerOneBasis (I := ℕ)) hw).trans
    ((LinearMap.finrank_range_le (mapLayer D.subtype 1)).trans finrank_layerOne_le_rank)

name: T3.Free.pairedCommutator_cardinalRank_le
statement:
theorem pairedCommutator_cardinalRank_le (D : Subgroup (Free ℕ)) (n : ℕ)
    (h : pairedCommutator n ∈ D.lowerCentralSeries 1) :
    ((2 * n : ℕ) : Cardinal) ≤ Group.cardinalRank D
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfin : Group.FG D
  · let := hfin
    rw [Group.cardinalRank_eq_rank]
    exact_mod_cast pairedCommutator_rank_le D n h
  · exact Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0.le.trans
      (not_lt.mp (fun hh => hfin ((Group.cardinalRank_lt_aleph0_iff D).mp hh)))

name: T3.gradedMulLinear_apply
statement:
theorem gradedMulLinear_apply {i j : ℕ} (x : ⋀[R]^i V) (y : ⋀[R]^j V) :
    gradedMulLinear x y = gradedMul x y
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Free.layerOneBasis_apply
statement:
theorem layerOneBasis_apply (i : I) :
    layerOneBasis i = mk (Free I) 1 ⟨of i, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply layerOneEquiv.injective
  change layerOneEquiv (layerOneEquiv.symm _) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, layerOneEquiv_of]

name: T3.Free.layerTwoBasis_apply
statement:
theorem layerTwoBasis_apply (p : IncreasingPair I) :
    layerTwoBasis p = mk (Free I) 2 (derivedCommutator (of p.first) (of p.second))
proof:
:= by
  apply layerTwoEquiv.injective
  change layerTwoEquiv (layerTwoEquiv.symm _) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, layerTwoEquiv_commutator]

name: T3.Free.layerTwoBasis_eq_bracket
statement:
theorem layerTwoBasis_eq_bracket (p : IncreasingPair I) :
    layerTwoBasis p = bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
      (layerOneBasis p.first) (layerOneBasis p.second)
proof:
:= by
  rw [layerTwoBasis_apply, layerOneBasis_apply, layerOneBasis_apply, bracketLayer_mk]
  rfl

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_bracketLayer_basis_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [layerOneBasis_apply, layerOneBasis_apply, sigmaOne_of, sigmaOne_of, bracketLayer_mk]
  exact sigmaTwo_commutator b ⟨i, j, hij⟩

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_bracketLayer_basis
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hij | rfl | hji
  · exact sigmaTwo_bracketLayer_basis_of_lt b hij
  · rw [bracketLayer_one_self, map_zero, gradedMul_one_self]
  · rw [bracketLayer_one_swap, map_neg, sigmaTwo_bracketLayer_basis_of_lt b hji]
    exact (gradedMul_one_swap _ _).symm

name: T3.Free.sigmaTwo_bracketLayer
statement:
theorem sigmaTwo_bracketLayer (x y : Layer (Free I) 1) :
    sigmaTwo b (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) x y) =
      gradedMul (sigmaOne b x) (sigmaOne b y)
proof:
:= by
  let left := (bracketLayer (G := Free I) (i := 1) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)).compr₂
    (sigmaTwo b).toLinearMap
  let right := gradedMulLinear.compl₁₂ (sigmaOne b).toLinearMap (sigmaOne b).toLinearMap
  have h : left = right := by
    apply (layerOneBasis (I := I)).ext
    intro i
    apply (layerOneBasis (I := I)).ext
    intro j
    exact sigmaTwo_bracketLayer_basis b i j
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun h x) y

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_triple_basis_of_lt
statement:
private theorem sigmaThree_triple_basis_of_lt {i j k : I} (hij : i < j) (hjk : j < k) :
    sigmaThree b (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
      (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (layerOneBasis i) (layerOneBasis j))
      (layerOneBasis k)) =
      gradedMul (gradedMul (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis i)) (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis j)))
        (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [layerOneBasis_apply, layerOneBasis_apply, layerOneBasis_apply,
    sigmaOne_of, sigmaOne_of, sigmaOne_of, bracketLayer_mk, bracketLayer_mk]
  exact sigmaThree_tripleCommutator b ⟨i, j, k, hij, hjk⟩

name: T3.Free.triple_swap_last
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracketLayer_triple_cyclic x y z, bracketLayer_one_swap y z, map_neg,
    LinearMap.neg_apply, ← bracketLayer_triple_cyclic x z y]

name: T3.Free.exterior_triple_swap_last
statement:
private theorem exterior_triple_swap_last (x y z : ⋀[ZMod 3]^1 V) :
    gradedMul (gradedMul x y) z = -gradedMul (gradedMul x z) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradedMul_one_cyclic x y z, gradedMul_one_swap y z]
  change gradedMulLinear (-gradedMul z y) x = _
  rw [map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply]
  change -gradedMul (gradedMul z y) x = _
  rw [← gradedMul_one_cyclic x z y]

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_triple_basis
statement:
private theorem sigmaThree_triple_basis {i j : I} (hij : i < j) (k : I) :
    sigmaThree b (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
      (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (layerOneBasis i) (layerOneBasis j))
      (layerOneBasis k)) =
      gradedMul (gradedMul (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis i)) (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis j)))
        (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis k))
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy j k with hjk | rfl | hkj
  · exact sigmaThree_triple_basis_of_lt b hij hjk
  · rw [bracketLayer_triple_self, map_zero, gradedMul_one_repeat]
  · rcases lt_trichotomy i k with hik | rfl | hki
    · rw [triple_swap_last, map_neg, sigmaThree_triple_basis_of_lt b hik hkj]
      exact (exterior_triple_swap_last _ _ _).symm
    · rw [bracketLayer_triple_cyclic, bracketLayer_triple_self, map_zero,
        gradedMul_one_cyclic, gradedMul_one_repeat]
    · rw [← bracketLayer_triple_cyclic (layerOneBasis k) (layerOneBasis i) (layerOneBasis j),
        ← gradedMul_one_cyclic (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis k)) (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis i))
          (sigmaOne b (layerOneBasis j))]
      exact sigmaThree_triple_basis_of_lt b hki hij

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_bracketLayer_basis
proof:
:= by
  rw [layerTwoBasis_eq_bracket, sigmaTwo_bracketLayer]
  exact sigmaThree_triple_basis b p.first_lt_second k

name: T3.Free.sigmaThree_bracketLayer
statement:
theorem sigmaThree_bracketLayer (q : Layer (Free I) 2) (v : Layer (Free I) 1) :
    sigmaThree b (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) q v) =
      gradedMul (sigmaTwo b q) (sigmaOne b v)
proof:
:= by
  let left := (bracketLayer (G := Free I) (i := 2) (j := 1) (by decide) (by decide)).compr₂
    (sigmaThree b).toLinearMap
  let right := gradedMulLinear.compl₁₂ (sigmaTwo b).toLinearMap (sigmaOne b).toLinearMap
  have h : left = right := by
    apply (layerTwoBasis (I := I)).ext
    intro p
    apply (layerOneBasis (I := I)).ext
    intro k
    exact sigmaThree_bracketLayer_basis b p k
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun h q) v

name: T3.Burnside.pow_exponent
statement: theorem pow_exponent (x : Burnside n I) : x ^ n = 1
proof: := powerQuotient_hasExponent x

name: T3.Burnside.lift_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_of (hG : ∀ x : G, x ^ n = 1) (a : I → G) (i : I) :
    lift hG a (of i) = a i
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift, of]

name: T3.Burnside.closure_range_of
statement: theorem closure_range_of : Subgroup.closure (Set.range (of : I → Burnside n I)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let q := powerQuotientMk (G := FreeGroup I) (n := n)
  have h := congrArg (Subgroup.map q) (FreeGroup.closure_range_of I)
  rw [MonoidHom.map_closure, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map,
    MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr (powerQuotientMk_surjective (G := FreeGroup I) (n := n))] at h
  change Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun x : I => q (FreeGroup.of x)) = ⊤
  simpa only [← Set.range_comp, Function.comp_def] using h

name: T3.Burnside.lift_surjective
statement:
theorem lift_surjective (hG : ∀ x : G, x ^ n = 1) (a : I → G)
    (ha : Subgroup.closure (Set.range a) = ⊤) : Function.Surjective (lift hG a)
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mp
  apply top_unique
  rw [← ha]
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨of i, lift_of hG a i⟩

name: T3.Burnside.finite_of_generating_family
statement:
theorem finite_of_generating_family [Finite I]
    (hfree : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → Finite (Burnside n (Fin r)))
    (hG : ∀ x : G, x ^ n = 1) (a : I → G)
    (ha : Subgroup.closure (Set.range a) = ⊤) : Finite G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let e := Fintype.equivFin I
  let b : Fin (Fintype.card I + 1) → G := fun i =>
    if h : i.val < Fintype.card I then a (e.symm ⟨i.val, h⟩) else 1
  have hb : Subgroup.closure (Set.range b) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← ha]
    apply Subgroup.closure_mono
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨(e i).val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (e i).isLt⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [b]
  let := hfree (Fintype.card I + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _)
  exact Finite.of_surjective (lift hG b) (lift_surjective hG b hb)

name: T3.Burnside.finite_of_fg
statement:
theorem finite_of_fg [Group.FG G]
    (hfree : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → Finite (Burnside n (Fin r)))
    (hG : ∀ x : G, x ^ n = 1) : Finite G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hfin⟩ := Group.fg_iff.mp (inferInstance : Group.FG G)
  let := hfin.to_subtype
  exact finite_of_generating_family hfree hG (Subtype.val : s → G) (by simpa using hs)

name: T3.Free.map_injective
statement:
theorem map_injective {f : I → J} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (map f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r : Free J →* Free I := lift pow_three (Function.extend f of fun _ => 1)
  have hr : r.comp (map f) = MonoidHom.id (Free I) := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro i
    simp [r, hf.extend_apply]
  exact (show Function.LeftInverse r (map f) from DFunLike.congr_fun hr).injective

name: T3.Free.exists_finset_map
statement:
theorem exists_finset_map (g : Free I) :
    ∃ s : Finset I, ∃ h : Free s, map (Subtype.val : s → I) h = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (of : I → Free I)) := by
    rw [closure_range_of]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top _
  induction hg using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨{i}, of ⟨i, Finset.mem_singleton_self i⟩, map_of _ _⟩
  | one => exact ⟨∅, 1, map_one _⟩
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨s, a, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨t, b, rfl⟩ := hy
    let fs : s → (s ∪ t : Finset I) := fun i => ⟨i, Finset.mem_union_left t i.property⟩
    let ft : t → (s ∪ t : Finset I) := fun i => ⟨i, Finset.mem_union_right s i.property⟩
    refine ⟨s ∪ t, map fs a * map ft b, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul]
    have hs := DFunLike.congr_fun (map_comp fs (Subtype.val : (s ∪ t : Finset I) → I)) a
    have ht := DFunLike.congr_fun (map_comp ft (Subtype.val : (s ∪ t : Finset I) → I)) b
    exact congrArg₂ (· * ·) hs ht
  | inv x _ hx =>
    obtain ⟨s, a, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨s, a⁻¹, map_inv _ _⟩

name: T3.LvdW.restrict_of
proof:
:= by
  ext j k l <;> simp [restrict, of_gen, hf.eq_iff]

name: T3.Free.restrict_toLvdW_map
statement:
theorem restrict_toLvdW_map {f : I → J} (hf : Function.Injective f) (g : Free I) :
    LvdW.restrict f (toLvdW (map f g)) = toLvdW g
proof:
:= by
  have h : (LvdW.restrict f).comp ((toLvdW (I := J)).comp (map f)) = toLvdW := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro i
    simp [hf]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h g

name: T3.Free.eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords {g : Free I}
    (hgen : ∀ i, (toLvdW g).gen i = 0)
    (hpair : ∀ p : IncreasingPair I, (toLvdW g).pair p.first p.second = 0)
    (htriple : ∀ t : IncreasingTriple I, (toLvdW g).triple t.first t.second t.third = 0) :
    g = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, h, hh⟩ := exists_finset_map g
  let : DecidableEq s := (inferInstance : LinearOrder s).toDecidableEq
  have hr := restrict_toLvdW_map (f := (Subtype.val : s → I)) Subtype.val_injective h
  rw [hh] at hr
  have he : h = 1 := by
    apply eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords_of_finite
    · intro i
      rw [← hr]
      exact hgen i
    · intro p
      rw [← hr]
      exact hpair ⟨p.first, p.second, p.first_lt_second⟩
    · intro t
      rw [← hr]
      exact htriple ⟨t.first, t.second, t.third, t.first_lt_second, t.second_lt_third⟩
  rw [he, map_one] at hh
  exact hh.symm

name: T3.Free.toLvdW_injective
statement: theorem toLvdW_injective : Function.Injective (toLvdW (I := I))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff, eq_bot_iff]
  intro g hg
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker] at hg
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  refine eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords (fun i => ?_) (fun p => ?_) (fun t => ?_) <;>
    simp [hg]

name: T3.Free.collect_toLvdW_injective
statement:
theorem collect_toLvdW_injective :
    Function.Injective fun g : Free I => LvdW.collect (toLvdW g)
proof:
:= by
  intro g h hgh
  have hgen : (toLvdW g).gen = (toLvdW h).gen := congrArg Prod.fst hgh
  have hpair : ∀ p : IncreasingPair I,
      (toLvdW g).pair p.first p.second = (toLvdW h).pair p.first p.second :=
    fun p => congrFun (congrArg (fun z => z.2.1) hgh) p
  have htriple : ∀ t : IncreasingTriple I,
      (toLvdW g).triple t.first t.second t.third =
        (toLvdW h).triple t.first t.second t.third :=
    fun t => congrFun (congrArg (fun z => z.2.2) hgh) t
  have key : h⁻¹ * g = 1 := by
    refine eq_one_of_toLvdW_coords (fun i => ?_) (fun p => ?_) (fun t => ?_)
    · rw [map_mul, map_inv]
      exact LvdW.gen_inv_mul_eq_zero hgen i
    · rw [map_mul, map_inv]
      exact LvdW.pair_inv_mul_eq_zero hgen (hpair p)
    · rw [map_mul, map_inv]
      exact LvdW.triple_inv_mul_eq_zero hgen (htriple t)
  exact (inv_mul_eq_one.mp key).symm

name: T3.LvdW.of_mem_supportedOn
statement:
theorem of_mem_supportedOn [DecidableEq I] {s : Set I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    of i ∈ supportedOn s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    simp only [of_gen]
    split_ifs with hij
    · exact False.elim (hj (hij ▸ hi))
    · rfl
  · intros
    rfl
  · intros
    rfl

name: T3.Free.toLvdW_map_mem_supportedOn
statement:
theorem toLvdW_map_mem_supportedOn (s : Finset I) (g : Free s) :
    toLvdW (map (Subtype.val : s → I) g) ∈ LvdW.supportedOn s
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (of : s → Free s)) := by
    rw [closure_range_of]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top _
  induction hg using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_of, toLvdW_of]
    exact LvdW.of_mem_supportedOn i.property
  | one => simp
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => simpa using (LvdW.supportedOn (s : Set I)).mul_mem hx hy
  | inv x _ hx => simpa using (LvdW.supportedOn (s : Set I)).inv_mem hx

name: T3.Free.exists_finset_supportedOn
statement:
theorem exists_finset_supportedOn (g : Free I) :
    ∃ s : Finset I, toLvdW g ∈ LvdW.supportedOn s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, h, rfl⟩ := exists_finset_map g
  exact ⟨s, toLvdW_map_mem_supportedOn s h⟩

name: T3.Free.finite_support_gen
statement: theorem finite_support_gen (g : Free I) : (Function.support (toLvdW g).gen).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_finset_supportedOn g
  apply s.finite_toSet.subset
  intro i hi
  by_contra hn
  exact hi (hs.1 i hn)

name: T3.Free.finite_support_pair
statement:
theorem finite_support_pair (g : Free I) :
    (Function.support fun p : IncreasingPair I => (toLvdW g).pair p.first p.second).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_finset_supportedOn g
  apply Set.Finite.of_injOn (f := fun p : IncreasingPair I => (p.first, p.second))
    (t := (s : Set I) ×ˢ (s : Set I)) ?_ ?_ (s.finite_toSet.prod s.finite_toSet)
  · intro p hp
    constructor
    · by_contra hn
      exact hp (hs.2.1 _ _ (Or.inl hn))
    · by_contra hn
      exact hp (hs.2.1 _ _ (Or.inr hn))
  · intro p _ q _ hpq
    exact IncreasingPair.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hpq) (congrArg Prod.snd hpq)

name: T3.Free.finite_support_triple
statement:
theorem finite_support_triple (g : Free I) :
    (Function.support fun t : IncreasingTriple I =>
      (toLvdW g).triple t.first t.second t.third).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_finset_supportedOn g
  apply Set.Finite.of_injOn (f := fun t : IncreasingTriple I => (t.first, t.second, t.third))
    (t := (s : Set I) ×ˢ (s : Set I) ×ˢ (s : Set I)) ?_ ?_
    (s.finite_toSet.prod (s.finite_toSet.prod s.finite_toSet))
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra hn
      exact ht (hs.2.2 _ _ _ (Or.inl hn))
    · by_contra hn
      exact ht (hs.2.2 _ _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inl hn)))
    · by_contra hn
      exact ht (hs.2.2 _ _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inr hn)))
  · intro p _ q _ hpq
    exact IncreasingTriple.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hpq)
      (congrArg (fun z => z.2.1) hpq) (congrArg (fun z => z.2.2) hpq)

name: T3.Free.lowerCentralSeries_two_fin_two_eq_bot
statement:
theorem lowerCentralSeries_two_fin_two_eq_bot :
    (⊤ : Subgroup (Free (Fin 2))).lowerCentralSeries 2 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [lowerCentralSeries_two_eq_increasingTripleClosure, increasingTripleClosure]
  have h : Set.range (increasingTripleCommutator (I := Fin 2)) = ∅ := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
      have h₁ := t.first_lt_second
      have h₂ := t.second_lt_third
      have h₃ := t.third.isLt
      simp only [Fin.lt_def] at h₁ h₂
      omega
    · simp
  rw [h, Subgroup.closure_empty]

name: T3.Free.upperCentralSeries_two_fin_two_eq_top
statement:
theorem upperCentralSeries_two_fin_two_eq_top :
    Subgroup.upperCentralSeries (Free (Fin 2)) 2 = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_upperCentralSeries_eq_top.mp
    lowerCentralSeries_two_fin_two_eq_bot

name: T3.Free.not_isMulCommutative_upperCentralSeries_two_fin_two
statement:
theorem not_isMulCommutative_upperCentralSeries_two_fin_two :
    ¬ IsMulCommutative (Subgroup.upperCentralSeries (Free (Fin 2)) 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let := h
  apply commutator_of_ne_one (show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 by decide)
  rw [commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm]
  apply setLike_mul_comm (s := Subgroup.upperCentralSeries (Free (Fin 2)) 2)
  · rw [upperCentralSeries_two_fin_two_eq_top]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top _
  · rw [upperCentralSeries_two_fin_two_eq_top]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top _

name: T3.Free.natCard_pairedCyclic
statement: theorem natCard_pairedCyclic {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Nat.card (pairedCyclic n) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairedCyclic, Nat.card_zpowers]
  exact orderOf_eq_three pow_three (pairedCommutator_ne_one hn)

name: T3.Free.finite_pairedCyclic
statement: theorem finite_pairedCyclic {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Finite (pairedCyclic n)
proof:
:=
  Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [natCard_pairedCyclic hn]; decide)

name: T3.Free.rank_pairedCyclic
statement: theorem rank_pairedCyclic {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : Group.rank (pairedCyclic n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Nontrivial (pairedCyclic n) :=
    ⟨⟨cyclicGenerator (pairedCommutator n), 1,
      fun h => pairedCommutator_ne_one hn (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩⟩
  apply Nat.le_antisymm _ (Group.rank_pos (pairedCyclic n))
  have hgen : Subgroup.closure
      (↑({cyclicGenerator (pairedCommutator n)} : Finset (pairedCyclic n)) :
        Set (pairedCyclic n)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [Finset.coe_singleton, ← Subgroup.zpowers_eq_closure]
    exact top_unique fun x _ => cyclicGenerator_generates (pairedCommutator n) x
  simpa using Group.rank_le hgen

name: T3.Free.rank_free_three
statement: theorem rank_free_three : Group.rank (Free (Fin 3)) = 3
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · simpa using (rank_le_card (I := Fin 3))
  · simpa only [finrank_layerOne, Nat.card_fin] using
      (AssociatedGraded.finrank_layerOne_le_rank (G := Free (Fin 3)))

name: T3.Free.pairedCyclicToFreeThree_injective
statement:
theorem pairedCyclicToFreeThree_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Function.Injective (pairedCyclicToFreeThree hn)
proof:
:=
  cyclicToFreeThree_injective pow_three (pairedCommutator n) (pairedCommutator_ne_one hn)

name: T3.Free.not_amalgamableOver_pairedCyclic
statement:
theorem not_amalgamableOver_pairedCyclic {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ¬ AmalgamableOver (pairedCyclic n).subtype (pairedCyclicToFreeThree hn)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact ((cyclicToFreeThree_amalgamableOver_iff pow_three (pairedCommutator n)
    (pairedCommutator_ne_one hn)).mp h) (pairedCommutator_mem_commutator n)

name: T3.Free.pairedCyclic_strict_cardinalRank_le
statement:
theorem pairedCyclic_strict_cardinalRank_le (n : ℕ) (D : Subgroup (Free ℕ))
    (hAD : pairedCyclic n ≤ D) (hD : IsStrict D) :
    ((2 * n : ℕ) : Cardinal) ≤ Group.cardinalRank D
proof:
:= by
  apply pairedCommutator_cardinalRank_le
  rw [hD.1]
  exact ⟨pairedCommutator_mem_commutator n, hAD (Subgroup.mem_zpowers _)⟩

name: T3.Free.pairedCyclic_obstruction_cardinalRank_le
statement:
theorem pairedCyclic_obstruction_cardinalRank_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (D : Subgroup (Free ℕ)) (hAD : pairedCyclic n ≤ D)
    (hbad : ¬ AmalgamableOver (Subgroup.inclusion hAD) (pairedCyclicToFreeThree hn)) :
    ((2 * n : ℕ) : Cardinal) ≤ Group.cardinalRank D
proof:
:= by
  have haD : pairedCommutator n ∈ D := hAD (Subgroup.mem_zpowers _)
  have hder : (⟨pairedCommutator n, haD⟩ : D) ∈ commutator D := by
    have hiff := cyclic_subgroup_amalgamableOver_iff pow_three (pairedCommutator n) D haD
      (pairedCyclicToFreeThree hn)
      (cyclicToFreeThree_generator pow_three (pairedCommutator n) (pairedCommutator_ne_one hn))
    exact not_not.mp (hbad ∘ hiff.mpr)
  apply pairedCommutator_cardinalRank_le
  have hm := Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem D.subtype hder
  rwa [← Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one, Subgroup.top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries] at hm

name: T3.Free.exists_cyclic_without_bounded_strict_envelope
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_without_bounded_strict_envelope (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ Group.rank (pairedCyclic n) = 1 ∧
      ∀ D : Subgroup (Free ℕ), pairedCyclic n ≤ D → IsStrict D →
        (k : Cardinal) < Group.cardinalRank D
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨k + 1, Nat.succ_pos _, rank_pairedCyclic (Nat.succ_pos _), ?_⟩
  intro D hAD hD
  have hlt : (k : Cardinal) < ((2 * (k + 1) : ℕ) : Cardinal) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show k < 2 * (k + 1) by omega)
  exact hlt.trans_le (pairedCyclic_strict_cardinalRank_le _ D hAD hD)

name: T3.Free.exists_cyclic_without_bounded_obstruction
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_without_bounded_obstruction (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), Group.rank (pairedCyclic n) = 1 ∧
      ¬ AmalgamableOver (pairedCyclic n).subtype (pairedCyclicToFreeThree hn) ∧
      ∀ (D : Subgroup (Free ℕ)) (hAD : pairedCyclic n ≤ D),
        ¬ AmalgamableOver (Subgroup.inclusion hAD) (pairedCyclicToFreeThree hn) →
          (k : Cardinal) < Group.cardinalRank D
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨k + 1, Nat.succ_pos _, rank_pairedCyclic (Nat.succ_pos _),
    not_amalgamableOver_pairedCyclic (Nat.succ_pos _), ?_⟩
  intro D hAD hbad
  have hlt : (k : Cardinal) < ((2 * (k + 1) : ℕ) : Cardinal) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show k < 2 * (k + 1) by omega)
  exact hlt.trans_le (pairedCyclic_obstruction_cardinalRank_le _ D hAD hbad)

name: T3.Free.exteriorLinearEquiv_mem_grade_iff
statement:
theorem exteriorLinearEquiv_mem_grade_iff (n : ℕ) (x : GradedModule (Free I)) :
    exteriorLinearEquiv b x ∈ TruncatedExterior.grade V n ↔ x ∈ grade (Free I) n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨x n, ?_⟩
    apply (exteriorLinearEquiv b).injective
    apply TruncatedExterior.ext
    · by_cases h : n = 1
      · subst n
        simp
      · rw [hx.1 h]
        simp [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne, Ne.symm h]
    · by_cases h : n = 2
      · subst n
        simp
      · rw [hx.2.1 h]
        simp [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne, Ne.symm h]
    · by_cases h : n = 3
      · subst n
        simp
      · rw [hx.2.2 h]
        simp [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne, Ne.symm h]
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩ <;>
      simp [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne, Ne.symm h]

theorem exteriorLinearEquiv_map_bracket (x y : GradedModule (Free I)) :

proof:
:= by
  apply TruncatedExterior.ext
  · rw [exteriorLinearEquiv_one, bracket_one, map_zero, TruncatedExterior.one_lie]
  · rw [exteriorLinearEquiv_two, bracket_two, sigmaTwo_bracketLayer, TruncatedExterior.two_lie,
      exteriorLinearEquiv_one, exteriorLinearEquiv_one]
  · rw [exteriorLinearEquiv_three, bracket_three, map_sub, sigmaThree_bracketLayer,
      sigmaThree_bracketLayer, TruncatedExterior.three_lie, exteriorLinearEquiv_two,
      exteriorLinearEquiv_one, exteriorLinearEquiv_two, exteriorLinearEquiv_one]
