name: T3.Free.exteriorLieEquiv_grade
statement:
theorem exteriorLieEquiv_grade (n : ℕ) :
    (grade (Free I) n).map (exteriorLieEquiv b).toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap =
      TruncatedExterior.grade V n
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (exteriorLieEquiv_mem_grade_iff b n x).mpr hx
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨(exteriorLieEquiv b).symm y, ?_, (exteriorLieEquiv b).apply_symm_apply y⟩
    apply (exteriorLieEquiv_mem_grade_iff b n _).mp
    simpa only [LieEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hy

name: T3.rank_eq_finrank_layerOne
statement: theorem rank_eq_finrank_layerOne : Group.rank G = Module.finrank (ZMod 3) (Layer G 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm ?_ finrank_layerOne_le_rank
  let b := Module.finBasis (ZMod 3) (Layer G 1)
  choose a ha using fun i => mk_surjective G 1 (b i)
  have hsur := Free.lift_surjective_of_basis (show HasExponentThree G from Fact.out) b
    (fun i => (a i : G)) ha
  have hle := Group.rank_le_of_surjective _ hsur
  exact hle.trans (Free.rank_le_card.trans_eq (by simp))

name: T3.finite_of_fg
statement: private theorem finite_of_fg : Finite G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, _, hs⟩ := Group.rank_spec G
  let : LinearOrder s := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let : Finite (Free s) := Free.finite
  have hsur := Free.lift_surjective_of_generating_family (Subtype.val : s → G)
    (by simpa using hs)
  exact Finite.of_surjective _ hsur

name: T3.three_pow_rank_le_natCard
statement: theorem three_pow_rank_le_natCard : 3 ^ Group.rank G ≤ Nat.card G
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite G := finite_of_fg
  have hsur : Function.Surjective (fun x : G => mk G 1 ⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 y
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have h := Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective _ hsur
  rw [Module.natCard_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod 3), Nat.card_zmod,
    ← rank_eq_finrank_layerOne] at h
  exact h

name: T3.natCard_le_three_pow_freeOrderExponent_rank
statement:
theorem natCard_le_three_pow_freeOrderExponent_rank :
    Nat.card G ≤ 3 ^ freeOrderExponent (Group.rank G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := Group.rank_spec G
  let : LinearOrder s := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let : Finite (Free s) := Free.finite
  have hsur := Free.lift_surjective_of_generating_family (Subtype.val : s → G)
    (by simpa using hs)
  have h := Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective _ hsur
  rw [Free.natCard_eq_pow_freeOrderExponent] at h
  simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe, hcard] using h

name: T3.rank_le_log_three_natCard
statement: theorem rank_le_log_three_natCard : Group.rank G ≤ Nat.log 3 (Nat.card G)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by decide)
  exact three_pow_rank_le_natCard

name: T3.monotone_freeOrderExponent
statement: private theorem monotone_freeOrderExponent : Monotone freeOrderExponent
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add h (Nat.choose_mono 2 h)) (Nat.choose_mono 3 h)

name: T3.log_three_natCard_le_freeOrderExponent_rank
statement:
theorem log_three_natCard_le_freeOrderExponent_rank :
    Nat.log 3 (Nat.card G) ≤ freeOrderExponent (Group.rank G)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.log_mono_right (b := 3) (natCard_le_three_pow_freeOrderExponent_rank (G := G))
  rwa [Nat.log_pow (by decide)] at h

name: T3.rank_le_freeOrderExponent_of_injective
statement:
theorem rank_le_freeOrderExponent_of_injective [Group.FG A] [Group.FG B]
    (hB : HasExponentThree B) (f : A →* B) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {m : ℕ} (hBm : Group.rank B ≤ m) : Group.rank A ≤ freeOrderExponent m
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree B) := ⟨hB⟩
  let : Finite B := finite_of_fg
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree A) := ⟨fun a => hf (by rw [map_pow, hB, map_one])⟩
  exact rank_le_log_three_natCard.trans ((Nat.log_mono_right
    (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f hf)).trans
      (log_three_natCard_le_freeOrderExponent_rank.trans (monotone_freeOrderExponent hBm)))

name: T3.exists_fg_and_rank_le_freeOrderExponent_of_injective
statement:
theorem exists_fg_and_rank_le_freeOrderExponent_of_injective [Group.FG B]
    (hB : HasExponentThree B) (f : A →* B) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {m : ℕ} (hBm : Group.rank B ≤ m) :
    ∃ hA : Group.FG A, letI
proof:
:= hA; Group.rank A ≤ freeOrderExponent m := by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree B) := ⟨hB⟩
  let : Finite B := finite_of_fg
  let : Finite A := Finite.of_injective f hf
  exact ⟨inferInstance, rank_le_freeOrderExponent_of_injective hB f hf hBm⟩

name: Group.generatingCardinals_nonempty
statement:
private theorem generatingCardinals_nonempty :
    {c | ∃ s : Set G, Subgroup.closure s = ⊤ ∧ Cardinal.mk s = c}.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨Cardinal.mk (Set.univ : Set G), Set.univ, Subgroup.closure_univ, rfl⟩

name: Group.cardinalRank_spec
statement:
theorem cardinalRank_spec :
    ∃ s : Set G, Cardinal.mk s = cardinalRank G ∧ Subgroup.closure s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcard⟩ := csInf_mem (generatingCardinals_nonempty G)
  exact ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩

name: Group.cardinalRank_le
statement:
theorem cardinalRank_le {s : Set G} (hs : Subgroup.closure s = ⊤) :
    cardinalRank G ≤ Cardinal.mk s
proof:
:=
  csInf_le ⟨0, fun _ _ => zero_le⟩ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩

name: Group.cardinalRank_le_nat_iff
statement:
theorem cardinalRank_le_nat_iff (n : ℕ) :
    cardinalRank G ≤ n ↔
      ∃ s : Finset G, s.card ≤ n ∧ Subgroup.closure (s : Set G) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := cardinalRank_spec G
    have hfin : s.Finite := Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite.mp
      ((hcard.trans_le hn).trans_lt Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0)
    refine ⟨hfin.toFinset, ?_, by simpa only [hfin.coe_toFinset] using hs⟩
    have h : (hfin.toFinset.card : Cardinal.{u}) ≤ n := by
      calc
        (hfin.toFinset.card : Cardinal.{u}) = Cardinal.mk (hfin.toFinset : Set G) :=
          Cardinal.mk_coe_finset.symm
        _ = Cardinal.mk s := congrArg (fun t : Set G => Cardinal.mk t) hfin.coe_toFinset
        _ = cardinalRank G := hcard
        _ ≤ n := hn
    exact_mod_cast h
  · rintro ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩
    exact (cardinalRank_le G hs).trans <| by
      change Cardinal.mk (s : Set G) ≤ (n : Cardinal.{u})
      have hmk : Cardinal.mk (s : Set G) = (s.card : Cardinal.{u}) := Cardinal.mk_coe_finset
      rw [hmk]
      exact_mod_cast hcard

name: Group.cardinalRank_eq_rank
statement: theorem cardinalRank_eq_rank [FG G] : cardinalRank G = (rank G : Cardinal.{u})
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := rank_spec G
    exact (cardinalRank_le_nat_iff G (rank G)).mpr ⟨s, hcard.le, hs⟩
  · obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := cardinalRank_spec G
    have hupper : cardinalRank G ≤ (rank G : Cardinal.{u}) := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htgen⟩ := rank_spec G
      exact (cardinalRank_le_nat_iff G (rank G)).mpr ⟨t, ht.le, htgen⟩
    have hfin : s.Finite := Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite.mp
      ((hcard.trans_le hupper).trans_lt Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0)
    have hmk : Cardinal.mk s = (hfin.toFinset.card : Cardinal.{u}) := by
      calc
        Cardinal.mk s = Cardinal.mk (hfin.toFinset : Set G) :=
          congrArg (fun t : Set G => Cardinal.mk t) hfin.coe_toFinset.symm
        _ = hfin.toFinset.card := Cardinal.mk_coe_finset
    rw [← hcard, hmk]
    exact_mod_cast rank_le (show Subgroup.closure (hfin.toFinset : Set G) = ⊤ by
      simpa only [hfin.coe_toFinset] using hs)

name: Group.cardinalRank_lt_aleph0_iff
statement: theorem cardinalRank_lt_aleph0_iff : cardinalRank G < Cardinal.aleph0 ↔ FG G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hcard, hs⟩ := cardinalRank_spec G
    have hfin : s.Finite := Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite.mp (hcard.trans_lt h)
    exact fg_iff.mpr ⟨s, hs, hfin⟩
  · intro h
    let := h
    rw [cardinalRank_eq_rank]
    exact Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0

name: T3.Support.normalClosureIn_mono_ambient
statement:
theorem normalClosureIn_mono_ambient {E F : Subgroup H} (hEF : E ≤ F) (Δ : Set H) :
    normalClosureIn E Δ ≤ normalClosureIn F Δ
proof:
:= by
  let j := Subgroup.inclusion hEF
  have hle : Subgroup.normalClosure (E.subtype ⁻¹' Δ) ≤
      (Subgroup.normalClosure (F.subtype ⁻¹' Δ)).comap j := by
    apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    intro x hx
    exact Subgroup.subset_normalClosure hx
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨j x, hle hx, rfl⟩

name: T3.Support.mem_normalClosure_of_mem_normalClosureIn
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let j : E →* G := (MonoidHom.ofInjective hf).symm.toMonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hE)
  have hj (y : E) : f (j y) = y := MonoidHom.apply_ofInjective_symm hf _
  have hle : Subgroup.normalClosure (E.subtype ⁻¹' Δ) ≤
      (Subgroup.normalClosure (f ⁻¹' Δ)).comap j := by
    apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    intro y hy
    apply Subgroup.subset_normalClosure
    change f (j y) ∈ Δ
    rw [hj]
    exact hy
  obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := hx
  have hxy : j y = x := hf ((hj y).trans heq)
  simpa only [Subgroup.mem_comap, hxy] using hle hy

name: T3.Support.commutator_mem_lowerCentralSeries_two
statement:
theorem commutator_mem_lowerCentralSeries_two {k : F} (hk : k ∈ commutator F) (w : F) :
    ⁅k, w⁆ ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup F).lowerCentralSeries 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 by omega, Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ,
    Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one]
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator hk (Subgroup.mem_top w)

name: T3.Support.commutator_quotient_gammaThree_le_center
statement:
theorem commutator_quotient_gammaThree_le_center :
    commutator (F ⧸ (⊤ : Subgroup F).lowerCentralSeries 2) ≤
      Subgroup.center (F ⧸ (⊤ : Subgroup F).lowerCentralSeries 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : commutator (F ⧸ (⊤ : Subgroup F).lowerCentralSeries 2) =
      (commutator F).map (QuotientGroup.mk' ((⊤ : Subgroup F).lowerCentralSeries 2)) := by
    have htop : (⊤ : Subgroup F).map
        (QuotientGroup.mk' ((⊤ : Subgroup F).lowerCentralSeries 2)) = ⊤ := by
      rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_map, MonoidHom.range_eq_top]
      exact QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _
    rw [commutator_def, commutator_def, Subgroup.map_commutator, htop]
  intro q hq
  rw [hmap] at hq
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hq
  rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
  intro y
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective
    (s := (⊤ : Subgroup F).lowerCentralSeries 2) y
  rw [QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, ← QuotientGroup.mk_mul, ← QuotientGroup.mk_mul,
    QuotientGroup.eq]
  have hcomm : (h * f)⁻¹ * (f * h) = ⁅f⁻¹, h⁻¹⁆ := by
    rw [commutatorElement_def]; group
  rw [hcomm]
  exact commutator_mem_lowerCentralSeries_two (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hf) _

name: T3.Support.exists_list_lift
statement:
theorem exists_list_lift {N : Subgroup F} [N.Normal] (S : Subgroup F) :
    ∀ l : List (F ⧸ N), (∀ z ∈ l, z ∈ S.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N)) →
      ∃ lF : List F, (∀ y ∈ lF, y ∈ S) ∧
        lF.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) = l ∧ lF.length = l.length
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact fun _ => ⟨[], by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  | cons z t ih =>
      intro h
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp (h z List.mem_cons_self)
      obtain ⟨tF, htF, htFmap, htFlen⟩ := ih fun w hw => h w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)
      refine ⟨y :: tF, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro w hw
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with rfl | hw
        · exact hy
        · exact htF w hw
      · rw [List.map_cons, hyz, htFmap]
      · rw [List.length_cons, List.length_cons, htFlen]

name: T3.Support.crossList_mem_closure
statement:
theorem crossList_mem_closure {S : Set F} {m : F → F} :
    ∀ {l : List F}, (∀ y ∈ l, y ∈ Subgroup.closure S) → (∀ y ∈ l, m y ∈ Subgroup.closure S) →
      crossList m l ∈ Subgroup.closure S
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact fun _ _ => Subgroup.one_mem _
  | cons x t ih =>
      intro hx hm
      refine Subgroup.mul_mem _ ?_
        (ih (fun y hy => hx y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy))
          (fun y hy => hm y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy)))
      rw [commutatorElement_def]
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _
        (hx x List.mem_cons_self) (hm x List.mem_cons_self))
        (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (hx x List.mem_cons_self)))
        (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (hm x List.mem_cons_self))

name: T3.Support.exists_compressed_conjugator
statement:
theorem exists_compressed_conjugator (hF : HasExponentThree F) {BB MM : Subgroup F}
    (hgen : BB ⊔ MM = ⊤) (b : List F)
    (hb : Subgroup.closure {x | x ∈ b} = BB) {k : ℕ} (hlen : b.length ≤ k) (u : F) :
    ∃ Y : Finset F, ↑Y ⊆ (MM : Set F) ∧ Y.card ≤ k + 1 ∧
      ∃ v ∈ Subgroup.closure ((BB : Set F) ∪ ↑Y), ∀ x : F, u⁻¹ * x * u = v⁻¹ * x * v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set N : Subgroup F := (⊤ : Subgroup F).lowerCentralSeries 2 with hN
  set π : F →* F ⧸ N := QuotientGroup.mk' N with hπ
  have hQ : commutator (F ⧸ N) ≤ Subgroup.center (F ⧸ N) :=
    commutator_quotient_gammaThree_le_center
  
  have hgen' : BB.map π ⊔ MM.map π = ⊤ := by
    rw [← Subgroup.map_sup, hgen, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_map, MonoidHom.range_eq_top]
    exact QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N
  let l : List (F ⧸ N) := (b.map π).dedup
  have hlnd : l.Nodup := List.nodup_dedup _
  have hlgen : Subgroup.closure {x | x ∈ l} = BB.map π := by
    calc
      Subgroup.closure {x | x ∈ l} = Subgroup.closure (π '' {x | x ∈ b}) := by
        congr 1
        ext x
        simp [l]
      _ = (Subgroup.closure {x | x ∈ b}).map π := (MonoidHom.map_closure π _).symm
      _ = BB.map π := by rw [hb]
  have hlmem : ∀ z ∈ l, z ∈ BB.map π := fun z hz =>
    hlgen ▸ Subgroup.subset_closure hz
  have hllen : l.length ≤ k := by
    exact (List.dedup_sublist _).length_le.trans (by simpa only [List.length_map] using hlen)
  
  obtain ⟨β', hβ', μ', hμ', m', hm', hu'⟩ :=
    exists_crossList_normalForm hQ hgen' hlnd hlgen (π u)
  
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀, hb₀eq⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hβ'
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hμeq⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hμ'
  obtain ⟨lF, hlF, hlFmap, hlFlen⟩ := exists_list_lift BB l fun z hz => hlmem z hz
  have hsec : ∀ z : F ⧸ N, ∃ y : F, y ∈ MM ∧ (z ∈ MM.map π → π y = z) := by
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ MM.map π
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hz
      exact ⟨y, hy, fun _ => hyz⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Subgroup.one_mem _, fun h => absurd h hz⟩
  choose σ hσmem hσeq using hsec
  set m : F → F := fun y => σ (m' (π y)) with hm
  have hmmem : ∀ y : F, m y ∈ MM := fun y => hσmem _
  have hmeq : ∀ y : F, π (m y) = m' (π y) := fun y => hσeq _ (hm' (π y))
  
  set Y : Finset F := insert μ (lF.map m).toFinset with hY
  refine ⟨Y, ?_, ?_, b₀ * μ * crossList m lF, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, hY, Finset.mem_insert] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | hy
    · exact hμ
    · rw [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map] at hy
      obtain ⟨w, -, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact hmmem w
  · refine le_trans (Finset.card_insert_le _ _) ?_
    refine Nat.succ_le_succ (le_trans (List.toFinset_card_le _) ?_)
    rw [List.length_map, hlFlen]
    exact hllen
  · refine Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_union_left _ hb₀)
    · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_union_right _ (by
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, hY]; exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
    · refine crossList_mem_closure (fun y hy => ?_) (fun y hy => ?_)
      · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_union_left _ (hlF y hy))
      · refine Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_union_right _ ?_)
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, hY]
        exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.mem_map_of_mem hy))
  · 
    have hpi : π (b₀ * μ * crossList m lF) = π u := by
      rw [hu', map_mul, map_mul, hb₀eq, hμeq]
      refine congrArg (fun z => β' * μ' * z) ?_
      have hcross : π (crossList m lF) = crossList m' (lF.map π) := by
        refine map_crossList π m m' lF fun y _ => hmeq y
      rw [hcross, hlFmap]
    have hmemN : u * (b₀ * μ * crossList m lF)⁻¹ ∈ N := by
      have hone : π (u * (b₀ * μ * crossList m lF)⁻¹) = 1 := by
        rw [map_mul, map_inv, hpi, mul_inv_cancel]
      rwa [hπ, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff] at hone
    have hcent : u * (b₀ * μ * crossList m lF)⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.center F :=
      lowerCentralSeries_two_le_center hF hmemN
    intro x
    set v := b₀ * μ * crossList m lF with hv
    have heq := congrArg (fun z : F => u⁻¹ * z * v) (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp hcent x)
    change u⁻¹ * (x * (u * v⁻¹)) * v = u⁻¹ * ((u * v⁻¹) * x) * v at heq
    convert heq using 1 <;> group

name: T3.Support.commutator_mem_center_of_le
statement: theorem commutator_mem_center_of_le (x y : Q) : ⁅x, y⁆ ∈ Subgroup.center Q
proof:
:=
  hQ (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top x) (Subgroup.mem_top y))

name: T3.Support.commutator_mul_left_of_le
statement: theorem commutator_mul_left_of_le (a b c : Q) : ⁅a * b, c⁆ = ⁅a, c⁆ * ⁅b, c⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hb : a * ⁅b, c⁆ = ⁅b, c⁆ * a :=
    Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (commutator_mem_center_of_le hQ b c) a
  have ha : ⁅b, c⁆ * ⁅a, c⁆ = ⁅a, c⁆ * ⁅b, c⁆ :=
    Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (commutator_mem_center_of_le hQ a c) ⁅b, c⁆
  calc ⁅a * b, c⁆ = a * ⁅b, c⁆ * (c * a⁻¹ * c⁻¹) := by
        simp only [commutatorElement_def]; group
    _ = ⁅b, c⁆ * a * (c * a⁻¹ * c⁻¹) := by rw [hb]
    _ = ⁅b, c⁆ * ⁅a, c⁆ := by simp only [commutatorElement_def]; group
    _ = ⁅a, c⁆ * ⁅b, c⁆ := ha

name: T3.Support.commutator_mul_right_of_le
statement: theorem commutator_mul_right_of_le (a b c : Q) : ⁅a, b * c⁆ = ⁅a, b⁆ * ⁅a, c⁆
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : ⁅a, c⁆ * ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅a, b⁆ * ⁅a, c⁆ :=
    Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (commutator_mem_center_of_le hQ a b) ⁅a, c⁆
  calc ⁅a, b * c⁆ = ⁅b * c, a⁆⁻¹ := (commutatorElement_inv (b * c) a).symm
    _ = (⁅b, a⁆ * ⁅c, a⁆)⁻¹ := by rw [commutator_mul_left_of_le hQ]
    _ = ⁅c, a⁆⁻¹ * ⁅b, a⁆⁻¹ := mul_inv_rev _ _
    _ = ⁅a, c⁆ * ⁅a, b⁆ := by rw [commutatorElement_inv, commutatorElement_inv]
    _ = ⁅a, b⁆ * ⁅a, c⁆ := hcomm

name: T3.Support.commutator_inv_right_of_le
statement: theorem commutator_inv_right_of_le (a b : Q) : ⁅a, b⁻¹⁆ = ⁅a, b⁆⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := commutator_mul_right_of_le hQ a b b⁻¹
  rw [mul_inv_cancel, commutatorElement_one_right] at h
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h.symm

name: T3.Support.crossList_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem crossList_nil (m : Q → Q) : crossList m ([] : List Q) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Support.crossList_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem crossList_cons (m : Q → Q) (x : Q) (t : List Q) :
    crossList m (x :: t) = ⁅x, m x⁆ * crossList m t
proof: := rfl

name: T3.Support.crossList_eq_one_of_forall
statement:
theorem crossList_eq_one_of_forall {m : Q → Q} {l : List Q} (h : ∀ z ∈ l, m z = 1) :
    crossList m l = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x t ih =>
      rw [crossList_cons, h x List.mem_cons_self, commutatorElement_one_right, one_mul]
      exact ih fun z hz => h z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)

name: T3.Support.crossList_one
statement: theorem crossList_one (l : List Q) : crossList (fun _ : Q => (1 : Q)) l = 1
proof:
:=
  crossList_eq_one_of_forall fun _ _ => rfl

name: T3.Support.crossList_single
statement:
theorem crossList_single [DecidableEq Q] {β μ : Q} {l : List Q} (hnd : l.Nodup) (hβ : β ∈ l) :
    crossList (fun x => if x = β then μ else 1) l = ⁅β, μ⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact absurd hβ List.not_mem_nil
  | cons x t ih =>
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hnd
      rw [crossList_cons]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hβ with hx | hx
      · subst hx
        have hzero : crossList (fun z => if z = β then μ else 1) t = 1 :=
          crossList_eq_one_of_forall fun z hz =>
            ite_eq_right fun hzb => hnd.1 (by rw [← hzb]; exact hz)
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl, hzero, mul_one]
      · have hxne : x ≠ β := fun h => hnd.1 (h ▸ hx)
        rw [ite_eq_right hxne, commutatorElement_one_right, one_mul, ih hnd.2 hx]

name: T3.Support.map_crossList
statement:
theorem map_crossList {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] (φ : G →* H) (m : G → G) (m' : H → H)
    (l : List G) (h : ∀ y ∈ l, φ (m y) = m' (φ y)) :
    φ (crossList m l) = crossList m' (l.map φ)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rw [List.map_nil, crossList_nil, crossList_nil, map_one]
  | cons x t ih =>
      rw [crossList_cons, map_mul, map_commutatorElement, h x List.mem_cons_self,
        ih fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy), List.map_cons, crossList_cons]

name: T3.Support.crossList_mem_center
statement: theorem crossList_mem_center (m : Q → Q) (l : List Q) : crossList m l ∈ Subgroup.center Q
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  | cons x t ih => exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (commutator_mem_center_of_le hQ x (m x)) ih

name: T3.Support.crossList_mul
statement:
theorem crossList_mul (m m' : Q → Q) (l : List Q) :
    crossList m l * crossList m' l = crossList (fun x => m x * m' x) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rw [crossList_nil, crossList_nil, crossList_nil, mul_one]
  | cons x t ih =>
      have hcen : crossList m t * ⁅x, m' x⁆ = ⁅x, m' x⁆ * crossList m t :=
        Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (commutator_mem_center_of_le hQ x (m' x))
          (crossList m t)
      calc ⁅x, m x⁆ * crossList m t * (⁅x, m' x⁆ * crossList m' t)
          = ⁅x, m x⁆ * (crossList m t * ⁅x, m' x⁆) * crossList m' t := by group
        _ = ⁅x, m x⁆ * (⁅x, m' x⁆ * crossList m t) * crossList m' t := by rw [hcen]
        _ = ⁅x, m x⁆ * ⁅x, m' x⁆ * (crossList m t * crossList m' t) := by group
        _ = ⁅x, m x * m' x⁆ * crossList (fun y => m y * m' y) t := by
              rw [commutator_mul_right_of_le hQ, ih]

name: T3.Support.crossList_inv
statement:
theorem crossList_inv (m : Q → Q) (l : List Q) :
    (crossList m l)⁻¹ = crossList (fun x => (m x)⁻¹) l
proof:
:= by
  have h := crossList_mul hQ m (fun x => (m x)⁻¹) l
  rw [show (fun x => m x * (m x)⁻¹) = fun _ : Q => (1 : Q) from
      funext fun x => mul_inv_cancel _, crossList_one] at h
  exact inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right h

name: T3.Support.exists_crossList_normalForm
statement:
theorem exists_crossList_normalForm
    {BB MM : Subgroup Q} (hgen : BB ⊔ MM = ⊤) {l : List Q} (hnd : l.Nodup)
    (hl : Subgroup.closure {x | x ∈ l} = BB) (u : Q) :
    ∃ β ∈ BB, ∃ μ ∈ MM, ∃ m : Q → Q, (∀ x, m x ∈ MM) ∧ u = β * μ * crossList m l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcomm : ∀ β ∈ BB, ∀ μ ∈ MM,
      ∃ m : Q → Q, (∀ x, m x ∈ MM) ∧ ⁅β, μ⁆ = crossList m l := by
    intro β hβ
    rw [← hl] at hβ
    induction hβ using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem β hβ =>
      intro μ hμ
      refine ⟨fun x => if x = β then μ else 1, fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp only
        split
        · exact hμ
        · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
      · exact (crossList_single hnd hβ).symm
    | one =>
      intro μ _
      exact ⟨fun _ => 1, fun _ => Subgroup.one_mem _, by
        rw [commutatorElement_one_left, crossList_one]⟩
    | mul β β' _ _ ih ih' =>
      intro μ hμ
      obtain ⟨m, hm, heq⟩ := ih μ hμ
      obtain ⟨m', hm', heq'⟩ := ih' μ hμ
      exact ⟨fun x => m x * m' x, fun x => MM.mul_mem (hm x) (hm' x), by
        rw [commutator_mul_left_of_le hQ, heq, heq', crossList_mul hQ]⟩
    | inv β _ ih =>
      intro μ hμ
      obtain ⟨m, hm, heq⟩ := ih μ hμ
      refine ⟨fun x => (m x)⁻¹, fun x => MM.inv_mem (hm x), ?_⟩
      have hinv : ⁅β⁻¹, μ⁆ = ⁅β, μ⁆⁻¹ := by
        have h := commutator_mul_left_of_le hQ β β⁻¹ μ
        rw [mul_inv_cancel, commutatorElement_one_left] at h
        exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h.symm
      rw [hinv, heq, crossList_inv hQ]
  have hcen : ∀ (m : Q → Q) (y : Q), crossList m l * y = y * crossList m l := fun m y =>
    (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (crossList_mem_center hQ m l) y).symm
  have hceninv : ∀ (m : Q → Q) (y : Q), (crossList m l)⁻¹ * y = y * (crossList m l)⁻¹ :=
    fun m y => (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp
      (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (crossList_mem_center hQ m l)) y).symm
  let T : Subgroup Q :=
    { carrier := {u | ∃ β ∈ BB, ∃ μ ∈ MM, ∃ m : Q → Q,
        (∀ x, m x ∈ MM) ∧ u = β * μ * crossList m l}
      one_mem' := ⟨1, Subgroup.one_mem _, 1, Subgroup.one_mem _, fun _ => 1,
        fun _ => Subgroup.one_mem _, by rw [crossList_one, mul_one, mul_one]⟩
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨β₁, hβ₁, μ₁, hμ₁, m₁, hm₁, rfl⟩ ⟨β₂, hβ₂, μ₂, hμ₂, m₂, hm₂, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m₃, hm₃, hm₃eq⟩ := hcomm β₂ hβ₂ μ₁ hμ₁
        refine ⟨β₁ * β₂, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hβ₁ hβ₂, μ₁ * μ₂, Subgroup.mul_mem _ hμ₁ hμ₂,
          fun x => (m₃ x)⁻¹ * m₁ x * m₂ x,
          fun x => Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (hm₃ x))
            (hm₁ x)) (hm₂ x), ?_⟩
        have hswap : μ₁ * β₂ = ⁅μ₁, β₂⁆ * (β₂ * μ₁) := by
          rw [commutatorElement_def]; group
        have hinv : ⁅μ₁, β₂⁆ = (crossList m₃ l)⁻¹ := by
          rw [← commutatorElement_inv, hm₃eq]
        calc β₁ * μ₁ * crossList m₁ l * (β₂ * μ₂ * crossList m₂ l)
            = β₁ * μ₁ * (crossList m₁ l * (β₂ * μ₂)) * crossList m₂ l := by group
          _ = β₁ * μ₁ * (β₂ * μ₂ * crossList m₁ l) * crossList m₂ l := by rw [hcen]
          _ = β₁ * (μ₁ * β₂) * μ₂ * (crossList m₁ l * crossList m₂ l) := by group
          _ = β₁ * ((crossList m₃ l)⁻¹ * (β₂ * μ₁)) * μ₂ *
                (crossList m₁ l * crossList m₂ l) := by rw [hswap, hinv]
          _ = β₁ * (β₂ * μ₁ * (crossList m₃ l)⁻¹) * μ₂ *
                (crossList m₁ l * crossList m₂ l) := by rw [hceninv]
          _ = β₁ * β₂ * μ₁ * ((crossList m₃ l)⁻¹ * μ₂) *
                (crossList m₁ l * crossList m₂ l) := by group
          _ = β₁ * β₂ * μ₁ * (μ₂ * (crossList m₃ l)⁻¹) *
                (crossList m₁ l * crossList m₂ l) := by rw [hceninv]
          _ = β₁ * β₂ * (μ₁ * μ₂) *
                ((crossList m₃ l)⁻¹ * crossList m₁ l * crossList m₂ l) := by group
          _ = β₁ * β₂ * (μ₁ * μ₂) * crossList (fun x => (m₃ x)⁻¹ * m₁ x * m₂ x) l := by
                rw [crossList_inv hQ, crossList_mul hQ, crossList_mul hQ]
      inv_mem' := by
        rintro u ⟨β, hβ, μ, hμ, m, hm, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m₃, hm₃, hm₃eq⟩ := hcomm β⁻¹ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hβ) μ⁻¹ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hμ)
        refine ⟨β⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hβ, μ⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hμ,
          fun x => (m x)⁻¹ * (m₃ x)⁻¹,
          fun x => Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (hm x))
            (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (hm₃ x)), ?_⟩
        have hswap : μ⁻¹ * β⁻¹ = ⁅μ⁻¹, β⁻¹⁆ * (β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹) := by
          rw [commutatorElement_def]; group
        have hinv : ⁅μ⁻¹, β⁻¹⁆ = (crossList m₃ l)⁻¹ := by
          rw [← commutatorElement_inv, hm₃eq]
        calc (β * μ * crossList m l)⁻¹
            = (crossList m l)⁻¹ * (μ⁻¹ * β⁻¹) := by group
          _ = (crossList m l)⁻¹ * ((crossList m₃ l)⁻¹ * (β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹)) := by rw [hswap, hinv]
          _ = (crossList m l)⁻¹ * (β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹ * (crossList m₃ l)⁻¹) := by
                rw [hceninv m₃ (β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹)]
          _ = (crossList m l)⁻¹ * (β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹) * (crossList m₃ l)⁻¹ := by rw [← mul_assoc]
          _ = β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹ * (crossList m l)⁻¹ * (crossList m₃ l)⁻¹ := by
                rw [hceninv m (β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹)]
          _ = β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹ * ((crossList m l)⁻¹ * (crossList m₃ l)⁻¹) := by group
          _ = β⁻¹ * μ⁻¹ * crossList (fun x => (m x)⁻¹ * (m₃ x)⁻¹) l := by
                rw [crossList_inv hQ m, crossList_inv hQ m₃, crossList_mul hQ] }
  have hBB : BB ≤ T := fun β hβ =>
    ⟨β, hβ, 1, Subgroup.one_mem _, fun _ => 1, fun _ => Subgroup.one_mem _, by
      rw [crossList_one, mul_one, mul_one]⟩
  have hMM : MM ≤ T := fun μ hμ =>
    ⟨1, Subgroup.one_mem _, μ, hμ, fun _ => 1, fun _ => Subgroup.one_mem _, by
      rw [crossList_one, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  exact (hgen ▸ sup_le hBB hMM) (Subgroup.mem_top u)

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracket_eq
statement:
theorem bracket_eq (x y : GradedModule G) :
    ⁅x, y⁆ =
      DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 2
        (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (x 1) (y 1)) +
      DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 3
        (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (x 2) (y 1) -
          bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (y 2) (x 1))
proof: := rfl

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracket_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracket_one (x y : GradedModule G) : ⁅x, y⁆ 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracket_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracket_two (x y : GradedModule G) :
    ⁅x, y⁆ 2 = bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (x 1) (y 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_same, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.triple_neg
statement:
private theorem triple_neg (x y z : Layer G 1) :
    -bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) y z) x =
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) x y) z -
        bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) x z) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracketLayer_triple_cyclic x z y, bracketLayer_one_swap z y,
    map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, sub_neg_eq_add, bracketLayer_triple_cyclic x y z]
  apply neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr
  have h := three_nsmul_eq_zero G Fact.out 3
    (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) y z) x)
  simpa only [succ_nsmul, zero_nsmul, zero_add, add_assoc] using h

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.triple_bracket_eq
statement:
theorem triple_bracket_eq (x y z : GradedModule G) :
    ⁅⁅x, y⁆, z⁆ = DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 3
      (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide)
        (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (x 1) (y 1)) (z 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_eq ⁅x, y⁆ z]
  simp

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.triple_bracket_cyclic
statement: theorem triple_bracket_cyclic (x y z : GradedModule G) : ⁅⁅x, y⁆, z⁆ = ⁅⁅y, z⁆, x⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp only [triple_bracket_eq, bracketLayer_triple_cyclic (x 1) (y 1) (z 1)]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.triple_bracket_self
statement: theorem triple_bracket_self (x y : GradedModule G) : ⁅⁅x, y⁆, y⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [triple_bracket_eq, bracketLayer_triple_self, map_zero]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracket_lof
statement:
theorem bracket_lof {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) (x : Layer G i) (y : Layer G j) :
    ⁅DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) i x, DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) j y⁆ =
      DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) (i + j) (bracketLayer hi hj x y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsum : 4 ≤ i + j
  · have := layer_subsingleton_of_four_le (G := G) Fact.out hsum
    have hz : bracketLayer hi hj x y = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz, map_zero]
    by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      have hj1 : j ≠ 1 := by omega
      have hj2 : j ≠ 2 := by omega
      simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne,
        Ne.symm hj1, Ne.symm hj2]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        have hj1 : j ≠ 1 := by omega
        simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne, Ne.symm hj1]
      · simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne,
          Ne.symm hi1, Ne.symm hi2]
  · have hi' : i = 1 ∨ i = 2 := by omega
    have hj' : j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by omega
    rcases hi' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj' with rfl | rfl
    · simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne]
    · simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne, bracketLayer_one_two]
    · simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne]
    · omega

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracket_lof_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracket_lof_mk {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j)
    (x : term G i) (y : term G j) :
    ⁅DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) i (mk G i x),
      DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) j (mk G j y)⁆ =
        DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) (i + j)
          (mk G (i + j) (termCommutator hi hj x y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_lof hi hj, bracketLayer_mk]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.grade_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem grade_zero : grade G 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hy : y = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp [hy]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.grade_eq_bot_of_four_le
statement: theorem grade_eq_bot_of_four_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) : grade G n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have := layer_subsingleton_of_four_le (G := G) Fact.out hn
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hy : y = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp [hy]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.map_bracket
statement:
theorem map_bracket (f : G →* H) (x y : GradedModule G) :
    map f ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅map f x, map f y⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_eq, bracket_eq]
  simp only [map_add, map_lof, map_sub, map_apply]
  rw [mapLayer_bracketLayer f (i := 1) (j := 1),
    mapLayer_bracketLayer f (i := 2) (j := 1), mapLayer_bracketLayer f (i := 2) (j := 1)]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mapLie_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLie_apply (f : G →* H) (x : GradedModule G) : mapLie f x = map f x
proof: := rfl

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mapLie_mem_grade
statement:
theorem mapLie_mem_grade (f : G →* H) (n : ℕ) {x : GradedModule G} (hx : x ∈ grade G n) :
    mapLie f x ∈ grade H n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨mapLayer f n x, (map_lof f n x).symm⟩

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mapLie_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLie_id : mapLie (MonoidHom.id G) = LieHom.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LieHom.ext
  intro x
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun map_id x

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mapLie_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapLie_comp {K : Type*} [Group K] [Fact (HasExponentThree K)]
    (f : G →* H) (g : H →* K) : mapLie (g.comp f) = (mapLie g).comp (mapLie f)
proof:
:= by
  apply LieHom.ext
  intro x
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (map_comp f g) x

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.injective_of_mapLie_injective
statement:
theorem injective_of_mapLie_injective (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Injective (mapLie f)) :
    Function.Injective f
proof: := injective_of_map_injective f hf

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mapLie_injective_iff_isStrict
statement:
theorem mapLie_injective_iff_isStrict (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (mapLie f) ↔ IsStrict f.range
proof: := map_injective_iff_isStrict f hf

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.lof_mk_mem_of_degree_one
statement:
private theorem lof_mk_mem_of_degree_one
    (K : LieSubalgebra (ZMod 3) (GradedModule G))
    (hK : Set.range (DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 1) ⊆ K) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : term G (n + 1)),
      DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) (n + 1) (mk G (n + 1) x) ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro x
    exact hK ⟨mk G 1 x, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    change x ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries (n + 1) at hx
    induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx
      have hbracket := K.lie_mem (ih ⟨a, ha⟩) (hK ⟨mk G 1 ⟨b, hb⟩, rfl⟩)
      rw [bracket_lof (Nat.succ_pos n) (by decide), bracketLayer_mk] at hbracket
      exact hbracket
    | one =>
      change DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) (n + 1 + 1) 0 ∈ K
      simpa only [map_zero] using K.zero_mem
    | mul a b ha hb hia hib =>
      change DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) (n + 1 + 1)
        (mk G (n + 1 + 1) (⟨a, ha⟩ * ⟨b, hb⟩)) ∈ K
      rw [mk_mul, map_add]
      exact K.add_mem hia hib
    | inv a ha hia =>
      change DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) (n + 1 + 1)
        (-mk G (n + 1 + 1) ⟨a, ha⟩) ∈ K
      rw [map_neg]
      exact K.neg_mem hia

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.lieSubalgebra_eq_top_of_degree_one
statement:
theorem lieSubalgebra_eq_top_of_degree_one
    (K : LieSubalgebra (ZMod 3) (GradedModule G))
    (hK : Set.range (DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 1) ⊆ K) : K = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  clear hx
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact K.zero_mem
  | of n x =>
    change DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) n x ∈ K
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [hx, map_zero]
      exact K.zero_mem
    | succ n =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G (n + 1) x
      exact lof_mk_mem_of_degree_one K hK n x
  | add x y hx hy => exact K.add_mem hx hy

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.lieSpan_range_lof_one_eq_top
statement:
theorem lieSpan_range_lof_one_eq_top :
    LieSubalgebra.lieSpan (ZMod 3) (GradedModule G)
      (Set.range (DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 1)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  lieSubalgebra_eq_top_of_degree_one _ LieSubalgebra.subset_lieSpan

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.term_prod
statement: theorem term_prod (n : ℕ) : term (G × H) n = (term G n).prod (term H n)
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_prod (n - 1)

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.layerProdEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem layerProdEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (x : Layer (G × H) n) :
    layerProdEquiv n x = (mapLayer (MonoidHom.fst G H) n x, mapLayer (MonoidHom.snd G H) n x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mem_term_map_iff_of_leftInverse
statement:
theorem mem_term_map_iff_of_leftInverse (f : G →* H) (r : H →* G)
    (h : r.comp f = MonoidHom.id G) (n : ℕ) (x : G) : f x ∈ term H n ↔ x ∈ term G n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hr := (termMap r n ⟨f x, hx⟩).property
    change r (f x) ∈ term G n at hr
    simpa only [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, h, MonoidHom.id_apply] using hr
  · intro hx
    exact (termMap f n ⟨x, hx⟩).property

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mapLayer_leftInverse
statement:
theorem mapLayer_leftInverse (f : G →* H) (r : H →* G)
    (h : r.comp f = MonoidHom.id G) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.LeftInverse (mapLayer r n) (mapLayer f n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLayer_comp, h, mapLayer_id]
  rfl

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mapLayer_injective_of_leftInverse
statement:
theorem mapLayer_injective_of_leftInverse (f : G →* H) (r : H →* G)
    (h : r.comp f = MonoidHom.id G) (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (mapLayer f n)
proof:
:=
  (mapLayer_leftInverse f r h n).injective

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.isStrict_range_of_leftInverse
statement:
theorem isStrict_range_of_leftInverse (f : G →* H) (r : H →* G)
    (h : r.comp f = MonoidHom.id G) : IsStrict f.range
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Function.Injective f :=
    (show Function.LeftInverse r f from fun x => DFunLike.congr_fun h x).injective
  apply (map_injective_iff_isStrict f hf).mp
  exact (map_injective_iff f).mpr (mapLayer_injective_of_leftInverse f r h)

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.subgroupImage_map_of_leftInverse
statement:
theorem subgroupImage_map_of_leftInverse (f : G →* H) (r : H →* G)
    (h : r.comp f = MonoidHom.id G) (K : Subgroup G) (n : ℕ) :
    subgroupImage (K.map f) n = (subgroupImage K n).map (mapLayer f n)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (mem_subgroupImage (K.map f) n x).mp hx
    obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := ha
    have hkn : k ∈ term G n :=
      (mem_term_map_iff_of_leftInverse f r h n k).mp (he ▸ a.property)
    refine Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨mk G n ⟨k, hkn⟩,
      (mem_subgroupImage K n _).mpr ⟨⟨k, hkn⟩, hk, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [mapLayer_mk]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext he
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (mem_subgroupImage K n y).mp hy
    exact (mem_subgroupImage (K.map f) n _).mpr
      ⟨termMap f n a, Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.quotient_conj
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem.mpr
  change (x * (a : G) * x⁻¹) / a ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries n
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← commutatorElement_def]
  have h := Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top x) a.property
  change ⁅x, (a : G)⁆ ∈ ⁅⊤, (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries (n - 1)⁆ at h
  rw [Subgroup.commutator_comm, ← Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_succ] at h
  simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn] using h

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.commutatorMul_mul_left
proof:
:= by
  have h : termCommutator hi hj (x * y) z =
      termConj (i + j) (x : G) (termCommutator hi hj y z) * termCommutator hi hj x z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul (x : G) y z
  simp only [commutatorMul, h, map_mul]
  rw [quotient_conj (by omega)]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.commutatorMul_mul_right
proof:
:= by
  have h : termCommutator hi hj x (y * z) =
      termCommutator hi hj x y * termConj (i + j) (y : G) (termCommutator hi hj x z) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ⁅(x : G), (y : G) * z⁆ =
      ⁅(x : G), (y : G)⁆ * ((y : G) * ⁅(x : G), (z : G)⁆ * (y : G)⁻¹)
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using commutatorElement_mul_right_eq_mul_conj (x : G) y z
  simp only [commutatorMul, h, map_mul]
  rw [quotient_conj (by omega)]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.commutatorMul_eq_one_left
proof:
:= by
  apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr
  change ⁅(x : G), (y : G)⁆ ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries (i + j)
  change (x : G) ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries i at hx
  have h := Subgroup.commutator_lowerCentralSeries_le (G := G) i (j - 1)
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator hx y.property)
  have he : i + (j - 1) + 1 = i + j := by omega
  simpa only [he] using h

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.commutatorMul_eq_one_right
proof:
:= by
  apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr
  change ⁅(x : G), (y : G)⁆ ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries (i + j)
  change (y : G) ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries j at hy
  have h := Subgroup.commutator_lowerCentralSeries_le (G := G) (i - 1) j
    (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator x.property hy)
  have he : i - 1 + j + 1 = i + j := by omega
  simpa only [he] using h

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketAdd_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracketAdd_mk {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j)
    (x : term G i) (y : term G j) :
    bracketAdd hi hj (mk G i x) (mk G j y) = mk G (i + j) (termCommutator hi hj x y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketLayer_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracketLayer_mk {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j)
    (x : term G i) (y : term G j) :
    bracketLayer hi hj (mk G i x) (mk G j y) = mk G (i + j) (termCommutator hi hj x y)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketLayer_one_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracketLayer_one_self (x : Layer G 1) : bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 x
  rw [bracketLayer_mk, mk_eq_zero]
  change ⁅(x : G), (x : G)⁆ ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries 2
  simp

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketLayer_one_swap
statement:
theorem bracketLayer_one_swap (x y : Layer G 1) :
    bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) x y = -bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) y x
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
  have h := bracketLayer_one_self (x + y)
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, bracketLayer_one_self, zero_add, add_zero] at h
  exact (add_comm _ _).trans h

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketLayer_one_two
statement:
theorem bracketLayer_one_two (x : Layer G 1) (y : Layer G 2) :
    bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) x y = -bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) y x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 2 y
  simp only [bracketLayer_mk]
  change QuotientGroup.mk' (relation G 3) _ = (QuotientGroup.mk' (relation G 3) _)⁻¹
  rw [← map_inv]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (commutatorElement_inv (y : G) x).symm

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketLayer_triple_cyclic
statement:
theorem bracketLayer_triple_cyclic (x y z : Layer G 1) :
    bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) x y) z =
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) y z) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G 1 z
  simp only [bracketLayer_mk]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (T3.commutator_triple_cyclic Fact.out (x : G) y z)

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracketLayer_triple_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracketLayer_triple_self (x y : Layer G 1) :
    bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) x y) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracketLayer_triple_cyclic, bracketLayer_one_self, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.mapLayer_bracketLayer
statement:
theorem mapLayer_bracketLayer {H : Type*} [Group H] [Fact (HasExponentThree H)]
    (f : G →* H) {i j : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (hj : 0 < j) (x : Layer G i) (y : Layer G j) :
    mapLayer f (i + j) (bracketLayer hi hj x y) =
      bracketLayer hi hj (mapLayer f i x) (mapLayer f j y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G i x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective G j y
  simp only [bracketLayer_mk, mapLayer_mk]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (map_commutatorElement f (x : G) y)

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.truncationEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem truncationEquiv_apply (x : GradedModule G) : truncationEquiv G x = (x 1, x 2, x 3)
proof: := rfl

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.truncationEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem truncationEquiv_symm_apply (x : Layer G 1 × Layer G 2 × Layer G 3) :
    (truncationEquiv G).symm x = DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 1 x.1 +
      DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 2 x.2.1 + DirectSum.lof (ZMod 3) ℕ (Layer G) 3 x.2.2
proof: := rfl

name: T3.AssociatedGraded.bracket_three
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bracket_three (x y : GradedModule G) :
    ⁅x, y⁆ 3 = bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (x 2) (y 1) -
      bracketLayer (by decide) (by decide) (y 2) (x 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracket_eq, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne]

name: T3.Amalgamation.cyclicGenerator_generates
statement:
theorem cyclicGenerator_generates (a : G) (x : Subgroup.zpowers a) :
    x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (cyclicGenerator a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := x.property
  exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext hn⟩

name: T3.Amalgamation.orderOf_eq_three
statement:
theorem orderOf_eq_three (hG : HasExponentThree G) {a : G} (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    orderOf a = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hd := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one (hG a)
  rcases (Nat.dvd_prime (by decide : Nat.Prime 3)).mp hd with h | h
  · exact (ha (orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp h)).elim
  · exact h

name: T3.Amalgamation.cyclicToFreeThree_generator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclicToFreeThree_generator (hG : HasExponentThree G) (a : G) (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    cyclicToFreeThree hG a ha (cyclicGenerator a) = Free.of 0
proof:
:=
  monoidHomOfForallMemZpowers_apply_gen _ _

name: T3.Amalgamation.cyclicToFreeThree_injective
statement:
theorem cyclicToFreeThree_injective (hG : HasExponentThree G) (a : G) (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    Function.Injective (cyclicToFreeThree hG a ha)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Free (Fin 3) →* Subgroup.zpowers a :=
    Free.lift (fun x => Subtype.ext (hG x))
      (fun k => if k = 0 then cyclicGenerator a else 1)
  have hr : r.comp (cyclicToFreeThree hG a ha) = MonoidHom.id _ := by
    apply (MonoidHom.eq_iff_eq_on_generator (cyclicGenerator_generates a) _ _).mpr
    simp [r]
  exact (show Function.LeftInverse r (cyclicToFreeThree hG a ha) from
    fun x => DFunLike.congr_fun hr x).injective

name: T3.Amalgamation.exists_cyclic_retraction
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_retraction (hG : HasExponentThree G) (a : G)
    (ha : a ∉ commutator G) :
    ∃ r : G →* Subgroup.zpowers a, r.comp (Subgroup.zpowers a).subtype = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  let : Fact (HasExponentThree G) := ⟨hG⟩
  let : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have ha' : AssociatedGraded.mk G 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩ ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [ne_eq, AssociatedGraded.mk_eq_zero, Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_one] using ha
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one (ZMod 3) ha'
  have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := fun h => ha (h ▸ (commutator G).one_mem)
  have hc : Nat.card (Subgroup.zpowers a) = 3 := by
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, orderOf_eq_three hG ha1]
  let e : Multiplicative (ZMod 3) ≃* Subgroup.zpowers a :=
    zmodMulEquivOfGenerator (cyclicGenerator_generates a) hc
  let q : G →* Multiplicative (ZMod 3) :=
    l.toAddMonoidHom.toMultiplicative.comp (AssociatedGraded.quotientOne G)
  refine ⟨e.toMonoidHom.comp q, ?_⟩
  apply (MonoidHom.eq_iff_eq_on_generator (cyclicGenerator_generates a) _ _).mpr
  change e (Multiplicative.ofAdd (l (AssociatedGraded.mk G 1 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩))) = _
  rw [hl]
  exact zmodMulEquivOfGenerator_apply_ofAdd_one _ _

name: T3.Amalgamation.amalgamableOver_of_retractions
statement:
theorem amalgamableOver_of_retractions {A H : Type*} [Group A] [Group H]
    (hG : HasExponentThree G) (hH : HasExponentThree H)
    (f : A →* G) (g : A →* H) (rG : G →* A) (rH : H →* A)
    (hGret : rG.comp f = MonoidHom.id _) (hHret : rH.comp g = MonoidHom.id _) :
    AmalgamableOver f g
proof:
:= by
  let i : G →* G × H := (MonoidHom.id G).prod (g.comp rG)
  let j : H →* G × H := (f.comp rH).prod (MonoidHom.id H)
  apply amalgamableOver_of_amalgam f g (K := G × H)
    (fun x => Prod.ext (hG x.1) (hH x.2)) i j
  · exact fun x y h => congrArg Prod.fst h
  · exact fun x y h => congrArg Prod.snd h
  · apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro x
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact (congrArg f (DFunLike.congr_fun hHret x)).symm
    · exact congrArg g (DFunLike.congr_fun hGret x)

name: T3.Amalgamation.triple_eq_one_of_mem_commutator
statement:
theorem triple_eq_one_of_mem_commutator (hG : HasExponentThree G) {a : G}
    (ha : a ∈ commutator G) (b c : G) : ⁅⁅a, b⁆, c⁆ = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp (commutator_mem_center_of_mem_commutator hG ha b) c).symm
    |> commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm.mpr

name: T3.Amalgamation.cyclic_amalgamableOver_iff
statement:
theorem cyclic_amalgamableOver_iff (hG : HasExponentThree G) (a : G)
    (f : Subgroup.zpowers a →* Free (Fin 3))
    (hf : f (cyclicGenerator a) = Free.of 0) :
    AmalgamableOver (Subgroup.zpowers a).subtype f ↔ a ∉ commutator G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, hij⟩ ha
    let : Group K := hK
    have hia : i a = j (Free.of 0) := by
      have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hij (cyclicGenerator a)
      change i a = j (f (cyclicGenerator a)) at h
      exact h.trans (congrArg j hf)
    have hmap : (commutator G).map i ≤ commutator K := by
      rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.map_commutator, commutator_def]
      exact Subgroup.commutator_mono le_top le_top
    have ham : i a ∈ commutator K := hmap (Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem i ha)
    have ht := triple_eq_one_of_mem_commutator hpow ham (j (Free.of 1)) (j (Free.of 2))
    rw [hia, ← map_commutatorElement, ← map_commutatorElement, ← map_one j] at ht
    exact Free.triple_commutator_of_ne_one (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1)
      (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2) (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2) (hj ht)
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_cyclic_retraction hG a ha
    let s : Free (Fin 3) →* Subgroup.zpowers a :=
      Free.lift (fun x => Subtype.ext (hG x)) (fun k => if k = 0 then cyclicGenerator a else 1)
    apply amalgamableOver_of_retractions hG Free.pow_three _ f r s hr
    apply (MonoidHom.eq_iff_eq_on_generator (cyclicGenerator_generates a) _ _).mpr
    simp [s, hf]

name: T3.Amalgamation.cyclicToFreeThree_amalgamableOver_iff
statement:
theorem cyclicToFreeThree_amalgamableOver_iff (hG : HasExponentThree G) (a : G) (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    AmalgamableOver (Subgroup.zpowers a).subtype (cyclicToFreeThree hG a ha) ↔
      a ∉ commutator G
proof:
:=
  cyclic_amalgamableOver_iff hG a _ (cyclicToFreeThree_generator hG a ha)

name: T3.Amalgamation.cyclic_subgroup_amalgamableOver_iff
statement:
theorem cyclic_subgroup_amalgamableOver_iff (hG : HasExponentThree G) (a : G)
    (D : Subgroup G) (haD : a ∈ D) (f : Subgroup.zpowers a →* Free (Fin 3))
    (hf : f (cyclicGenerator a) = Free.of 0) :
    AmalgamableOver (Subgroup.inclusion (Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr haD)) f ↔
      (⟨a, haD⟩ : D) ∉ commutator D
proof:
:= by
  let d : D := ⟨a, haD⟩
  let e : Subgroup.zpowers d →* Subgroup.zpowers a :=
    (D.subtype.comp (Subgroup.zpowers d).subtype).codRestrict _ (fun x => by
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := x.property
      exact ⟨n, congrArg Subtype.val hn⟩)
  let q : Subgroup.zpowers a →* Subgroup.zpowers d :=
    (Subgroup.inclusion (Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr haD)).codRestrict _ (fun x => by
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := x.property
      exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext hn⟩)
  have heq : e.comp q = MonoidHom.id _ := by ext x; rfl
  have hq : (Subgroup.zpowers d).subtype.comp q =
      Subgroup.inclusion (Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr haD) := by ext x; rfl
  have hD : HasExponentThree D := fun x => Subtype.ext (hG x)
  have hc := cyclic_amalgamableOver_iff hD d (f.comp e) hf
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, hij⟩
    apply hc.mp
    let : Group K := hK
    apply amalgamableOver_of_amalgam _ _ hpow i j hi hj
    exact congrArg (fun p => p.comp e) hij
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hpow, i, j, hi, hj, hij⟩ := hc.mpr ha
    let : Group K := hK
    apply amalgamableOver_of_amalgam _ _ hpow i j hi hj
    have hh := congrArg (fun p => p.comp q) hij
    simpa only [MonoidHom.comp_assoc, heq, hq, MonoidHom.comp_id] using hh

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsLocallyFinite.exists_finite_qfType_cover_of_model
statement:
theorem IsLocallyFinite.exists_finite_qfType_cover_of_model [Finite L.Symbols]
    (hT : T.IsLocallyFinite) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ P : Finset (Σ M : T.ModelType.{u, v, max u v}, Fin n → M),
      ∀ (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊨ T] (a : Fin n → M),
        ∃ p ∈ P, ∀ φ : L.Formula (Fin n), φ.IsQF → (φ.Realize a ↔ φ.Realize p.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hT.exists_finite_qfType_cover n
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  intro M _ _ _ a
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hsmall⟩ := exists_small_elementarySubstructure_containing_finset
    (L := L) M (Finset.univ.image a)
  let := hsmall
  let N : T.ModelType.{u, v, max u v} := (ModelType.of T S).shrink
  let e : S ≃[L] N := (equivShrink S).inducedStructureEquiv
  let a' : Fin n → S := fun i => ⟨a i, hS (by simp)⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, htype⟩ := hP N (e ∘ a')
  refine ⟨p, hp, fun φ hφ => ?_⟩
  have heφ := e.toElementaryEmbedding.map_formula φ a'
  simp only [Equiv.coe_toElementaryEmbedding] at heφ
  exact (S.subtype.map_formula φ a').trans (heφ.symm.trans (htype φ hφ))

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsLocallyFinite.exists_card_closure_range_le_of_model
statement:
theorem IsLocallyFinite.exists_card_closure_range_le_of_model [Finite L.Symbols]
    (hT : T.IsLocallyFinite) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊨ T] (a : Fin n → M),
      Nat.card (Substructure.closure L (Set.range a)) ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := IsLocallyFinite.exists_finite_qfType_cover_of_model.{u, v, w} hT n
  let size (p : Σ M : T.ModelType.{u, v, max u v}, Fin n → M) : ℕ :=
    Nat.card (Substructure.closure L (Set.range p.2))
  refine ⟨P.sup size, ?_⟩
  intro N _ _ _ b
  obtain ⟨⟨M, a⟩, hp, hpb⟩ := hP N b
  let := hT.finite_closure_range M a
  have hb : Nat.card (Substructure.closure L (Set.range b)) ≤ size ⟨M, a⟩ :=
    Substructure.card_closure_range_le_of_qfType a b hpb
  exact hb.trans (Finset.le_sup (f := size) hp)

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.exists_card_closure_le_of_isLocallyFinite_of_model
statement:
theorem exists_card_closure_le_of_isLocallyFinite_of_model [Finite L.Symbols]
    (hT : T.IsLocallyFinite) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊨ T] (s : Finset M),
      s.card ≤ n → Nat.card (Substructure.closure L (s : Set M)) ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsLocallyFinite.exists_card_closure_range_le_of_model.{u, v, w} hT n
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  intro M _ _ _ s hs
  have hc : Fintype.card s ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n) := by simpa using hs
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hc
  let b : Fin n → M := Function.extend e ((↑) : s → M)
    (fun _ => Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty M))
  have hsrange : (s : Set M) ⊆ Set.range b := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨e ⟨x, hx⟩, e.injective.extend_apply ((↑) : s → M)
      (fun _ => Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty M)) ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  let := hT.finite_closure M (Set.range b) (Set.finite_range b)
  let f := Substructure.inclusion (Substructure.closure_mono (L := L) hsrange)
  exact (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f f.injective).trans (hm M b)

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsLocallyFinite.exists_finite_tupleQfDiagram_representatives_of_model
statement:
theorem IsLocallyFinite.exists_finite_tupleQfDiagram_representatives_of_model
    [Finite L.Symbols] (hT : T.IsLocallyFinite) (M : Type w)
    [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊨ T] {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → M) :
    ∃ Δ : Finset (L.Formula (Fin n)), (Δ : Set (L.Formula (Fin n))) ⊆ tupleQfDiagram (L := L) a ∧
      ∀ φ ∈ tupleQfDiagram (L := L) a, ∃ ψ ∈ Δ, φ ⇔[T] ψ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hrepresentative⟩ := hT.exists_finite_qf_representatives n
  refine ⟨R.filter (fun ψ => ψ.Realize a), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ψ hψ
    have h := Finset.mem_filter.mp hψ
    exact ⟨hR ψ h.1, h.2⟩
  · intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, heq⟩ := hrepresentative φ hφ.1
    refine ⟨ψ, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hψ, ?_⟩, heq⟩
    exact heq.realize_iff.mp hφ.2

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.isExistentiallyClosedAt_equiv
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty M := hM.1
  let : Nonempty N := e.toEquiv.symm.nonempty
  let : M ⊨ T := hM.2.1
  have : N ⊨ T := (e.toElementaryEmbedding.theory_model_iff T).mp hM.2.1
  refine ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro P f n φ x hφ hP
  have hPx : φ.Realize ((f.comp e.toEmbedding) ∘ (e.symm ∘ x)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Embedding.comp_apply, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding,
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hP
  have hMx := hM.reflects_of_model P (f.comp e.toEmbedding) φ (e.symm ∘ x) hφ hPx
  have heφ := e.toElementaryEmbedding.map_formula φ (e.symm ∘ x)
  simpa only [Equiv.coe_toElementaryEmbedding, Function.comp_def, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    using heφ.mpr hMx

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsModelCompanionOf.exists_bounded_nonamalgamation_obstruction_in_universe
statement:
theorem IsModelCompanionOf.exists_bounded_nonamalgamation_obstruction_in_universe [Finite L.Symbols]
    (hPi : T.IsPiTwo) (hMC : Tstar.IsModelCompanionOf T)
    {A : Type w} {B : Type w'} [L.Structure A] [L.Structure B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (i : A ↪[L] B) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (M : Type z) [L.Structure M], T.IsExistentiallyClosedAt M →
      ∀ j : A ↪[L] M, ¬ T.AmalgamableOverAt i j →
        ∃ (C : L.Substructure M) (hj : ∀ a, j a ∈ C), C.GeneratedByAtMost n ∧
          ¬ T.AmalgamableOverAt i (j.codRestrict C hj)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype A := Fintype.ofFinite A
  let a := Fintype.card A
  let eA : A ≃ Fin a := Fintype.equivFin A
  let δ : L.Formula (Fin a) := (extensionFormula (L := L) (i : A → B)).relabel eA
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hiff⟩ := hMC.isModelComplete δ.not
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hψ.exists_bounded_finite_witnesses_formula
  refine ⟨k + a, ?_⟩
  intro M _ hM j hbad
  let : Nonempty M := hM.1
  let : M ⊨ T := hM.2.1
  let : M ⊨ Tstar := (hMC.models_iff_isExistentiallyClosedAt hPi M).mpr hM
  let vA : Fin a → M := j ∘ eA.symm
  have hvA : vA ∘ eA = j := by
    funext x
    exact congrArg j (eA.symm_apply_apply x)
  have hnotδ : ¬ δ.Realize vA := by
    intro hδ
    change ((extensionFormula (L := L) (i : A → B)).relabel eA).Realize vA at hδ
    rw [Formula.realize_relabel, hvA] at hδ
    exact hbad ((hM.amalgamableOverAt_iff_realize_extensionFormula i j).mpr hδ)
  have hψM : ψ.Realize vA := hiff.realize_iff.mp (Formula.realize_not.mpr hnotδ)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, htransfer⟩ := hk M vA hψM
  let t : Finset M := s ∪ Finset.univ.image j
  let C : L.Substructure M := Substructure.closure L (t : Set M)
  have hj : ∀ x, j x ∈ C := fun x =>
    Substructure.subset_closure (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _
      (Finset.mem_univ x)))
  refine ⟨C, hj, ⟨t, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact (Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hs
      (Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp [a])))
  · intro hbadC
    obtain ⟨N₀, f, g, hcomm⟩ := hbadC
    obtain ⟨N, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hMC.isCompanion.2.exists_embedding N₀
    let vC : Fin a → C := j.codRestrict C hj ∘ eA.symm
    have hvC : vC ∘ eA = j.codRestrict C hj := by
      funext x
      exact congrArg (j.codRestrict C hj) (eA.symm_apply_apply x)
    have hsC : (s : Set M) ⊆ Set.range C.subtype := fun x hx =>
      ⟨⟨x, Substructure.subset_closure (Finset.mem_union_left _ hx)⟩, rfl⟩
    have hψC : ψ.Realize vC := htransfer C C.subtype hsC vC rfl
    have hψN : ψ.Realize ((e.comp g) ∘ vC) :=
      hψ.realize_formula_embedding (e.comp g) hψC
    have hδN : δ.Realize ((e.comp g) ∘ vC) := by
      change ((extensionFormula (L := L) (i : A → B)).relabel eA).Realize _
      rw [Formula.realize_relabel, Function.comp_assoc, hvC]
      apply (realize_extensionFormula_iff _ _).mpr
      refine ⟨e.comp f, ?_⟩
      funext x
      exact congrArg e (DFunLike.congr_fun hcomm x)
    exact (Formula.realize_not.mp (hiff.realize_iff.mpr hψN)) hδN

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.BoundedAmalgamationObstructions.exists_bounded_obstruction_in_universe
statement:
theorem BoundedAmalgamationObstructions.exists_bounded_obstruction_in_universe
    [Finite L.Symbols] (hbound : T.BoundedAmalgamationObstructions)
    (hPi : T.IsPiTwo) (hLF : T.IsLocallyFinite)
    {A : Type w} {B : Type w'} [L.Structure A] [L.Structure B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (i : A ↪[L] B) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (M : Type z) [L.Structure M], T.IsExistentiallyClosedAt M →
      ∀ j : A ↪[L] M, ¬ T.AmalgamableOverAt i j →
        ∃ (C : L.Substructure M) (hj : ∀ a, j a ∈ C), C.GeneratedByAtMost n ∧
          ¬ T.AmalgamableOverAt i (j.codRestrict C hj)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Tstar, hMC⟩ := hasModelCompanion_of_boundedAmalgamationObstructions hPi hLF hbound
  exact hMC.exists_bounded_nonamalgamation_obstruction_in_universe hPi i

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.HasModelCompanion.exists_finite_bounded_obstruction_in_universe
statement:
theorem HasModelCompanion.exists_finite_bounded_obstruction_in_universe
    [Finite L.Symbols] (h : T.HasModelCompanion) (hPi : T.IsPiTwo)
    (hLF : T.IsLocallyFinite) {A : Type w} {B : Type w'}
    [L.Structure A] [L.Structure B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (i : A ↪[L] B) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (M : Type z) [L.Structure M], T.IsExistentiallyClosedAt M →
      ∀ j : A ↪[L] M, ¬ T.AmalgamableOverAt i j →
        ∃ (C : L.Substructure M) (hj : ∀ a, j a ∈ C), Finite C ∧ C.GeneratedByAtMost n ∧
          ¬ T.AmalgamableOverAt i (j.codRestrict C hj)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Tstar, hMC⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
    IsModelCompanionOf.exists_bounded_nonamalgamation_obstruction_in_universe.{u, v, w, w', z}
      hPi hMC i
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro M _ hM j hbad
  let : Nonempty M := hM.1
  let : M ⊨ T := hM.2.1
  obtain ⟨C, hj, hgen, hbadC⟩ := hn M hM j hbad
  refine ⟨C, hj, ?_, hgen, hbadC⟩
  obtain ⟨s, _, heq⟩ := hgen
  rw [← heq]
  exact hLF.finite_closure M (s : Set M) s.finite_toSet

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.BoundedAmalgamationObstructionsAt.to_canonical
statement:
theorem BoundedAmalgamationObstructionsAt.to_canonical
    (h : BoundedAmalgamationObstructionsAt.{u, v, z} T) :
    T.BoundedAmalgamationObstructions
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro d
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h d
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro M hM j hbad
  let N : T.ModelType.{u, v, max u v z} := M.ulift
  let e : M ≃[L] N := Equiv.inducedStructureEquiv _
  have hN : T.IsExistentiallyClosedAt N := isExistentiallyClosedAt_equiv hM e
  let jN : d.base ↪[L] N := e.toEmbedding.comp j
  have hbadN : ¬ T.AmalgamableOverAt d.incl jN := by
    intro hN
    exact hbad (amalgamableOverAt_iff.mp (hN.of_comp_right e.toEmbedding))
  obtain ⟨C, hj, hgen, hbadC⟩ := hn N hN jN hbadN
  let D : L.Substructure M := C.map e.symm.toHom
  have hjD : ∀ a, j a ∈ D := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨e (j a), hj a, ?_⟩
    exact e.symm_apply_apply (j a)
  have hgenD : D.GeneratedByAtMost n := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs, heq⟩ := hgen
    refine ⟨s.image e.symm, Finset.card_image_le.trans hs, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.coe_image, ← Equiv.coe_toHom (f := e.symm),
      ← Substructure.map_closure, heq]
  let q : C ↪[L] D := (e.symm.toEmbedding.comp C.subtype).codRestrict D
    (fun c => ⟨c, c.property, rfl⟩)
  have hmark : q.comp (jN.codRestrict C hj) = j.codRestrict D hjD := by
    apply Embedding.ext
    intro a
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact e.symm_apply_apply (j a)
  refine ⟨D, hjD, hgenD, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨P, f, g, heq⟩
  apply hbadC
  apply AmalgamableOverAt.of_comp_right q
  rw [hmark]
  exact AmalgamableOverAt.of_amalgam P f g heq

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.BoundedAmalgamationObstructions.to_universe
statement:
theorem BoundedAmalgamationObstructions.to_universe [Finite L.Symbols]
    (hbound : T.BoundedAmalgamationObstructions) (hPi : T.IsPiTwo)
    (hLF : T.IsLocallyFinite) : BoundedAmalgamationObstructionsAt.{u, v, z} T
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  exact hbound.exists_bounded_obstruction_in_universe hPi hLF d.incl

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.hasModelCompanion_iff_boundedAmalgamationObstructionsAt
statement:
theorem hasModelCompanion_iff_boundedAmalgamationObstructionsAt [Finite L.Symbols]
    (hPi : T.IsPiTwo) (hLF : T.IsLocallyFinite) :
    T.HasModelCompanion ↔ BoundedAmalgamationObstructionsAt.{u, v, z} T
proof:
:= by

  · rintro ⟨Tstar, hMC⟩ d
    exact hMC.exists_bounded_nonamalgamation_obstruction_in_universe hPi d.incl
  · intro hbound

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsLocallyFinite.finite_closure
statement:
theorem IsLocallyFinite.finite_closure (hT : T.IsLocallyFinite) (M : Type w)
    [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊨ T] (s : Set M) (hs : s.Finite) :
    Finite (Substructure.closure L s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hsmall⟩ :=
    exists_small_elementarySubstructure_containing_finset (L := L) M hs.toFinset
  let := hsmall
  let N : T.ModelType.{u, v, max u v} := (ModelType.of T S).shrink
  let e : S ≃[L] N := (equivShrink S).inducedStructureEquiv
  let j : N ↪[L] M := S.subtype.toEmbedding.comp e.symm.toEmbedding
  have hsrange : s ⊆ Set.range j := by
    intro a ha
    let a' : S := ⟨a, hS (hs.mem_toFinset.mpr ha)⟩
    exact ⟨e a', by simp [j, a', Embedding.comp_apply, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding]⟩
  let t : Set N := j ⁻¹' s
  have ht : t.Finite := hs.preimage j.injective.injOn
  have himage : j '' t = s := Set.image_preimage_eq_of_subset hsrange
  let := hT N t ht
  have hfinite : Set.Finite (Substructure.closure L s : Set M) := by
    rw [← himage, ← Embedding.coe_toHom (f := j), Substructure.closure_image j.toHom]
    exact (Set.toFinite (Substructure.closure L t : Set N)).image j
  exact hfinite.to_subtype

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsLocallyFinite.exists_finite_tupleQfDiagram_of_model
statement:
theorem IsLocallyFinite.exists_finite_tupleQfDiagram_of_model [Finite L.Symbols]
    (hT : T.IsLocallyFinite) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊨ T]
    {α : Type x} [Finite α] (a : α → M) :
    ∃ Δ : Finset (L.Formula α), (Δ : Set (L.Formula α)) ⊆ tupleQfDiagram (L := L) a ∧
      ∀ (N : Type w') [L.Structure N] (b : α → N),
        (∀ φ ∈ Δ, φ.Realize b) ↔ ∀ φ ∈ tupleQfDiagram (L := L) a, φ.Realize b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := hT.finite_closure M (Set.range a) (Set.finite_range a)
  refine ⟨{finiteGeneratedDiagram (L := L) a}, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro φ hφ
    obtain rfl := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hφ
    exact finiteGeneratedDiagram_mem_tupleQfDiagram a
  · intro N _ b
    simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq] using
      realize_finiteGeneratedDiagram_iff_tupleQfDiagram a b

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.exists_amalgam_of_small
statement:
theorem exists_amalgam_of_small [Small.{max u v z} B] [Small.{max u v z} C]
    {i : A ↪[L] B} {j : A ↪[L] C} (N : Type w''')
    [L.Structure N] [Nonempty N] [N ⊨ T] (f : B ↪[L] N) (g : C ↪[L] N)
    (heq : f.comp i = g.comp j) :
    ∃ (P : T.ModelType.{u, v, max u v z}) (f' : B ↪[L] P) (g' : C ↪[L] P),
      f'.comp i = g'.comp j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Set N := Set.range (Sum.elim f g)
  let S := (Substructure.closure (L.sum L.skolem₁) s).elementarySkolem₁Reduct
  have : Small.{max u v z} S := by
    change Small.{max u v z} (Substructure.closure (L.sum L.skolem₁) s)
    rw [← SetLike.coe_sort_coe, Substructure.coe_closure_eq_range_term_realize]
    have : Small.{max u v z} ((L.sum L.skolem₁).Term s) :=
      small_of_injective (Term.relabelEquiv (equivShrink.{max u v z} s)).injective
    exact small_range _
  let P : T.ModelType.{u, v, max u v z} := (ModelType.of T S).shrink
  let e : S ≃[L] P := (equivShrink S).inducedStructureEquiv
  let fS : B ↪[L] S := f.codRestrict S.toSubstructure
    (fun b => Substructure.subset_closure ⟨Sum.inl b, rfl⟩)
  let gS : C ↪[L] S := g.codRestrict S.toSubstructure
    (fun c => Substructure.subset_closure ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨P, e.toEmbedding.comp fS, e.toEmbedding.comp gS, ?_⟩
  apply Embedding.ext
  intro a
  apply congrArg e.toEmbedding
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq a

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.AmalgamableOverAt.of_amalgam
statement:
theorem AmalgamableOverAt.of_amalgam {i : A ↪[L] B} {j : A ↪[L] C}
    (N : Type w''') [L.Structure N] [Nonempty N] [N ⊨ T]
    (f : B ↪[L] N) (g : C ↪[L] N) (heq : f.comp i = g.comp j) :
    T.AmalgamableOverAt i j
proof:
:=
  exists_amalgam_of_small.{u, v, w, w', w'', w''', max w' w''} N f g heq

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.amalgamableOverAt_iff
statement:
theorem amalgamableOverAt_iff [Small.{max u v} B] [Small.{max u v} C]
    {i : A ↪[L] B} {j : A ↪[L] C} :
    T.AmalgamableOverAt i j ↔ T.AmalgamableOver i j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨N, f, g, heq⟩
    exact exists_amalgam_of_small.{u, v, w, w', w'', max u v w' w'', 0} N f g heq
  · rintro ⟨N, f, g, heq⟩
    exact AmalgamableOverAt.of_amalgam N f g heq

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.AmalgamableOverAt.symm
statement:
theorem AmalgamableOverAt.symm {i : A ↪[L] B} {j : A ↪[L] C}
    (h : T.AmalgamableOverAt i j) : T.AmalgamableOverAt j i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, f, g, heq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨N, g, f, heq.symm⟩

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.AmalgamableOverAt.of_comp_right
statement:
theorem AmalgamableOverAt.of_comp_right {D : Type w'''} [L.Structure D]
    {i : A ↪[L] B} {j : A ↪[L] C} (e : C ↪[L] D)
    (h : T.AmalgamableOverAt i (e.comp j)) : T.AmalgamableOverAt i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, f, g, heq⟩ := h
  exact AmalgamableOverAt.of_amalgam N f (g.comp e) heq

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsExistentiallyClosedAt.amalgamableOverAt_iff_exists_embedding
statement:
theorem IsExistentiallyClosedAt.amalgamableOverAt_iff_exists_embedding [Finite L.Symbols]
    [Finite A] [Finite B] {M : Type w''} [L.Structure M]
    (hM : T.IsExistentiallyClosedAt M) (i : A ↪[L] B) (j : A ↪[L] M) :
    T.AmalgamableOverAt i j ↔ ∃ f : B ↪[L] M, f.comp i = j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨N, f, g, heq⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hM.exists_embedding_over_tuple N g i j f
      (congrArg DFunLike.coe heq)
    exact ⟨e, Embedding.ext (congrFun he)⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, heq⟩
    let : Nonempty M := hM.1
    let : M ⊨ T := hM.2.1
    exact AmalgamableOverAt.of_amalgam M f (Embedding.refl L M) heq

name: FirstOrder.Language.Theory.IsExistentiallyClosedAt.amalgamableOverAt_iff_realize_extensionFormula
statement:
theorem IsExistentiallyClosedAt.amalgamableOverAt_iff_realize_extensionFormula
    [Finite L.Symbols] [Finite A] [Finite B] {M : Type w''} [L.Structure M]
    (hM : T.IsExistentiallyClosedAt M) (i : A ↪[L] B) (j : A ↪[L] M) :
    T.AmalgamableOverAt i j ↔ (extensionFormula (L := L) (i : A → B)).Realize j
proof:
:= by
  rw [hM.amalgamableOverAt_iff_exists_embedding i j, realize_extensionFormula_iff]
  exact exists_congr fun f => ⟨fun h => congrArg DFunLike.coe h,
    fun h => Embedding.ext (congrFun h)⟩
